hindi: मेरी भी सहमति — बिना शब्द जोड़े समर्थन
definition: typed agreement; adds your vote without adding words
example: +1 to shipping Thursday and sleeping on Friday.

hindi: दस-गुना इंजीनियर — दस के बराबर बताया जाने वाला (प्रायः मिथकीय) डेवलपर
definition: a supposedly ten-times-more-productive developer, part legend, part hiring myth
example: He's a 10x engineer: ten times the code, ten times the incidents.

hindi: विहंगम दृष्टि — बहुत ऊँचाई से मोटा-मोटा नज़ारा
definition: an executive-level overview with no details
example: Give me the 30,000-foot view before the details.

hindi: चौतरफा मूल्यांकन — बॉस, साथी और अधीनस्थ सबकी राय
definition: feedback collected from your manager, peers, and reports all at once
example: The 360 review confirmed everyone likes him except the people he manages.

hindi: 80/20 नियम — 20% मेहनत से 80% नतीजा मिलने का सिद्धांत
definition: the principle that most results come from a minority of effort
example: Apply the 80/20 rule: ship the top three features.

hindi: @ से नाम लेकर बुलाना — सूचना पहुँचाना
definition: to name someone with @ so they get a notification
example: @mention the owner directly or the request dies in the channel.

hindi: ए/ए परीक्षण — दो एक-जैसे संस्करणों से टेस्टिंग सिस्टम की जांच
definition: an experiment comparing identical versions to verify the testing setup itself
example: The A/A test found a winner, which is the bad news.

hindi: ए/बी परीक्षण — दो संस्करण दिखाकर बेहतर चुनने का प्रयोग
definition: an experiment showing users two versions to see which performs better
example: The A/B test says the ugly button wins; design is grieving.

hindi: सुगम्यता का संक्षिप्त रूप — a और y के बीच ग्यारह अक्षर
definition: shorthand for accessibility: a, eleven letters, y
example: The a11y audit found forty issues, starting with the gray-on-gray text.

hindi: पाइरेट मेट्रिक्स — अधिग्रहण, सक्रियण, प्रतिधारण, रेफ़रल, राजस्व का ढांचा
definition: acquisition, activation, retention, referral, revenue; the pirate metrics funnel
example: We adopted AARRR because saying it in planning is the best part.

hindi: खाता-आधारित विपणन — चुनिंदा कंपनियों पर केंद्रित अभियान
definition: account-based marketing — targeting a specific list of companies with personalized campaigns
example: ABM means the ad only stalks the twelve companies we actually want.

hindi: पहली नज़र का क्षेत्र — बिना स्क्रॉल किए दिखने वाला हिस्सा
definition: the part of a page visible without scrolling
example: Everyone wants their feature above the fold; the fold disagrees.

hindi: त्वरक कार्यक्रम — स्टार्टअप्स को पूँजी, मार्गदर्शन और मंच देने वाला
definition: a fixed-term program that gives startups money, mentorship, and a demo day
example: The accelerator took seven percent and gave us unlimited coffee and deadlines.

hindi: स्वीकृति मानदंड — कहानी पूर्ण मानने की जाँच-शर्तें
definition: the testable conditions a story must meet to be accepted as complete
example: No acceptance criteria, no story; that's the theory anyway.

hindi: सुगम्यता — दिव्यांग समेत सभी के लिए उपयोग-योग्य बनाना
definition: designing products that people with disabilities can actually use
example: Accessibility isn't a feature request; it's the price of shipping.

hindi: ग्राहक खाता — एक कंपनी और उससे जुड़े सारे सौदे
definition: a customer company and everything related to selling to it
example: She inherited the account along with three years of unanswered emails.

hindi: देय राशि — कंपनी पर विक्रेताओं का बक़ाया
definition: money the company owes its vendors and suppliers
example: Accounts payable says the check is coming; vendors call it folklore.

hindi: प्राप्य राशि — ग्राहकों से आनी बाक़ी रक़में
definition: money customers owe the company
example: Our accounts receivable is aging like it's in a cellar.

hindi: प्राप्ति की पुष्टि — मिल गया, पढ़ लिया
definition: to acknowledge a message — received and read, action to follow
example: Please ack the incident so we know someone's on it.

hindi: टीम पाने के लिए पूरी कंपनी खरीदना — उत्पाद अक्सर बंद
definition: buying a company mainly for its people, then shelving its product
example: The acqui-hire kept the engineers; the app got a sunset email.

hindi: अमल में लाना — बात को काम में बदलना
definition: to turn an item into actual work, in manager dialect
example: Great points; who's going to action them?

hindi: कार्य बिंदु — मीटिंग से निकला, किसी को सौंपा गया काम
definition: a task assigned in a meeting, with an owner and theoretical deadline
example: The meeting produced nine action items and no decisions.

hindi: कार्रवाई आवश्यक — पढ़ना नहीं, करना है
definition: subject-line warning that this email contains actual work
example: Subject says action required, so it might survive Monday's inbox purge.

hindi: करने लायक़ — जिस पर सीधे कार्रवाई हो सके
definition: specific enough to act on
example: Interesting data, but give me one actionable takeaway.

hindi: कार्रवाई-योग्य मापदंड — जो साफ बताए कि आगे क्या करना है
definition: a measure tied clearly enough to behavior that it guides decisions
example: An actionable metric tells you what to fix; ours tell us moods.

hindi: सक्रियण — नए उपयोगकर्ता को पहली बार असली फायदा मिलना
definition: the moment a new user first experiences the product's core value
example: Activation is defined as three actions, chosen by vote.

hindi: गतिविधि पहचान — सेंसर से समझना कि व्यक्ति क्या कर रहा है
definition: classifying what a person is physically doing from sensor or camera data
example: Activity recognition logged vacuuming as cardio; users have never been happier.

hindi: वार्षिक अनुबंध मूल्य — एक वर्ष की अनुबंध-राशि
definition: annual contract value — what a customer's contract is worth per year
example: The ACV looks great if you ignore the free first year.

hindi: अपनाना — उपयोगकर्ताओं का किसी फ़ीचर या उत्पाद को इस्तेमाल में लेना
definition: the extent to which users start using a product or feature
example: Feature adoption is at four percent, led by the team that built it.

hindi: पैरोकार ग्राहक — सबके सामने उत्पाद की सिफ़ारिश करने वाला
definition: a customer who publicly recommends your product without being paid to
example: She's such an advocate we should probably put her on payroll.

hindi: खाता कार्यकारी — सौदे चलाने और बंद करने वाला विक्रेता
definition: account executive — the salesperson who runs deals and closes them
example: The AE takes the meeting; the SDR who booked it gets a shout-out.

hindi: जहाँ तक मुझे पता है — पक्का दावा नहीं
definition: as far as I know — true to my knowledge, with an escape hatch
example: AFAIK nobody owns that dashboard anymore.

hindi: संकेत-गुण — रूप से ही उपयोग का तरीका बताने वाला गुण
definition: a design cue that suggests how something should be used
example: Flat buttons lost their affordance; users no longer know what's clickable.

hindi: कीबोर्ड से दूर — जवाब में देरी होगी
definition: away from keyboard — not at the desk, replies will lag
example: AFK for lunch; ping me only if production is on fire.

hindi: एजेंसी — डिज़ाइन, विज्ञापन जैसी सेवाएँ देने वाली बाहरी फर्म
definition: an external firm hired for services like design, marketing, or recruiting
example: We paid the agency six figures for a logo we redrew internally.

hindi: कार्यसूची — बैठक के विषयों की क्रमबद्ध सूची
definition: the ordered list of topics a meeting will cover
example: No agenda, no attenda, as the poster says.

hindi: एजेंट — औज़ार लेकर कई क़दमों में काम निपटाने वाला एआई
definition: an AI system that plans and takes multi-step actions using tools, not just answers
example: The support agent resolved the refund, rescheduled the class, and cc'd nobody.

hindi: स्वायत्त-कर्मी — लक्ष्य तक ख़ुद कई क़दम उठाने वाला
definition: acting with autonomy across multiple steps and tools to reach a goal
example: The roadmap says 'agentic' four times; the demo still books the wrong gym slot.

hindi: कृत्रिम सामान्य बुद्धि — अधिकांश मानवीय कामों में सक्षम काल्पनिक एआई
definition: artificial general intelligence; a hypothetical AI matching humans across most cognitive work
example: AGI timelines dominate lunch; the sprint board remains unmoved.

hindi: एजाइल — छोटे चक्रों में लचीले ढंग से काम करने की कार्यप्रणाली
definition: of software delivery done in short iterative cycles with frequent feedback rather than one big plan
example: We're agile now, which mostly means the meetings have new names.

hindi: अहा क्षण — जब उपयोगकर्ता को उत्पाद की असली कीमत समझ आ जाए
definition: the instant a new user first grasps why the product matters
example: We moved the aha moment earlier; onboarding now takes only forty minutes.

hindi: एआई अभिशासन — संस्था में एआई के उपयोग पर नीतियाँ और निगरानी
definition: the policies, reviews, and accountability that control how an organization uses AI
example: AI governance now has its own committee, calendar, and acronym-filled charter.

hindi: एआई साक्षरता — एआई की क्षमता और सीमा की बुनियादी समझ
definition: baseline understanding of what AI can, cannot, and should not do
example: AI literacy training is mandatory now, mostly so people stop pasting secrets into chatbots.

hindi: एआई कचरा — हर जगह पटा घटिया मशीनी कंटेंट
definition: low-quality machine-generated content flooding feeds, inboxes, and search results
example: The blog's traffic died after two months of AI slop; who could have guessed.

hindi: एआई आवरण — दूसरों के मॉडल पर चढ़ाया पतला उत्पाद-ख़ोल
definition: a product that is mostly a thin interface over someone else's model
example: 'Just an AI wrapper', says the competitor with the identical AI wrapper.

hindi: एआई-प्रथम — शुरुआत से ही एआई को केंद्र में रखकर डिज़ाइन
definition: designing products and workflows around AI capabilities from the start, not bolting them on
example: Going AI-first means the app plans your training week before you open it.

hindi: एआई-निर्मित — इंसान नहीं, मॉडल का बनाया हुआ
definition: produced by a model rather than a person, ideally labeled as such
example: The AI-generated meal plans are fine; the AI-generated motivational poetry was a mistake.

hindi: संरेखण — एआई के व्यवहार को मानवीय मंशा और मूल्यों से मिलाना
definition: making an AI system's behavior match human intent and values
example: Alignment question of the week: should the coach push harder or protect your knees?

hindi: पूर्ण सभा — पूरी कंपनी की बैठक
definition: a meeting for the entire company
example: The all-hands announced record growth and a hiring freeze.

hindi: आबंटित करना — धन, लोग या समय तय काम को देना
definition: to assign money, people, or time to a purpose
example: Allocate the budget before the loudest team does it for you.

hindi: प्रारंभिक परीक्षण संस्करण — अधूरा, भीतरखाने आज़माने लायक रूप
definition: an early, rough version tested internally or by the brave
example: The alpha crashes on launch, which technically prevents all other bugs.

hindi: वैकल्पिक पाठ — चित्र का शब्दों में वर्णन, जो देख न सकें उनके लिए
definition: the written description of an image for those who can't see it
example: The alt text says 'image123.png', which is technically a description.

hindi: सदा-उपलब्ध — हर घड़ी संपर्क की अपेक्षा
definition: expected to be reachable at any hour
example: Always-on culture means the phone buzzes on the beach too.

hindi: कुछ भी पूछो सत्र — नेतृत्व से खुले सवाल
definition: ask me anything; an open question session with a leader
example: The CTO's AMA filled with anonymous questions in one minute.

hindi: किश्तों में बाँटना — लागत को समय के साथ फैलाना
definition: to spread a cost over time
example: We amortize the rewrite's cost across every roadmap it delayed.

hindi: विश्लेषण में जड़ता — इतना सोचना कि फ़ैसला ही न हो
definition: overthinking that prevents any decision
example: Six spreadsheets later, analysis paralysis won again.

hindi: निर्धारित दफ़्तर-दिवस — सब साथ आने का दिन
definition: a designated weekday when hybrid teammates come in together
example: Tuesday is anchor day, so book the good conference room early.

hindi: किस्सा-आँकड़ा — कहानियों को डेटा की तरह पेश करना
definition: anecdotes dressed up and presented as data
example: Three customer emails is anecdata, not a trend, per the data team.

hindi: देवदूत निवेशक — शुरुआती स्टार्टअप में अपना पैसा लगाने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: an individual who invests personal money in very early startups
example: Our first angel investor was the founder's old boss, oddly forgiving.

hindi: टिप्पणी-अंकन — डेटा पर लेबल, नोट या श्रेणियाँ जोड़ना
definition: adding labels, notes, or categories to data for training or evaluation
example: The annotation guidelines run forty pages, mostly about what counts as a rep.

hindi: सार्वजनिक घोषणा — सबके लिए आधिकारिक सूचना
definition: an official message meant for everyone, read by some
example: Post the holiday list as an announcement, not a reply.

hindi: विसंगति — सामान्य पैटर्न से अनपेक्षित भटकाव
definition: an unexpected deviation from the normal pattern in data
example: The anomaly was a bot; the celebration was genuine.

hindi: विसंगति पहचान — सामान्य ढर्रे से हटी चीज़ें अपने-आप पकड़ना
definition: automatically spotting data points that deviate from the normal pattern
example: Anomaly detection flagged your heart rate spike; turns out it was just leg day.

hindi: अनामीकरण — डेटा से पहचान बताने वाले सुराग़ हटाना
definition: stripping data of anything that could identify the person behind it
example: Anonymization first, analysis second — the research team never sees names, just squats.

hindi: हिस्सेदारी सुरक्षा शर्त — घटी क़ीमत के दौर में निवेशक का बचाव
definition: a term protecting investors' stakes if the company later raises at a lower price
example: The anti-dilution clause seemed harmless until the down round arrived.

hindi: कुप्रथा — आम पर हानिकारक समाधान-शैली
definition: a common solution that reliably causes more problems than it solves
example: We documented the anti-pattern, right after shipping it.

hindi: कोई प्रगति? — काम कहाँ तक पहुँचा
definition: the polite prod asking where the thing you promised is
example: Any update? The client asked me, so I'm asking you.

hindi: औसत ऑर्डर मूल्य — हर ऑर्डर की औसत रकम
definition: average order value
example: Free shipping raised AOV and quietly ate the margin.

hindi: मंज़ूरी शृंखला — फ़ैसले के लिए ज़रूरी अनुमतियों की कतार
definition: the sequence of people who must approve something
example: The approval chain has six links and one person on vacation.

hindi: स्वीकृति देना — औपचारिक हाँ कहना
definition: to formally say yes to something
example: Approved, pending the seven other approvals.

hindi: संदेश संभालकर हटाना — मिटाए बिना इनबॉक्स से बाहर
definition: to file a message out of the inbox without deleting it
example: Archive the thread once the ticket closes.

hindi: प्रति उपयोगकर्ता औसत राजस्व — हर उपयोगकर्ता से औसत कमाई
definition: average revenue per user
example: ARPU rose because the free users left, which is one way.

hindi: वार्षिक आवर्ती राजस्व — सालाना दोहराई जाने वाली सब्सक्रिप्शन कमाई
definition: annual recurring revenue; subscription revenue normalized to a yearly figure
example: ARR is up; please do not annualize last Tuesday.

hindi: जैसा चर्चा हुई — पिछली बातचीत का हवाला
definition: invoking an earlier conversation so its outcome counts as agreed
example: As discussed, the demo moves to Thursday.

hindi: के अनुसार — दफ़्तरी हवाला
definition: according to — office formalese for citing a source or agreement
example: As per policy, travel above economy needs a director's blessing.

hindi: जल्द से जल्द — फ़ौरन चाहिए
definition: as soon as possible — urgent, but the deadline is your problem
example: Need the signed copy ASAP; the courier leaves at four.

hindi: सहायक — सवालों के जवाब देने और काम निपटाने वाला संवादी एआई
definition: a conversational AI product that answers questions and completes tasks for users
example: Users tell the assistant things they'd never tell their trainer, starting with the truth.

hindi: असमकालिक — सबकी एक-साथ मौजूदगी के बिना
definition: done without needing everyone present at the same time
example: Let's make the status update async and cancel the call.

hindi: असमकालिक-प्रथम — पहले लिखित संवाद, फिर बैठक
definition: defaulting to written, non-simultaneous communication before booking meetings
example: Async-first means the doc goes out before any invite does.

hindi: जोखिम में — समयसीमा चूकने की आशंका वाला
definition: in danger of missing its date, the polite word before slipping
example: The launch is at risk, which everyone heard as late.

term: at the end of the day
hindi: आख़िरकार — सब जोड़-घटाकर असल बात
definition: when everything is considered; signals a conclusion is coming
example: At the end of the day, someone still has to ship it.

hindi: बिना कारण बताए नौकरी समाप्त की जा सकने वाली व्यवस्था
definition: employment either side can end at any time, for almost any reason
example: The handbook celebrates loyalty; page two explains at-will employment.

hindi: आणविक डिज़ाइन — अणु से पेज तक घटक जोड़ने की पद्धति
definition: building UIs from small parts up: atoms, molecules, organisms, pages
example: Atomic design is great until someone asks what an organism is.

hindi: आवेदन ट्रैक करने वाला सॉफ्टवेयर — रिज़्यूमे छाँटने की प्रणाली
definition: applicant tracking system; software that stores, filters, and often rejects resumes
example: Tailor the resume keywords or the ATS will never let a human see it.

hindi: संलग्न फ़ाइल — ईमेल के साथ जुड़ी फ़ाइल
definition: the file included with an email, famously easy to forget
example: Resending with the attachment actually attached this time.

hindi: श्रेय-निर्धारण — किस चैनल या कदम से नतीजा आया, यह तय करना
definition: deciding which touchpoint gets credit for a conversion
example: Attribution says the blog did it; the blog was down that week.

hindi: कर्मचारियों का धीरे-धीरे स्वाभाविक रूप से छोड़ते जाना
definition: the gradual loss of employees who leave and aren't always replaced
example: No layoffs needed; attrition and a hiring freeze did it quietly.

hindi: लेखा-परीक्षा — रिकॉर्ड और प्रक्रियाओं की औपचारिक जाँच
definition: a formal inspection of records, finances, or processes
example: The audit found the process we swore we had.

hindi: जाँच-निशान — किसने कब क्या किया, इसका रिकॉर्ड
definition: a record of who did what and when
example: The audit trail shows exactly who deleted the audit trail.

hindi: सम्वर्धन — इंसान की जगह लेने के बजाय उसका काम बेहतर बनाना
definition: using AI to make people better at their jobs rather than replace them
example: The pitch says augmentation, not automation — the trainers remain cautiously optimistic.

hindi: स्वचालन — बिना इंसानी हाथ लगाए काम पूरा करवाना
definition: having software do a task end to end without a person in it
example: We automated the weekly progress email; unsubscribes automated themselves shortly after.

hindi: उपलब्धता — मिलने लायक ख़ाली समय
definition: the open times someone can meet
example: Send your availability and I'll do the calendar Tetris.

hindi: दूर — सीट पर नहीं वाली स्थिति
definition: the presence status meaning not at the desk right now
example: Set yourself to away if you're stepping out for lunch.

hindi: व्यवसाय-से-व्यवसाय — कंपनियों को बेचना, आम उपभोक्ता को नहीं
definition: business-to-business; selling to companies rather than consumers
example: We went B2B because companies complain less and pay more.

hindi: व्यवसाय-से-उपभोक्ता — सीधे आम ग्राहकों को बेचना
definition: business-to-consumer; selling directly to individual customers
example: B2C means millions of tiny customers and one very loud app store.

hindi: लगातार बैठकें — बिना अंतराल एक के बाद एक
definition: scheduled with no gap between meetings
example: I'm back-to-back until four; can this be async?

hindi: ठंडे बस्ते में डालना — काम टालकर पीछे रखना
definition: to postpone something indefinitely without officially killing it
example: We backburnered the redesign; the burner has a waiting list.

hindi: आधिकारिक संदर्भों के बाहर चुपचाप राय जुटाना
definition: to quietly gather opinions on a candidate outside their offered references
example: The official references were great, but someone backchanneled a former teammate.

hindi: गए हुए कर्मचारी की जगह नई भर्ती
definition: a hire made to replace someone who left, not to grow the team
example: She quit in March; the backfill was approved in September.

hindi: बैकलॉग — बचे हुए कामों की प्राथमिकता-क्रम सूची
definition: the ordered list of all work a team intends to do someday
example: It's in the backlog, right between hope and never.

hindi: बैकलॉग सँवारना — कार्य-सूची छाँटने और क्रम देने की बैठक
definition: a session to clean up, estimate, and reorder backlog items
example: Backlog grooming ran long, so the backlog remains ungroomed.

hindi: पिछड़ा-संगत — पुराने संस्करणों के साथ बिना तोड़े चलने वाला
definition: still working with older versions, data, or clients
example: It's backwards compatible with everything except our oldest customer.

hindi: आमने-सामने मूल्यांकन — कई विक्रेताओं की सीधी तुलना
definition: a head-to-head evaluation where a customer trials competing vendors
example: We're in a bake-off against two rivals and the customer's intern's side project.

hindi: मोटा अनुमान — लगभग कितना होगा, का अंदाज़ा
definition: a rough estimate
example: Ballpark the cost; nobody will hold you to it, officially.

hindi: वेतन-सीमा — किसी स्तर के लिए तय न्यूनतम-अधिकतम दायरा
definition: the salary range attached to a given level or role
example: HR loved the work, but the raise would exceed the band.

hindi: पट्टी-मरहम — मर्ज़ नहीं, बस लक्षण ढकने वाला इलाज
definition: a superficial patch that covers the symptom while the disease continues
example: Another band-aid fix; the wound underneath now has its own team.

hindi: काम की गुंजाइश — और काम लेने की क्षमता
definition: spare capacity to take on more work
example: I'd love to help, but I have zero bandwidth this week.

hindi: बजट, अधिकार, ज़रूरत, समयसीमा — लीड परखने की कसौटी
definition: budget, authority, need, timeline — a checklist for qualifying leads
example: It passed BANT except budget, authority, and timeline.

hindi: भर्ती-गुणवत्ता की रक्षा करने वाला तटस्थ इंटरव्यूअर
definition: an interviewer from outside the team empowered to veto hires to protect quality
example: Everyone said yes except the bar raiser, so it was no.

hindi: मूल मॉडल — फ़ाइन-ट्यूनिंग से पहले का कच्चा प्रशिक्षित मॉडल
definition: a pretrained model before fine-tuning or safety training shapes it for a product
example: The base model knows everything about deadlifts and nothing about being polite.

hindi: आधार रेखा — बदलाव से पहले का स्तर, तुलना का आधार
definition: the starting measurement any change gets compared against
example: Impressive growth, until someone asked what the baseline was.

hindi: प्रतिस्पर्धा-पत्रक — प्रतिद्वंद्वी के विरुद्ध बिक्री तर्क
definition: a cheat sheet telling reps how to sell against a specific competitor
example: The battlecard says never mention them first; the prospect always mentions them first.

hindi: यथावत कार्य — पहल से अलग, नियमित चालू काम
definition: business as usual; the routine work that continues regardless of initiatives
example: That's BAU, so it gets no ticket, no glory, no end.

hindi: छुपी प्रतिलिपि भेजना — औरों को दिखे बिना
definition: to copy someone invisibly; recipients cannot see they were included
example: Moving the vendor to bcc so we can speak freely.

hindi: व्यवसाय विकास प्रतिनिधि — ठंडे संपर्क से अवसर बनाने वाला
definition: business development representative — like an SDR, usually focused on outbound prospecting
example: Ask three companies the difference between BDR and SDR; get four answers.

hindi: अग्रिम मोर्चा बाज़ार — पहले छोटा बाज़ार जीतो, फिर फैलो
definition: the small first market you dominate before expanding outward
example: Our beachhead market is dentists in Pune; the world comes later.

hindi: हिसाब-किताब वाला — ख़र्च पर नज़र रखने वाले वित्त-कर्मी का व्यंग्य नाम
definition: a mildly rude nickname for a finance person focused on costs
example: The bean counters found the unused licenses before we did.

hindi: तामझाम — ज़रूरी नहीं, दिखावटी अतिरिक्त सुविधाएँ
definition: attractive extra features that are not essential
example: Ship the basics first; bells and whistles can wait.

hindi: बिना प्रोजेक्ट के प्रतीक्षारत कर्मचारी-समूह
definition: staff between projects, kept employed but unassigned
example: Two months on the bench taught him every conference room's name.

hindi: मानक — तुलना के लिए उद्योग या प्रतिस्पर्धी का स्तर
definition: an external reference point used to judge whether your numbers are good
example: We beat the industry benchmark once we picked a different industry.

hindi: सुविधाएँ — वेतन के अलावा मिलने वाले लाभ, जैसे बीमा
definition: non-salary compensation like insurance, leave, and perks
example: The benefits page says 'competitive'; the dentist bill says otherwise.

hindi: श्रेष्ठ तरीक़ा — आज़माया हुआ मानक तरीक़ा
definition: the accepted standard way of doing something, wherever it was actually proven
example: Code review before merge is best practice, even on Fridays.

hindi: परीक्षण-पूर्व संस्करण — सीमित दर्शकों के लिए लगभग-तैयार रूप
definition: a nearly finished version released to a limited audience for testing
example: It's been in beta for three years; commitment issues, probably.

hindi: पूर्वाग्रह — झुके हुए डेटा से सीखी गई व्यवस्थागत नाइंसाफ़ी
definition: systematic unfairness a model learns from skewed training data
example: The model assumed all lifters are 25-year-old men — bias straight from the training data.

hindi: कीचड़ का गोला — बिना किसी ढाँचे का लिथड़ा हुआ सिस्टम
definition: a system with no discernible architecture, just accumulated mud
example: The architecture diagram is honest: one big ball of mud.

hindi: एक-झटके में — सब कुछ एक साथ जारी करना
definition: launching everything to everyone at once, no stages, no retreat
example: We chose a big bang release, and the name proved apt.

hindi: बड़ी तस्वीर — ब्योरों से ऊपर उठकर समग्र नज़रिया
definition: the overall view above the details
example: Zoom out to the big picture before we argue button colors.

hindi: बड़ा पत्थर — तिमाही का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण भारी काम
definition: one of the few large priorities a team commits to first
example: Migrations are this quarter's big rock; everything else is gravel.

hindi: एकमुश्त धमाका रिलीज़ — सब कुछ एक साथ जारी करना
definition: shipping everything at once instead of incrementally, maximizing suspense and risk
example: The big-bang release went fine, if you don't count the outage.

hindi: छोटी बात पर लंबी बहस — बड़े मुद्दे छोड़ तुच्छ विवरण पर अटकना
definition: debating trivial details at length while the hard decisions go untouched
example: An hour of bikeshedding over the function name, zero minutes on the data model.

hindi: बिल-योग्य — ग्राहक से वसूला जा सकने वाला समय या काम
definition: chargeable to a client, as in billable hours
example: For the agency, listening to our complaints is billable.

hindi: आधा-आधा खोजना — इतिहास बाँटते हुए बिगाड़ने वाला कमिट पकड़ना
definition: to find the commit that broke things by halving the history repeatedly
example: Two hundred commits, eight bisect steps, one guilty one-liner.

hindi: कोड का क्षय — अनछुआ कोड समय के साथ खुद बिगड़ना
definition: the gradual decay of untouched code as the world changes around it
example: Nobody edited it for five years; the bit rot did.

hindi: पाक्षिक या सप्ताह में दो बार — अर्थ पूछकर तय करें
definition: every two weeks, or twice a week; always confirm which
example: Our biweekly sync collapsed because nobody agreed what biweekly meant.

hindi: दोषमुक्त — व्यक्ति नहीं, प्रक्रिया पर केंद्रित समीक्षा
definition: focused on systems rather than individuals when reviewing a failure
example: It's a blameless post-mortem, so please stop looking at Dave.

hindi: जोखिम भरी अत्याधुनिकता — इतनी नई तकनीक कि घाव दे जाए
definition: technology so new it is unstable and risky
example: We chose the bleeding edge and bled accordingly.

hindi: बिजली-रफ़्तार विस्तार — दक्षता छोड़कर बाज़ार पर तेज़ क़ब्ज़ा
definition: prioritizing extreme speed over efficiency to dominate a market before rivals do
example: Blitzscaling sounded great until we saw the cloud bill.

hindi: समय आरक्षित करना — कैलेंडर पर जगह रोकना
definition: to reserve calendar time so nothing can be scheduled over it
example: Block off Friday afternoon or the calendar wolves will take it.

hindi: अवरुद्ध — बाधा के कारण रुका हुआ
definition: unable to proceed until someone or something else moves first
example: I'm blocked on legal, which is a permanent state of being.

hindi: बाधा — वह चीज़ जो काम आगे नहीं बढ़ने देती
definition: anything that prevents work from moving forward
example: My only blocker is waiting on the API team's review.

hindi: नीला-हरा परिनियोजन — दो जुड़वाँ वातावरणों में झट अदला-बदली
definition: using two identical environments and switching traffic between them for zero-downtime releases
example: Blue-green deploys, so we can panic and switch back instantly.

hindi: खुले आसमान की सोच — हर बंदिश हटाकर कल्पना करना
definition: idea generation with no practical constraints
example: The blue-sky session produced a jetpack and no budget.

hindi: अचानक मिला सौदा — बिना मेहनत आया ग्राहक
definition: an unexpected deal that lands with little or no effort from sales
example: A bluebird signed through the website; the AE added it to his forecast retroactively.

hindi: निष्कर्ष सबसे पहले — मुख्य बात ऊपर
definition: bottom line up front — the conclusion first, the story after
example: BLUF: we're over budget; details and excuses in the doc.

hindi: असंभव बीड़ा उठाना — ज़रूरत से कहीं बड़ा काम छेड़ देना
definition: to attempt something impossibly broad instead of a focused task
example: Support ten languages at launch? Let's not boil the ocean.

hindi: साँचा-कोड — बार-बार दोहराया जाने वाला ज़रूरी पर नीरस कोड
definition: repetitive standard code you must write before anything interesting happens
example: Two hundred lines of boilerplate to print hello.

hindi: ग्राहक-सूची — किसी विक्रेता के ज़िम्मे के सारे खाते
definition: the set of accounts and revenue a salesperson manages
example: He guards his book of business like a dragon with a CRM login.

hindi: छोड़कर फिर लौटा कर्मचारी — अक्सर बेहतर वेतन पर
definition: someone who left the company and later returned, usually at a higher band
example: The boomerang employee got in eighteen months what loyalty never paid.

hindi: मैदान में मौजूदगी — मौक़े पर असल काम करते लोग
definition: people physically present doing the actual work
example: The dashboard says fine; boots on the ground disagree.

hindi: बिना निवेशकों के, अपनी कमाई और बचत से कंपनी खड़ी करना
definition: to build a company using personal savings and revenue instead of outside investors
example: We bootstrapped for four years before taking a single rupee of funding.

hindi: अड़चन — जहाँ काम अटककर धीमा हो जाता है
definition: the single point where work piles up and slows everything
example: Approvals are the bottleneck, not engineering.

hindi: शुद्ध लाभ — सारे ख़र्च के बाद बची असल कमाई
definition: net profit after all costs; also, the thing that finally matters
example: Free snacks vanished the moment the bottom line went red.

hindi: कीप का निचला हिस्सा — ख़रीद के क़रीब पहुँचे ग्राहक
definition: the late stage where prospects compare vendors and are ready to buy
example: Bottom of funnel content: the pricing page and a well-timed discount.

hindi: ईमेल लौट आना — डिलीवर न हो पाना
definition: to fail delivery and return to sender, as email does
example: My mail to the client bounced; someone check that address.

hindi: बाउंस दर — एक ही पेज देखकर लौट जाने वालों का प्रतिशत
definition: the share of visitors who leave after viewing a single page
example: The landing page bounce rate suggests the landing is the problem.

hindi: प्रतिभाशाली लोगों का संस्था छोड़कर जाना
definition: the exodus of skilled people, taking expertise with them
example: After the equity repricing, the brain drain emptied the senior bench.

hindi: विचार-मंथन करना — बिना रोक-टोक ढेर सारे विचार निकालना
definition: to generate many ideas quickly without judging them yet
example: We brainstormed forty names and shipped with the placeholder.

hindi: ब्रांड जागरूकता — लोगों को कंपनी का नाम पता होना
definition: how many people recognize your company exists, independent of buying anything
example: The billboard is for brand awareness, which is hard to measure and easy to invoice.

hindi: ब्रांड दिशानिर्देश — लोगो, रंग और आवाज़ के प्रयोग-नियम
definition: rules for using a company's logo, colors, and voice
example: Marketing rejected the mockup for violating brand guidelines, specifically the blue.

hindi: अभी लौटता हूँ — थोड़ी देर की दूरी
definition: be right back — briefly away from the keyboard
example: BRB, the doorbell and the deploy finished at the same time.

hindi: उल्लंघन — अनुबंध तोड़ना या डेटा में सेंध
definition: a violation of a contract, or unauthorized access to data
example: Legal asked if it's an 'incident' or a 'breach'; big difference.

hindi: पथ-सूत्र — पेज तक पहुँचने का रास्ता दिखाती कड़ियाँ
definition: the trail of links showing where you are in a site's hierarchy
example: Six levels deep, the breadcrumb is the only adult in the room.

hindi: बिल्ड तोड़ना — ऐसा बदलाव करना कि सबका काम रुक जाए
definition: to land a change that fails compilation or tests for everyone
example: He broke the build and left for lunch, a bold career move.

hindi: तोड़ने वाला बदलाव — जो मौजूदा उपयोग अचानक बिगाड़ दे
definition: a change that stops existing users or code from working
example: It's a minor release with one tiny breaking change, define minor.

hindi: उप-समूह चर्चा — बड़ी बैठक से निकला छोटा दल
definition: a small subgroup discussion split off from a larger session
example: Each breakout reports back with its top two ideas.

hindi: सम्मेलन-लाइन — समूह कॉल की साझा लाइन
definition: a shared conference line people join for a group call
example: Incident's open; everyone relevant is on the bridge.

hindi: पुल दौर — अगले पड़ाव तक पहुँचने के लिए छोटा अंतरिम निवेश
definition: a small interim raise meant to reach the next milestone or round
example: This is our second bridge round; the other side remains under construction.

hindi: सबको एक साथ संदेश — व्यापक घोषणा
definition: to send one message to everyone at once
example: We'll broadcast the maintenance window on Monday morning.

hindi: अपना टिफ़िन सत्र — लंच के साथ अनौपचारिक प्रस्तुति
definition: an informal talk held over a bring-your-own lunch
example: Her brown bag on debugging outdrew the all-hands.

hindi: पुरानी ज़मीन — मौजूदा पुराने सिस्टम की बाध्यताओं में होने वाला
definition: developed on top of an existing system, inheriting all its constraints and history
example: It's brownfield work: every change negotiates with code from 2011.

hindi: वैसे — बात-बात में एक और बात
definition: by the way — a side note smuggled into the conversation
example: BTW, the third-floor printer works again, allegedly.

hindi: बजट — किसी काम या अवधि के लिए तय ख़र्च सीमा
definition: the amount of money allocated for a team, project, or period
example: The budget covers the tool or the contractor, not both.

hindi: बजट रोक — नए ख़र्चों पर अस्थायी पाबंदी
definition: a temporary halt on new spending
example: The budget freeze arrived one day before my conference request.

hindi: अंतराल — बैठकों के बीच साँस भर की जगह
definition: a gap left between meetings to breathe, travel, or think
example: I keep a fifteen-minute buffer so my brain can change context.

hindi: बग बैश — सब मिलकर एक सत्र में दोष खोजना
definition: a group session where everyone hunts bugs in the same build
example: The bug bash found forty issues, three of them new.

hindi: संस्करण बढ़ाना — वर्ज़न नंबर एक पायदान ऊपर करना
definition: to increment a version number, often the entire change
example: The commit just bumps the version; the courage is implied.

hindi: इसे फिर ऊपर ला रहा हूँ — अनदेखे की याद
definition: the standalone message that lifts an ignored request back to the top
example: Bumping this; still blocked on the access request.

hindi: पूँजी खर्च की रफ़्तार — कंपनी हर महीने कितना पैसा जला रही है
definition: the speed at which a company spends its cash, usually measured monthly
example: Our burn rate doubled the month we hired three VPs.

hindi: बर्नडाउन चार्ट — बचे काम को समय के साथ घटते दिखाता ग्राफ
definition: a graph of remaining work versus time, ideally sloping to zero
example: Our burndown chart is flat, which is one kind of consistency.

hindi: लगातार काम के तनाव से पूरी थकान — शरीर और मन दोनों की
definition: exhaustion and detachment from prolonged unmanaged work stress
example: The wellness webinar on burnout was scheduled over lunch.

hindi: बर्नअप चार्ट — पूर्ण कार्य और कुल दायरा दिखाता ग्राफ
definition: a graph of completed work climbing toward total scope, which keeps climbing too
example: The burnup chart shows scope growing faster than progress.

hindi: बस फ़ैक्टर — कितने लोगों के जाते ही प्रोजेक्ट ठप हो जाए
definition: how many people could be hit by a bus before the project stalls
example: Our bus factor is one, and that one is on vacation.

hindi: व्यावसायिक औचित्य — ख़र्च के पक्ष में तर्क और आँकड़े
definition: the justification, with numbers, for spending money on something
example: Write the business case; 'it's cool' isn't a column in Excel.

hindi: सहमति — योजना के लिए लोगों की रज़ामंदी और साथ
definition: agreement and support from the people you need
example: Without engineering buy-in, the roadmap is fan fiction.

hindi: ख़रीदार का काल्पनिक चित्रण — मार्केटिंग योजना के लिए
definition: a fictional profile of a typical buyer, complete with invented name and worries
example: Meet 'Ops Manager Priya,' a persona who somehow reads all our emails.

hindi: ग्राहक अधिग्रहण लागत — एक ग्राहक जोड़ने का औसत खर्च
definition: customer acquisition cost; what you spend to win one customer
example: Our CAC assumes the founder's time is free, which it is not.

hindi: लय — बैठकों या रिलीज़ की नियमित आवृत्ति
definition: the regular rhythm of meetings, releases, or reports
example: We meet on a weekly cadence to discuss the biweekly cadence.

hindi: चक्रवृद्धि वार्षिक वृद्धि दर — कई सालों की औसत सालाना बढ़त
definition: compound annual growth rate over multiple years
example: The five-year CAGR looks smooth; the five years were not.

hindi: कैलेंडर-लेखा — बेकार बैठकों की छँटाई
definition: reviewing recurring meetings and cutting the ones that earn nothing
example: A calendar audit freed six hours; nobody noticed the deletions.

hindi: कैलेंडर आमंत्रण — बैठक जोड़ने का निमंत्रण
definition: the scheduling request that puts a meeting on people's calendars
example: If there's no calendar invite, the decision didn't happen.

hindi: कैलेंडर की जोड़-तोड़ — व्यस्त समयों में बैठक फिट करना
definition: the puzzle of fitting meetings into everyone's packed calendars
example: Finding an hour for six people is pure calendar Tetris.

hindi: प्रबंधकों की बंद बैठक जहाँ रेटिंग आपस में तय होती है
definition: the closed-door meeting where managers align ratings across teams
example: Her rating changed in calibration, in a room she wasn't in.

hindi: क्रिया-आह्वान — उपयोगकर्ता से अगला कदम कराने वाला बटन या संदेश
definition: the button or line that tells users what to do next
example: The page has six calls to action, so effectively none.

hindi: कैमरा बंद — बिना वीडियो कॉल में शामिल
definition: attending a video call without video enabled
example: I'm camera off today; the haircut needs another day.

hindi: कैमरा-चालू संस्कृति — कॉल पर वीडियो की अपेक्षा
definition: a workplace norm expecting video enabled on calls
example: Camera-on culture met its match on Friday afternoons.

hindi: मुसीबतों का पिटारा — छेड़ते ही उलझनें निकलने वाला मुद्दा
definition: an issue that unleashes endless complications once opened
example: Asking who owns that database opened a can of worms.

hindi: कैनरी रिलीज़ — पहले थोड़े उपयोगकर्ताओं पर आज़माई गई
definition: a release sent to a small slice of users first to catch problems early
example: The canary died at 2%, rollback initiated.

hindi: स्वामित्व तालिका — कंपनी में किसका कितना हिस्सा है
definition: the ledger of who owns what percentage of a company
example: The cap table has more names than our customer list.

hindi: क्षमता — टीम के पास उपलब्ध वास्तविक कार्य-समय
definition: how much work a team can actually take on in a period
example: We have capacity for this, assuming nobody takes vacation or breathes.

hindi: क्षमता नियोजन — उपलब्ध समय से काम का मिलान
definition: matching planned work against the hours a team realistically has
example: Capacity planning assumes forty focused hours; the calendar disagrees.

hindi: पूंजीगत ख़र्च — दीर्घकालिक संपत्ति पर एकमुश्त निवेश
definition: capital expenditure; big one-time spending on long-lived assets
example: Buying our own servers is capex nobody wants to defend.

hindi: कार्ड वर्गीकरण अभ्यास — उपयोगकर्ता से सामग्री समूहबद्ध करवाने की शोध-विधि
definition: a research method where users group topics into categories that make sense
example: The card sort proved users don't think in our org chart.

hindi: पदोन्नति की सीढ़ी — स्तर-दर-स्तर अपेक्षाओं का ढांचा
definition: the documented progression of levels and expectations in a role
example: The career ladder has eight rungs and a wait list.

hindi: अंधानुकरण — बिना समझे रस्में दोहराना कि शायद काम करें
definition: copying practices ritually without understanding why they worked elsewhere
example: We adopted their whole setup cargo-cult style, microservices and all.

hindi: मुनाफ़े में हिस्सा — फ़ंड की कमाई से VC साझेदारों का अंश
definition: carried interest; the share of fund profits that VC partners keep
example: Carry is why partners smile at exits and shrug at salaries.

hindi: शेष कार्य — पिछले स्प्रिंट से अगले में लुढ़का काम
definition: work that rolls from one sprint into the next, unfinished
example: This story is carry-over from three sprints ago; it commutes.

hindi: अलग निकालना — समय, बजट या दायरे का हिस्सा सुरक्षित रखना
definition: to reserve a portion of time, budget, or scope
example: Carve out two hours weekly for the work meetings displaced.

hindi: नीचे तक पहुँचाना — जानकारी क्रमवार टीमों तक भेजना
definition: to pass information down the org chart, level by level
example: Please cascade the new policy to your teams by Friday.

hindi: ग्राहक सफलता की कहानी — आँकड़ों समेत विस्तृत उदाहरण
definition: a marketing story showing how a customer used the product and got results
example: Every case study ends in '40% improvement,' regardless of what was measured.

hindi: श्रेणी निर्माण — नया बाज़ार वर्ग गढ़कर उसका अगुवा बनना
definition: inventing and naming a new market category so you can lead it
example: We're not losing to competitors; we're doing category creation, says marketing.

hindi: प्रतिलिपि में जोड़ना — जानकारी के लिए साथ रखना
definition: to copy someone on an email so they see it without being addressed
example: Cc my manager so nobody asks for proof later.

hindi: केंद्रीकृत करना — नियंत्रण या काम एक जगह समेटना
definition: to gather control or functions into one place
example: They centralized purchasing, and now pencils take a quarter.

hindi: अनुष्ठान — स्क्रम की नियत बैठकों में से एक
definition: any of scrum's recurring meetings, named without irony
example: Four ceremonies per sprint, attendance devout, faith varying.

hindi: विचार-शृंखला — अंतिम उत्तर से पहले क़दम-दर-क़दम तर्क लिखवाना
definition: prompting a model to show its step-by-step reasoning before the final answer
example: Ask for chain of thought and suddenly the calorie math almost adds up.

hindi: पैरवी करना — किसी विचार का खुलकर समर्थन करना
definition: to publicly back an idea and push it through resistance
example: She championed the accessibility work until it finally shipped.

hindi: परिवर्तन अनुरोध — तय दायरे में औपचारिक बदलाव की माँग
definition: a formal ask to alter agreed scope, schedule, or budget
example: That tiny tweak is a change request; here's form CR-114.

hindi: बदलाव-सूची — हर रिलीज़ में क्या बदला, उसका बहीखाता
definition: the file recording what changed in each release
example: The changelog says 'minor fixes'; the diff says 12,000 lines.

hindi: साझा चैट कक्ष — एक विषय की जगह
definition: a shared chat space organized around one topic, in theory
example: Take the lunch debate to the random channel, please.

hindi: अराजकता अभियांत्रिकी — जानबूझकर तोड़कर मज़बूती परखना
definition: deliberately breaking production to prove the system survives failures
example: Chaos engineering, or as finance calls it, self-inflicted outages.

hindi: पीछे पड़कर जवाब माँगना — बार-बार तक़ाज़ा
definition: to repeatedly follow up until someone finally responds
example: I'll chase finance about the reimbursement again on Monday.

hindi: चैटबॉट — उपयोगकर्ताओं से लिखित बातचीत करने वाला प्रोग्राम
definition: a program that converses with users by text, now usually LLM-powered
example: The chatbot handles password resets so humans can handle actual feelings.

hindi: हालचाल बैठक — प्रगति जानने की छोटी मुलाक़ात
definition: a brief meeting or message to see how things are going
example: Just a quick check-in: any blockers on the migration?

hindi: चुनिंदा उठाना — किसी शाखा से एक ख़ास कमिट ही लेना
definition: to copy one specific commit onto another branch, leaving the rest behind
example: Just cherry-pick the fix, not the seventeen commits around it.

hindi: चेस्टरटन की बाड़ — जब तक वजह न समझो, हटाओ मत
definition: the principle of never removing something until you know why it was put there
example: He deleted the weird check; Chesterton's fence and prod explained why it existed.

hindi: मुर्गी-अंडा समस्या — विक्रेता बिना ख़रीदार नहीं, ख़रीदार बिना विक्रेता नहीं
definition: a marketplace dilemma where sellers wait for buyers and buyers wait for sellers
example: We solved the chicken-and-egg problem by paying the chickens, briefly.

hindi: ग्राहक-छीजन — उपयोगकर्ताओं का सेवा छोड़ते जाना
definition: the loss of customers who stop using or paying
example: Churn is our fastest-growing metric, which is the wrong kind of growth.

hindi: छीजन दर — किसी अवधि में सेवा छोड़ने वालों का प्रतिशत
definition: the percentage of customers lost over a given period
example: The churn rate is five percent monthly, described internally as sturdy.

hindi: ग्राहक छूटने का ख़तरा — नवीनीकरण न होने की आशंका
definition: the likelihood a customer will cancel instead of renewing
example: They asked how to export all their data; the CSM logged it as churn risk.

hindi: बाद में लौटना — बिना फ़ैसला किए चर्चा टालने का विनम्र तरीक़ा
definition: to return to a topic later; often a polite way to end a discussion without deciding
example: Let's circle back next week — and it was never spoken of again.

hindi: वर्गीकारक — इनपुट को श्रेणियों में बाँटने वाला मॉडल
definition: a model that sorts inputs into categories rather than generating text
example: A tiny classifier decides squat versus deadlift before the fancy models wake up.

hindi: धारा/खंड — अनुबंध का एक विशेष प्रावधान
definition: a specific provision within a contract
example: There's a clause saying they own everything we sketch on napkins.

hindi: वेस्टिंग की पहली सीमा — आमतौर पर एक साल, उससे पहले कुछ नहीं
definition: the first vesting milestone, typically one year, before which you get nothing
example: The layoff came three weeks before her cliff, coincidentally.

hindi: सौदा पक्का करना — ग्राहक से हस्ताक्षर तक पहुँचना
definition: to get a prospect to sign and become a customer
example: He can close anything except his forty-seven browser tabs.

hindi: बात पूरी करना — सबको नतीजा बताकर सिलसिला ख़त्म करना
definition: to follow up so everyone involved knows the outcome
example: Close the loop with support once the fix ships.

hindi: हारा हुआ सौदा — ग्राहक ने मना कर दिया
definition: marked as a deal that died; usually blamed on pricing, timing, or gravity
example: Closed-lost reason: 'went with competitor.' Actual reason: nobody followed up for six weeks.

hindi: जीता हुआ सौदा — ग्राहक ने हस्ताक्षर कर दिए
definition: marked as a deal that signed; the happiest status in the CRM
example: She rang the gong for every closed-won deal, so we moved the gong.

hindi: सह-संस्थापक — साथ मिलकर कंपनी शुरू करने वाला साझेदार
definition: a partner who starts the company alongside you and shares the risk
example: Choosing a co-founder is like marriage, but the divorce needs a cap table.

hindi: कार्य दिवस की समाप्ति तक — दफ़्तरी शाम की मियाद
definition: close of business — end of the working day, formally dressed
example: Legal needs the signatures by COB Thursday.

hindi: कोड पुरातत्व — पुराने कोड की परतें खोदकर इतिहास समझना
definition: excavating old code and history to understand why things are the way they are
example: Code archaeology found the answer: a 2013 commit titled 'temporary'.

hindi: कोड फ़्रीज़ — रिलीज़ से पहले बदलावों पर रोक
definition: a period before release when no new changes may land
example: The code freeze starts Monday, so everything is merging tonight.

hindi: कोड गोल्फ़ — कम-से-कम अक्षरों में समाधान लिखने का खेल
definition: the sport of solving a problem in the fewest possible characters
example: Nice code golf; now write the readable version for the rest of us.

hindi: कोड मज़दूर — बिना सोच-विचार सौंपे टुकड़े टाइप करने वाला (स्व-व्यंग्य)
definition: self-deprecating term for a developer treated as a typing machine, not a thinker
example: Requirements final, no questions, code monkey just types.

hindi: कोड समीक्षा — मर्ज से पहले सहकर्मी की जाँच
definition: peer inspection of a change before it merges
example: The code review had one comment: LGTM. It was 4,000 lines.

hindi: कोड की बदबू — गहरी गड़बड़ी का सतही संकेत
definition: a surface symptom in code that hints at a deeper design problem
example: A 900-line function is not a code smell, it's a code stench.

hindi: हाज़िरी-कॉफ़ी — दफ़्तर छूकर निकल लेना
definition: badging into the office briefly, then leaving to work elsewhere
example: Anchor days created a coffee badging economy by 10 a.m.

hindi: कॉफ़ी वार्ता — परिचय बढ़ाने की अनौपचारिक गपशप
definition: an informal get-to-know-you conversation over coffee
example: Set up a coffee chat with the new designer this week.

hindi: संज्ञानात्मक भार — स्क्रीन समझने में लगने वाली मानसिक मेहनत
definition: the mental effort a design demands from its user
example: Nine badges, three banners, one popup: the cognitive load is the feature.

hindi: समूह — एक ही समय या तरीके से जुड़े उपयोगकर्ताओं का बैच
definition: a group of users bundled by start date or behavior for comparison
example: The January cohort still loves us; February never really did.

hindi: बिना पूर्व परिचय फ़ोन — अनजान संभावित ग्राहक को सीधा कॉल
definition: an unsolicited sales phone call to someone who has never heard of you
example: Twenty cold calls, nineteen voicemails, one wrong number — a solid Tuesday.

hindi: बिना परिचय भेजा ईमेल — अनजान संभावित ग्राहक को
definition: an unsolicited sales email to a stranger, ideally personalized beyond their first name
example: His cold email opened with 'Hope you're well' and closed with a calendar link.

hindi: शीत आरंभ — नए उपयोगकर्ता का डेटा न होने से सिफ़ारिशों की मुश्किल
definition: the struggle to serve good predictions for brand-new users or items with no data
example: Day-one users get the cold start special: three generic workouts and a questionnaire.

hindi: ठंडी शुरुआत की समस्या — बिना उपयोगकर्ताओं के उत्पाद बेकार लगना
definition: the struggle of launching a product that is only useful once many people use it
example: The cold start problem, explained: our chat app has three users, all employees.

hindi: बिक्री सामग्री — ब्रोशर, डेक और परिचय दस्तावेज़
definition: the decks, one-pagers, and brochures sales leaves behind with prospects
example: The rep asked for updated collateral, meaning the deck from before the rebrand.

hindi: सह-स्थित — एक ही दफ़्तर में साथ
definition: working physically together in the same office
example: The pilot team is colocated; everyone else joins the stream.

hindi: बिक्री पर कमीशन — सौदे के अनुपात में कमाई
definition: the percentage of a deal's value paid to the salesperson who closed it
example: Nothing focuses the mind like commission on a seven-figure deal.

hindi: वचनबद्ध होना — तयशुदा काम देने का ज़िम्मा लेना
definition: to formally promise to deliver something
example: We committed to the date before scoping the work. Classic.

hindi: आना-जाना — घर से दफ़्तर की यात्रा
definition: the trip between home and the office
example: My commute is thirty steps; the office pays in trains.

hindi: वेतन-पैकेज — तनख्वाह, बोनस और इक्विटी का कुल
definition: compensation; shorthand for everything a job pays you
example: The mission is inspiring, but let's discuss comp.

hindi: निर्णायक घटना — जो ख़रीद को टालने न दे
definition: a deadline or trigger forcing the customer to buy now rather than someday
example: No compelling event, no deal — 'someday' is not a close date.

hindi: प्रतिस्पर्धी जानकारी — प्रतिद्वंद्वियों की गतिविधि की ख़बर
definition: gathered knowledge about competitors' products, pricing, and moves
example: Competitive intel: their changelog, their job postings, and one very chatty prospect.

hindi: अनुपालन — नियम-क़ानूनों के मुताबिक़ चलना
definition: conforming to laws, regulations, and internal policies
example: Compliance says the spreadsheet of passwords has to go.

hindi: घटक पुस्तकालय — तैयार UI हिस्सों का साझा संग्रह
definition: a collection of prebuilt UI pieces teams assemble screens from
example: Check the component library before building yet another custom dropdown.

hindi: अभिकलन क्षमता — मॉडल चलाने की प्रोसेसिंग ताक़त, यानी बड़ा ख़र्च
definition: processing power for training and running models, usually measured in money
example: The new feature is approved pending compute; so, approved in spirit.

hindi: कंप्यूटर दृष्टि — चित्रों और वीडियो को समझने वाला एआई
definition: AI that understands images and video — detecting objects, people, and movement
example: Computer vision counts your reps through the front camera, judgment included at no charge.

hindi: विश्वास अंतराल — असली मान जिस दायरे में होने की संभावना है
definition: the range within which the true value plausibly falls
example: The confidence interval includes zero, which the summary slide omits.

hindi: विश्वास अंक — मॉडल अपने अनुमान पर कितना आश्वस्त है, उसका मान
definition: a number showing how sure a model is about its own prediction
example: It labeled the movement 'burpee, probably' with a confidence score of 0.51.

hindi: एकीकृत करना — बिखरी चीज़ों को मिलाकर एक करना
definition: to merge scattered things into one
example: We consolidated nine dashboards into one nobody opens.

hindi: बंधन — डिज़ाइन को दिशा देने वाली उपयोगी सीमा
definition: a limitation that shapes, and often improves, the design
example: The best feature of the deadline is that it's a constraint.

hindi: सलाहकार — फ़ीस लेकर विशेषज्ञ राय देने वाला बाहरी व्यक्ति
definition: an external expert hired to advise, famously at high rates
example: The consultant's deck recommended everything we said last year.

hindi: सामग्री द्वारा प्रचार — उपयोगी लेखों से ग्राहक खींचना
definition: publishing useful content to attract buyers instead of interrupting them with ads
example: Content marketing: a blog post about spreadsheets that ends in a demo link.

hindi: सामग्री निगरानी — हानिकारक या अनुचित सामग्री को छानकर रोकना
definition: filtering harmful or inappropriate content from what users and models produce
example: Content moderation caught the gym-selfie captions before they reached the community feed.

hindi: संदर्भ अभियांत्रिकी — मॉडल को दिखने वाली हर जानकारी की सोची-समझी व्यवस्था
definition: designing everything a model sees — instructions, documents, history — not just the prompt
example: Prompt engineering is out; context engineering is the same job with a better title.

hindi: संदर्भ-बदलाव — कामों के बीच कूदने की मानसिक लागत
definition: the mental cost of jumping between unrelated tasks or meetings
example: Four ten-minute gaps aren't focus time; they're context switching.

hindi: संदर्भ खिड़की — मॉडल एक बार में जितना पाठ ध्यान में रख सकता है
definition: the maximum amount of text a model can consider at one time
example: The chat history blew past the context window, so it forgot your knee injury.

hindi: अनुबंध — क़ानूनी रूप से बाध्यकारी लिखित समझौता
definition: a legally binding agreement between parties
example: It's in the contract, which nobody read until it mattered.

hindi: अनुबंधित कर्मी — वेतनभोगी नहीं, अनुबंध पर काम करने वाला
definition: a non-employee hired on contract for specific work
example: The contractor ships faster than half the full-time team.

hindi: योगदान मार्जिन — प्रति बिक्री, परिवर्तनीय लागत घटाकर बची कमाई
definition: revenue per sale minus its variable costs
example: Contribution margin is positive, excluding the discounts that made the sale.

hindi: नियंत्रण समूह — जिन्हें बदलाव नहीं दिखता, तुलना के लिए
definition: the users who see no change, providing the comparison baseline
example: The control group outperformed the feature, which nobody put on the slide.

hindi: रूपांतरण — विज़िटर का ग्राहक या इच्छित कार्य में बदल जाना
definition: a user completing the action you wanted, like signing up or paying
example: We celebrate every conversion; there is time, there are so few.

hindi: रूपांतरण दर — इच्छित कार्य पूरा करने वालों का प्रतिशत
definition: the percentage of users who complete a desired action
example: The conversion rate improved after we removed the survey about conversion.

hindi: परिवर्तनीय ऋणपत्र — बाद के दौर में शेयरों में बदलने वाला क़र्ज़
definition: a loan that converts into equity at a future priced round
example: The convertible note kept us alive until the Series A priced it.

hindi: कॉनवे का नियम — सिस्टम का ढाँचा संगठन के ढाँचे की नक़ल करता है
definition: systems mirror the communication structure of the organizations that build them
example: Four teams, four half-compatible APIs, Conway's law undefeated.

hindi: तालमेल बिठाना — लोगों और कामों को एक सुर में लाना
definition: to organize people and moving parts toward one outcome
example: Someone must coordinate the launch across four teams and two continents.

hindi: सह-चालक — इंसान के साथ काम करता, सुझाव देता एआई सहायक
definition: an AI assistant that works alongside a person, suggesting rather than replacing
example: The copilot drafts the training plan; the human coach still takes the blame.

hindi: कॉपी-पेस्ट कोड — बिना समझे चिपकाया दोहराव भरा कोड
definition: code duplicated by paste, bugs included, understanding not included
example: The same bug fixed in four places, thanks, copy-pasta.

hindi: मूल दक्षता — संस्था की सबसे मज़बूत क़ाबिलियत
definition: what an organization is genuinely best at
example: Payments is our core competency; the chatbot was a detour.

hindi: मुख्य घंटे — जब सबका उपलब्ध रहना तय है
definition: agreed hours when everyone is reachable for collaboration
example: Outside core hours, expect answers tomorrow, not tonight.

hindi: सह-संबंध बनाम कारण — साथ-साथ बदलना वजह होना नहीं है
definition: the reminder that two metrics moving together proves nothing
example: Ice cream sales track our churn; correlation versus causation, hopefully.

hindi: लागत केंद्र — ऐसा विभाग जो कमाता नहीं, सिर्फ़ ख़र्च करता है
definition: a department that spends money without directly generating revenue
example: Call us a cost center again and watch the servers go down.

hindi: ईमेल से काम चल जाता — बेवजह बुलाई बैठक पर कटाक्ष
definition: said of a meeting that added nothing beyond its written summary
example: Forty minutes, no decisions: that could have been an email.

hindi: क़ानूनी सलाहकार — कंपनी के वकील
definition: the company's lawyers, as in 'check with counsel'
example: Run the scraper idea past counsel before you run the scraper.

hindi: प्रति-मापदंड — मुख्य आँकड़े के दुरुपयोग को पकड़ने वाला जोड़ीदार आँकड़ा
definition: a paired metric that catches the damage of over-optimizing the main one
example: Clicks went up; the counter metric noticed the clickbait.

hindi: इस्तीफे पर रोकने के लिए मौजूदा कंपनी का बेहतर प्रस्ताव
definition: a raise your employer suddenly finds when you try to resign
example: The counteroffer matched the new salary he'd been denied at review time.

hindi: काउबॉय कोडिंग — नियम-प्रक्रिया दरकिनार, सीधे बदलाव ठोकना
definition: coding without process, review, or fear, changes ride straight to production
example: Cowboy coding on prod again, at least wear the hat.

hindi: शिल्प-कौशल — बारीकियों में झलकने वाली कारीगरी
definition: the care and skill visible in a product's details
example: You can feel the craft in this screen and the deadline in the next.

hindi: समालोचना सत्र — साथियों से डिज़ाइन पर खुली, बेबाक राय
definition: a structured session where designers get candid feedback from peers
example: Bring thick skin to crit; the feedback is about the work, mostly.

hindi: क्रांतिक पथ — कार्यों की वह शृंखला जो कुल अवधि तय करती है
definition: the chain of dependent tasks that determines the project's minimum duration
example: Design review is on the critical path, so everyone suddenly cares.

hindi: ग्राहक-संबंध प्रबंधन सॉफ़्टवेयर — संपर्कों और सौदों का रिकॉर्ड
definition: customer relationship management software — the database of every contact, deal, and broken promise
example: If it's not in the CRM, it didn't happen; it's not in the CRM.

hindi: बहु-विभागीय — कई विभागों के लोगों से बना
definition: involving people from multiple departments
example: The cross-functional team agreed on everything except everything.

hindi: संबंधित उत्पाद बेचना — मौजूदा ग्राहक को दूसरा उत्पाद
definition: to sell an existing customer a different product from the one they already use
example: They came for the analytics tool; we cross-sold the dashboard nobody asked for.

hindi: क्रंच — डेडलाइन से पहले लंबी थकाऊ काम की अवधि
definition: an intense stretch of long hours before a deadline
example: We avoid crunch by planning, and by lowering our definition of avoid.

hindi: ग्राहक संतुष्टि स्कोर — सेवा से खुशी नापने वाला सर्वे-पैमाना
definition: customer satisfaction score, usually from a quick post-interaction survey
example: CSAT is high among customers who answer surveys, a famously chill group.

hindi: ग्राहक सफलता प्रबंधक — ग्राहक को संतुष्ट और जुड़ा रखने वाला
definition: customer success manager — the person assigned to keep customers happy and renewing
example: Our CSM knows their org chart better than they do.

hindi: क्रिया-आह्वान का संक्षिप्त रूप — क्लिक कराने वाला मुख्य बटन
definition: short for call to action, the click you want most
example: The feedback is always 'make the CTA bigger', every single time.

hindi: क्लिक-थ्रू दर — देखने वालों में से क्लिक करने वालों का प्रतिशत
definition: click-through rate; clicks divided by impressions
example: The CTR doubled when we made the button say free.

hindi: संस्कृति में नयापन लाने वाला उम्मीदवार — फिट का सुधरा रूप
definition: hiring for what someone brings to the culture, not resemblance to it
example: We hire for culture add now, says the panel of five identical hoodies.

hindi: कंपनी की संस्कृति से मेल — कई बार 'हम जैसे लोग' का पर्दा
definition: how well a candidate matches company culture; sometimes code for 'similar to us'
example: Rejected for culture fit, which no one could define when asked.

hindi: ग्राहक सफलता विभाग — ग्राहक को उत्पाद से फ़ायदा दिलाना
definition: the team that helps customers get value so they renew instead of leaving
example: Customer success called it a partnership check-in; the customer called it a sales call.

hindi: कटओवर — पुरानी प्रणाली से नई पर स्विच करने का क्षण
definition: the moment of switching from the old system to the new one
example: Cutover is Saturday 2 a.m., attendance mandatory, sleep optional.

hindi: चक्र समय — काम शुरू से पूर्ण होने तक की अवधि
definition: how long an item takes from started to done
example: Our cycle time is nine days, eight of which are waiting.

hindi: गुप्त लॉन्च — फ़ीचर चुपचाप चालू कर असली ट्रैफ़िक पर परखना
definition: releasing a feature silently to real traffic before announcing it
example: It's been dark launched for a month; users just haven't noticed.

hindi: गहरे रंग की थीम — काली पृष्ठभूमि वाला रूप
definition: a dark color scheme, easier on eyes and batteries
example: Users demanded dark mode for two years; it shipped and broke every illustration.

hindi: छलपूर्ण डिज़ाइन — उपयोगकर्ता को अनचाहे काम की ओर धकेलने वाला इंटरफ़ेस
definition: an interface design that tricks users into doing things they didn't intend
example: Hiding the cancel button behind three menus is a dark pattern, not retention.

hindi: डैशबोर्ड — मुख्य आँकड़ों को एक जगह दिखाने वाला पैनल
definition: a single screen collecting the charts a team watches
example: We built a dashboard to track how often we check dashboards.

hindi: डेटा चक्र — उपयोग से डेटा, डेटा से बेहतर मॉडल, फिर और उपयोग
definition: a loop where product usage generates data that improves the model, attracting more usage
example: Every logged workout feeds the data flywheel; the coach gets smarter as you sweat.

hindi: डेटा अंकन — कच्चे डेटा पर सही उत्तर चिपकाने का काम
definition: tagging raw data with correct answers so models can learn from it
example: Data labeling week: watch a thousand squat videos and mark which ones hurt.

hindi: डेटा बिंदु — एक अकेला माप या उदाहरण
definition: a single measurement, or one example doing the job of many
example: Interesting data point, we say, meaning we will forget it by lunch.

hindi: डेटा विषाक्तता — प्रशिक्षण डेटा बिगाड़कर मॉडल को ग़लत सिखाना
definition: corrupting training data so a model learns wrong or malicious behavior
example: Someone bulk-logged fake workouts; call it data poisoning or call it cheating.

hindi: दस्तावेज़ कक्ष — जाँच के लिए निवेशकों से साझा गोपनीय फ़ाइलें
definition: a secure folder of company documents shared with investors during diligence
example: The data room is ready; please ignore the folder named 'misc_final_v7.'

hindi: डेटा-चालित — फैसले राय से नहीं, आँकड़ों से लेना
definition: making decisions primarily from data rather than opinion
example: We are data-driven, except when the data disagrees with the roadmap.

hindi: डेटा-सूचित — आँकड़े देखकर, पर अंतिम निर्णय समझ से
definition: using data as one input while leaving room for judgment
example: Data-informed means we read the dashboard and then did what we wanted.

hindi: दैनिक सक्रिय उपयोगकर्ता — एक दिन में उत्पाद चलाने वाले लोग
definition: daily active users; unique people who use the product in a day
example: DAU spiked Monday, mostly people trying to cancel.

hindi: जोखिम घटाना — विफलता की आशंका पहले से कम करना
definition: to reduce a project's chance of failure by tackling the scary parts early
example: We'll de-risk the migration with a spike before committing.

hindi: मृत कोड — कभी न चलने वाला पर फिर भी पड़ा हुआ
definition: code that can never execute yet still lives in the repository
example: Half the file is dead code everyone is afraid to bury.

hindi: अंतिम तिथि — काम पूरा होने की नियत तारीख़
definition: the date work is due, and the reason it eventually happens
example: The deadline moved twice, so now we call it a window.

hindi: सौदों की धारा — निवेशक के पास आने वाले प्रस्तावों का प्रवाह
definition: the stream of investment opportunities a VC sees
example: Half their deal flow is warm intros; the other half is LinkedIn optimism.

hindi: सौदे का आकार — एक अनुबंध की कुल क़ीमत
definition: the monetary value of a single deal
example: Average deal size doubled once we stopped leading with the discount.

hindi: थकान-यात्रा — विफलता की ओर बढ़ती अंतहीन क्रंच परियोजना
definition: a doomed project kept alive by ever-longer hours and ever-lower morale
example: It's not a death march; the snacks are still good.

hindi: समीक्षा बैठक — घटना के बाद क्या-क्यों की चर्चा
definition: a meeting after an event to review what happened and why
example: Quick debrief after the client call to compare notes.

hindi: दस अरब डॉलर से अधिक मूल्य वाला निजी स्टार्टअप
definition: a private startup valued at ten billion dollars or more
example: Once you're a decacorn, analysts start asking when the IPO is.

hindi: विकेंद्रीकृत करना — निर्णय-अधिकार टीमों में बाँटना
definition: to push decisions and control out to individual teams
example: We decentralized decisions, then centralized them at the first mistake.

hindi: निर्णयकर्ता — जिसके पास ख़रीद की अंतिम मंज़ूरी हो
definition: the person with actual authority to approve the purchase
example: Six great meetings later, we finally met the decision maker: the CFO.

hindi: प्रेज़ेंटेशन — स्लाइडों का सेट
definition: a slide presentation; where strategy goes to be admired
example: The strategy is done; now we just need the deck.

hindi: आमंत्रण अस्वीकारना — मीटिंग का न्योता ठुकराना
definition: to reject a meeting invitation, ideally with a reason
example: Feel free to decline if the agenda doesn't need you.

hindi: गहन पड़ताल — किसी विषय की विस्तृत जाँच
definition: a thorough examination of a topic, promised more often than delivered
example: We'll do a deep dive on the drop-off numbers next quarter.

hindi: गहन प्रौद्योगिकी — विज्ञान की खोजों पर टिका स्टार्टअप, सिर्फ़ ऐप नहीं
definition: startups built on hard science or engineering breakthroughs, not just software
example: Deep tech means the demo is impressive and the timeline is geological.

hindi: गहन कार्य — बिना विघ्न लंबी एकाग्रता
definition: long, distraction-free concentration on cognitively demanding tasks
example: Real deep work needs mornings, not the gaps between meetings.

hindi: डीपफ़ेक — असली व्यक्ति की हूबहू नक़ली ऑडियो-वीडियो
definition: synthetic audio or video realistically impersonating a real person
example: Security training now includes spotting a deepfake of your CEO asking for gift cards.

hindi: स्वतः जीवित — मौजूदा पूँजी से ही मुनाफ़े तक पहुँचने की राह पर
definition: on track to reach profitability with current cash, no new funding needed
example: The CFO confirmed we're default alive, and everyone exhaled at once.

hindi: स्वतः मृत — बिना नए निवेश के मुनाफ़े तक न पहुँच पाना
definition: unable to reach profitability with current cash, dependent on future fundraising
example: Default dead isn't a mood, the CEO said, it's a spreadsheet.

hindi: रक्षण क्षमता — कारोबार की नक़ल कर पाना कितना कठिन है
definition: how hard a business is to copy or compete away
example: The investor's only question was defensibility; our answer was a longer pause.

hindi: स्थगित करना — निर्णय या काम बाद के लिए टालना
definition: to postpone a decision or task to later
example: Let's defer that to next quarter, the land of infinite capacity.

hindi: पूर्णता की परिभाषा — काम कब सचमुच पूरा माना जाए, उसकी साझा शर्तें
definition: the agreed checklist a task must satisfy before it truly counts as complete
example: By our definition of done, this is definition of almost.

hindi: तैयारी की परिभाषा — कार्य शुरू करने लायक कब है, उसकी शर्तें
definition: the criteria a backlog item must meet before a team will start it
example: It fails the definition of ready, so back to refinement it goes.

hindi: विविधता, समानता और समावेश की संगठनात्मक पहल
definition: diversity, equity, and inclusion; programs aimed at fairer workplaces
example: The DEI report shipped annually; the numbers moved slower.

hindi: प्रबंधन की परतें हटाना — मैनेजरों की छँटनी का सौम्य नाम
definition: removing management layers; layoffs aimed specifically at managers
example: Delayering flattened the org and twelve careers.

hindi: काम सौंपना — ज़िम्मेदारी किसी और को देना
definition: to hand a task and its responsibility to someone else
example: She delegates so well her calendar is a rumor.

hindi: ऊपर काम सरकाना — अपना काम मैनेजर के पाले में डालना
definition: to push your task onto your manager, the reverse of delegation
example: Asking the VP to draft the email is delegating up, champ.

hindi: आनंद-अनुभूति — अपेक्षा से बढ़कर खुश कर देने वाला अनुभव
definition: the small joy a product sparks by exceeding expectations
example: Confetti on task completion: delight to some, clutter to others.

hindi: प्रसन्नकारक — अनपेक्षित खुशी देने वाली छोटी खूबी
definition: an unexpected touch that charms users without being required
example: The delighter budget died in Q3, along with the animations.

hindi: नतीजा देना — वादा किया काम पूरा कर दिखाना
definition: to produce the promised result
example: Miss the party, attend the meeting, deliver the feature.

hindi: पहुँच-योग्यता — ईमेल का स्पैम नहीं, इनबॉक्स तक पहुँचना
definition: the ability of email to actually reach inboxes instead of spam
example: Marketing broke deliverability, so our invoices live in spam now.

hindi: सुपुर्दगी योग्य वस्तु — तय तिथि पर सौंपा जाने वाला ठोस परिणाम
definition: a tangible piece of work owed to someone by an agreed date
example: The deliverable is a deck about the deliverable.

hindi: अंतर — दो मापों के बीच का फर्क
definition: the difference between two measurements
example: The delta between forecast and reality has its own line item now.

hindi: माँग सृजन — ख़रीद-इच्छा पैदा करने वाली मार्केटिंग
definition: demand generation — marketing programs that create interest and pipeline, not just clicks
example: Demand gen swears the webinar sourced that deal; sales remembers it differently.

hindi: प्रदर्शन — बना हुआ काम जीवंत दिखाना
definition: a live showing of working software, powered by adrenaline and luck
example: It worked in every rehearsal, so naturally the demo gods struck.

hindi: प्रदर्शन दिवस — एक्सेलेरेटर के स्टार्टअप निवेशकों के सामने पिच करते हैं
definition: the event where accelerator startups pitch to a room of investors
example: Demo day is in two weeks, so sleep is now optional.

hindi: निर्भरता — दूसरे के काम पर टिका आपका काम
definition: work that cannot start or finish until someone else's work does
example: Our only dependency is the one team that never answers email.

hindi: निर्भरता नरक — आपस में टकराते पैकेज संस्करणों का चक्रव्यूह
definition: the maze of conflicting package versions that refuses every resolution
example: Upgraded one library, entered dependency hell, cancelled the afternoon.

hindi: तैनात करना — कोड सर्वर पर चढ़ाकर चालू करना
definition: to push code to servers and make it live
example: We deploy on Fridays because we enjoy suspense.

hindi: अप्रचलित घोषित करना — हटाने से पहले पुरानी चीज़ पर चेतावनी लगाना
definition: to mark something as obsolete and discouraged before eventually removing it
example: We deprecated that API in 2019; half the company still calls it.

hindi: प्राथमिकता घटाना — विनम्रता से किसी काम को ठंडा करना
definition: to quietly lower something's priority, often as a mercy killing
example: The feature wasn't cancelled, just deprioritized into another timeline.

hindi: पटरी से उतारना — बैठक को विषय से भटकाना
definition: to knock a meeting off its intended topic
example: One small question derailed the entire planning session.

hindi: दायरा घटाना — समयसीमा बचाने हेतु फ़ीचर हटाना
definition: to cut features from a project so the deadline survives
example: We descoped dark mode again; it's basically a tradition now.

hindi: डिज़ाइन ऋण — टाले गए सुधारों और असंगतियों का बढ़ता बोझ
definition: accumulated inconsistencies from shortcuts that someone must eventually fix
example: Every 'temporary' screen is design debt with compound interest.

hindi: डिज़ाइन भाषा — पूरे उत्पाद में एक जैसी पहचान वाली शैली
definition: the consistent visual and interaction style that makes a product recognizable
example: Our design language is fluent on iOS and heavily accented on web.

hindi: डिज़ाइन प्रक्रिया-प्रबंधन — डिज़ाइन टीम के औज़ार और कार्यप्रवाह संभालना
definition: the practice of running a design team's tools, processes, and rituals
example: Design ops exists so designers design instead of managing license seats.

hindi: डिज़ाइन समीक्षा — काम आगे बढ़ने से पहले की जाँच बैठक
definition: a meeting where work is critiqued before it moves forward
example: The design review approved everything except the part users touch.

hindi: डिज़ाइन स्प्रिंट — पाँच दिन में समस्या से परीक्षित प्रोटोटाइप तक
definition: a five-day process from problem to tested prototype
example: The design sprint answered in five days what we'd debated for five months.

hindi: डिज़ाइन प्रणाली — पुन:प्रयोज्य घटकों और नियमों का साझा सेट
definition: a shared library of reusable components and rules for building UI
example: The design system has three button styles; the app has seventeen.

hindi: डिज़ाइन चिंतन — सहानुभूति और प्रोटोटाइप से समस्या सुलझाने की पद्धति
definition: a human-centered method for solving problems through empathy and prototyping
example: The design thinking workshop produced four hundred sticky notes and one decision.

hindi: डिज़ाइन टोकन — रंग, माप जैसी शैलियों का नामित, साझा मान
definition: a named value for a color, size, or spacing, reused everywhere
example: Hardcoded hex again; the design tokens weep in their JSON file.

hindi: आलोचक ग्राहक — दूसरों को उत्पाद से हतोत्साहित करने वाला
definition: an unhappy customer likely to warn others away from the product
example: One loud detractor undoes ten quiet case studies.

hindi: दूर से जुड़ना — कॉल के ज़रिए बैठक में शामिल होना
definition: to join a meeting remotely by phone or link
example: I'll dial in from the train, so forgive the tunnels.

hindi: डायरी अध्ययन — उपयोगकर्ता से हफ़्तों तक अनुभव लिखवाने की शोध-विधि
definition: research where users log their experiences over days or weeks
example: The diary study showed people use the app mostly in elevators.

hindi: विभेदक — प्रतिस्पर्धा से सचमुच अलग दिखाने वाली खूबी
definition: the thing you do that competitors genuinely don't
example: Our differentiator, per the deck, is 'caring more'.

hindi: घुमंतू कर्मी — यात्रा करते हुए रिमोट काम
definition: someone who works remotely while traveling between places
example: Our digital nomad joins from a new coastline each quarter.

hindi: हिस्सेदारी में कमी — नए शेयर जारी होने पर पुराने हिस्से का घटना
definition: the shrinking of existing owners' percentage when new shares are issued
example: Every round means dilution; we own less of something worth more, hopefully.

hindi: गिरावट — आँकड़े में थोड़े समय की कमी
definition: a brief decline in a metric
example: It is a dip, we said, four consecutive months.

hindi: सीधे अधीनस्थ — जो कर्मचारी सीधे आपको रिपोर्ट करता है
definition: an employee who reports directly to a given manager
example: He has nine direct reports and a calendar that proves it.

hindi: दिशा-सूचक — सांख्यिकीय रूप से पक्का नहीं, पर उम्मीद की ओर इशारा
definition: not statistically solid, but pointing the way we hoped
example: The results are directional, meaning they lost politely.

hindi: छूट — दाम में कटौती, प्रायः तिमाही के अंत में
definition: a price reduction used to close deals faster, especially near quarter end
example: The 'one-time' discount is now in its third consecutive renewal.

hindi: समस्या-खोज चरण — बनाने से पहले समझने का दौर
definition: the phase of learning what's worth building before building it
example: We skipped discovery, so now we're discovering in production.

hindi: प्रारंभिक जानकारी कॉल — ग्राहक की ज़रूरतें समझने के लिए
definition: an early sales call for understanding the prospect's needs, budget, and timeline
example: The discovery call discovered they have no budget until next fiscal year.

hindi: उथल-पुथल मचाने वाली कंपनी — पुराने उद्योग का ढर्रा बदलने वाली
definition: a company that upends an industry with a cheaper or radically different model
example: Every disruptor's deck has a slide of logos it plans to bankrupt.

hindi: आसवन — बड़े मॉडल की नक़ल में छोटा, सस्ता मॉडल तैयार करना
definition: training a small, cheap model to imitate a big, expensive one
example: Distillation gave us the big model's judgment at watch-battery prices.

hindi: बिखरा हुआ एकाश्म — माइक्रोसेवाओं के भेस में जकड़ा पुराना ढाँचा
definition: microservices so entangled they must deploy together, the worst of both worlds
example: Forty services, one release day — congratulations, a distributed monolith.

hindi: वितरित टीम — शहरों और समय-क्षेत्रों में फैली टीम
definition: a team spread across cities or timezones
example: A distributed team runs on writing, not on hallways.

hindi: सीधा निजी संदेश — सिर्फ़ एक व्यक्ति को
definition: direct message — a private message sent to one person
example: DM me the details instead of posting them in the channel.

hindi: परेशान न करें — सूचनाएँ मौन, ध्यान चालू
