definition: the status that silences all notifications and guards your focus
example: I'm on do not disturb until the report is out.

hindi: जो आवश्यक हो कीजिए — भारतीय दफ़्तरी विनती
definition: please take the obvious required action; beloved Indian office English
example: The server is down; kindly do the needful.

hindi: ख़ुद इस्तेमाल करना — अपना उत्पाद ख़ुद बरतकर परखना
definition: to use your own product internally to find its flaws
example: We dogfood the app daily, which explains the bug reports.

hindi: अपना ही उत्पाद बरतना — खुद इस्तेमाल कर खामियाँ पकड़ना
definition: using your own product internally so the team feels its bugs before customers do
example: Dogfooding the new release found three bugs before lunch.

hindi: पक्का पूर्ण — सचमुच समाप्त, सिर्फ़ कहने भर को नहीं
definition: actually finished, as opposed to merely declared finished
example: It's done, but is it done-done, or demo done?

hindi: बिंदु-मतदान — सीमित वोटों से प्राथमिकता चुनना
definition: prioritizing options by letting everyone place limited votes
example: After dot voting, the boring option won, as it should.

hindi: अनौपचारिक रिपोर्टिंग संबंध — बिना सीधी अधीनता के जवाबदेही
definition: an informal reporting relationship alongside one's actual manager
example: She reports to Priya, with a dotted line to the platform director.

hindi: दोहरा हीरा मॉडल — फैलाओ-सिकोड़ो दो बार की डिज़ाइन प्रक्रिया
definition: a design model: diverge and converge on the problem, then the solution
example: We did the double diamond, though ours looked more like one confused circle.

hindi: दांव दोगुना करना — विरोध के बावजूद और ज़ोर लगाना
definition: to commit harder to a position despite pushback
example: Metrics dipped, so naturally we doubled down.

hindi: दोहरी बुकिंग — एक ही समय दो बैठकें
definition: scheduled in two meetings at the same time
example: I'm double-booked at two; I'll lurk in one on mute.

hindi: और गहराई में जाना — किसी बिंदु को विस्तार से देखना
definition: to examine a point in more detail
example: Can we double-click on that revenue dip?

hindi: घटे मूल्य का दौर — पिछले दौर से कम वैल्यूएशन पर निवेश
definition: a funding round at a lower valuation than the previous one
example: The down round hurt egos more than it hurt the balance sheet.

hindi: उम्मीदवार को उसके मौजूदा स्तर से नीचे रखना
definition: to hire someone at a lower level than they held elsewhere
example: They down-leveled her at hiring, then praised her for exceeding expectations.

hindi: सस्ता विकल्प देना — ग्राहक खोने के बजाय छोटा प्लान
definition: to offer a cheaper plan rather than lose the customer entirely
example: We downsold them to the starter plan; it beats a cancellation email.

hindi: मसौदा बनाना — पहला कच्चा संस्करण लिखना
definition: to write a first rough version
example: Draft the announcement now; we'll argue about adjectives later.

hindi: प्रत्यक्ष उत्तरदायी व्यक्ति — निर्णय या परिणाम का एकल स्वामी
definition: directly responsible individual; the single named owner of an outcome
example: Every project needs a DRI, preferably one who knows they're the DRI.

hindi: विचलन — समय के साथ डेटा बदलने से मॉडल की सटीकता घटना
definition: gradual decay in model accuracy as real-world data changes over time
example: New year, new gym crowd, new movement patterns — hello, drift.

hindi: तह तक जाना — आँकड़ों की बारीकी में उतरना
definition: to move from summary to detail, usually in data
example: Let's drill down into why signups dropped in March.

hindi: सूचना की बाढ़ झेलना — एक साथ बहुत कुछ सीखना-समझना
definition: to absorb an overwhelming amount of information at once
example: Week one is drinking from the firehose; week two, swimming.

hindi: क्रमिक ईमेल शृंखला — तयशुदा अंतराल पर स्वचालित संदेश
definition: an automated email series sent on a schedule to warm up leads
example: Day 14 of the drip campaign: 'Just circling back one last time.'

hindi: आगे बढ़ाना — पहल की कमान लेकर मंज़िल तक ले जाना
definition: to push an initiative forward as its main force
example: Someone must drive this, or it drives itself into a ditch.

hindi: बीच में निकलना — कॉल ख़त्म होने से पहले छोड़ना
definition: to leave a call before it ends
example: I'll drop off at half past for my hard stop.

hindi: अटल अंतिम तिथि — जिसके बाद कोई मोहलत नहीं
definition: the truly final deadline after which there is no more slipping
example: The drop-dead date is Friday, the third Friday it's been.

hindi: दोहराव मत करो — हर तर्क एक ही जगह रहे (don't repeat yourself)
definition: don't repeat yourself; every piece of logic should live in exactly one place
example: The code is DRY; the meeting explaining it repeated everything twice.

hindi: बिना लगाई पूँजी — सही सौदे के इंतज़ार में रखा फ़ंड
definition: committed fund money not yet invested, waiting for the right deal
example: They claim record dry powder, yet every pitch ends in 'not right now.'

hindi: पूर्वाभ्यास — असली से पहले पूरी प्रक्रिया का अभ्यास
definition: a full rehearsal of a launch or demo before the real thing
example: The dry run failed, which is technically what dry runs are for.

hindi: पूरी तैयारी — सब कुछ क्रम से सजा लेना
definition: everything organized and ready before acting
example: Get your ducks in a row before the audit.

hindi: जुगाड़ू टेप — असल समाधान की जगह अस्थायी जोड़-गाँठ
definition: whatever improvised patchwork keeps the system together instead of a proper fix
example: The integration is duct tape with a service-level agreement.

hindi: गहन जाँच-पड़ताल — निवेश से पहले कंपनी के दावों की पड़ताल
definition: the deep investigation of a company's numbers, legal state, and claims before investing
example: Due diligence found the spreadsheet where 'projected' meant 'imagined.'

hindi: अग्रिम उपलब्धता — आधिकारिक विमोचन से पहले चुनिंदा प्रवेश
definition: letting select users in before the official launch
example: Early access means paying to be a tester, framed as a privilege.

hindi: अग्रणी उपयोगकर्ता — नई चीज़ सबसे पहले आज़माने वाला ग्राहक
definition: a customer who tries new products first and forgives their rough edges
example: Our early adopters file bugs with more love than most people file taxes.

hindi: मद के लिए चिह्नित करना — रक़म ख़ास काम हेतु अलग रखना
definition: to set money aside for a specific purpose
example: That money was earmarked for training, not the offsite karaoke.

hindi: अर्जित प्रचार — बिना भुगतान मिली मीडिया कवरेज
definition: press coverage and mentions you didn't pay for
example: One viral customer tweet earned more media than the entire launch budget.

hindi: छिपा तोहफ़ा — सॉफ़्टवेयर में छुपाया गया मज़ेदार रहस्य
definition: a hidden joke or feature tucked into software for those who find it
example: The 404 page plays snake, our finest easter egg.

hindi: आर्थिक निर्णयकर्ता — जिसके पास बजट की चाबी हो
definition: the person who actually controls the budget for the purchase
example: Everyone loved the demo; none of them was the economic buyer.

hindi: किनारे का मामला — दुर्लभ या चरम स्थिति जो कोड तोड़ दे
definition: an unusual input or situation at the boundary of what the code expects
example: Works perfectly, except for the edge case of a user with no email.

hindi: एज अनुमान — क्लाउड के बजाय पास की डिवाइस पर मॉडल चलाना
definition: running model predictions on local devices instead of cloud servers
example: Edge inference keeps rep counting alive in basement gyms with zero bars.

hindi: कमरे में हाथी — सबको दिखती पर अनकही समस्या
definition: the obvious problem everyone avoids mentioning
example: The elephant in the room is that nobody uses the app.

hindi: अति-संक्षिप्त परिचय — लिफ़्ट जितने समय में पूरा प्रस्ताव
definition: a summary of what you do, short enough to deliver during an elevator ride
example: His elevator pitch requires a building with at least ninety floors.

hindi: इंजीनियरिंग मैनेजर — इंजीनियरों की टीम का प्रबंधक
definition: engineering manager; the person responsible for an engineering team's people and delivery
example: Ask your EM to raise it in the next skip-level.

hindi: प्रकाशन रोक — तय समय से पहले ख़बर न छापने की शर्त
definition: an agreement that journalists hold a story until an agreed date and time
example: The embargo lifts at 9 a.m., so expect a leak by 7.

hindi: एम्बेडिंग — अर्थ को संख्याओं में बदलना ताकि मिलती-जुलती चीज़ें पास आएँ
definition: a list of numbers representing meaning, so similar things sit near each other
example: Per the embeddings, 'leg day' and 'regret' are basically neighbors.

hindi: इमोजी प्रतिक्रिया — बिना शब्दों का जवाब
definition: a one-tap emoji response that replaces a whole reply
example: Mark attendance with an emoji reaction, not forty replies.

hindi: सहानुभूति मानचित्र — उपयोगकर्ता क्या सोचता, कहता, करता है उसका खाका
definition: a chart of what users think, feel, say, and do
example: The empathy map says users feel anxious; the error messages aren't helping.

hindi: रिक्त अवस्था — डेटा न होने पर स्क्रीन का दिखने वाला रूप
definition: what a screen shows when there's no data in it yet
example: The empty state just says 'No items', which helps nobody.

hindi: जुड़ाव — उपयोगकर्ता उत्पाद कितना और कितनी गहराई से चलाते हैं
definition: how much and how often users actually interact with the product
example: Engagement doubled once we counted opening the app as engagement.

hindi: कर्मचारी संतुष्टि का स्कोर — 'क्या आप यहाँ काम करने की सलाह देंगे'
definition: employee net promoter score; whether staff would recommend working there
example: The eNPS dropped nine points, so leadership scheduled a fun event.

hindi: बड़ी कंपनियों का वर्ग — हज़ारों कर्मचारियों वाले ग्राहक
definition: the largest customer segment, with big budgets, long sales cycles, and longer security reviews
example: Enterprise deals: nine months of meetings, one signature, champagne.

hindi: दिवसांत — आज का कार्य-दिवस समाप्त होने तक
definition: end of day; a deadline whose time zone is negotiable
example: I'll have it by EOD, somewhere on Earth.

hindi: तिमाही के अंत तक — तिमाही बंद होने की घड़ी
definition: end of quarter — when deals, targets, and tempers all close at once
example: Sales wants every contract countersigned by EOQ.

hindi: सप्ताह के अंत तक — शुक्रवार की मियाद
definition: end of week — due by Friday, usually late Friday
example: Draft by EOW works; nobody reads it before Monday anyway.

hindi: एपिक — कई कहानियों में बँटा बड़ा कार्यखंड
definition: a large body of work broken down into many smaller stories
example: The login epic is now old enough to attend kindergarten.

hindi: कंपनी में हिस्सेदारी — वेतन के बदले मिले शेयर या विकल्प
definition: ownership in the company, granted as shares or options
example: The salary was low, but the equity was described as life-changing.

hindi: स्वामित्व हिस्सा — कंपनी में किसी की मिल्कियत का प्रतिशत
definition: the ownership percentage someone holds in a company
example: The advisor wants a two percent equity stake for one monthly call.

hindi: समान पृष्ठभूमि के कर्मचारियों का स्वैच्छिक समूह
definition: employee resource group; a volunteer community for employees with shared identity
example: The ERG got a logo, a channel, and no budget.

hindi: त्रुटि बजट — कितनी विफलता स्वीकार्य है, उसकी तय सीमा
definition: the agreed amount of failure a service may spend before feature work stops
example: We spent the quarter's error budget in one enthusiastic afternoon.

hindi: ऊपर पहुँचाना — मामला वरिष्ठों तक ले जाना
definition: to raise an issue to higher management when normal channels stall
example: If legal doesn't reply by Friday, we escalate and pray.

hindi: एस्केलेशन मार्ग — समस्या ऊपर पहुँचाने की तय शृंखला
definition: the agreed chain of people to alert when something goes badly enough
example: The escalation path is documented; the willingness to use it is not.

hindi: आकलन — काम में लगने वाले समय का अनुमान
definition: a guess about effort, delivered with more precision than confidence
example: My estimate is two weeks, which is an estimate of an estimate.

hindi: अनुमानित समय — काम पूरा होने का संभावित वक़्त
definition: estimated time of arrival; when something should be done, allegedly
example: The ETA on the fix is soon, a proud engineering unit of time.

hindi: अंतिम-उपयोक्ता लाइसेंस — सॉफ़्टवेयर उपयोग की क्लिक-स्वीकृत शर्तें
definition: end-user license agreement; the terms you click through to use software
example: The EULA forbids benchmarks, which tells you about the benchmarks.

hindi: मूल्यांकन — मॉडल की क्षमता नापने की व्यवस्थित परीक्षा
definition: a structured test measuring how well a model performs on a task
example: No launch until the evals pass; vibes are not a test suite.

hindi: प्रचारक — किसी तकनीक या उत्पाद का जोशीला समर्थक
definition: a person paid to promote enthusiasm for a product or technology
example: Our developer evangelist gave the same demo at nine conferences.

hindi: इवेंट ट्रैकिंग — हर क्लिक और कार्य को नाम देकर दर्ज करना
definition: recording each user action as a named event for analysis
example: Event tracking captures everything except why.

hindi: क्रियान्वित करना — योजना को अमल में लाना
definition: to carry out a plan; also to formally sign a contract
example: Strategy was the easy part; now someone has to execute.

hindi: कार्यकारी प्रायोजक — सौदे को ऊपर से समर्थन देने वाला
definition: a senior leader on the customer side who backs the project and unblocks it
example: The project survived reorg number three because the executive sponsor did.

hindi: नौकरी छोड़ने के बाद विकल्प भुनाने की समय-सीमा
definition: the deadline after leaving to buy your vested options or lose them
example: The 90-day exercise window turned quitting into a five-figure decision.

hindi: निकास — अधिग्रहण या IPO से निवेशकों का पैसा वसूल होना
definition: the event where investors and founders cash out, via acquisition or IPO
example: Every pitch ends with an exit slide nobody reads aloud.

hindi: विदा होते कर्मचारी से आख़िरी औपचारिक बातचीत
definition: the final chat where departing employees are finally asked for honest feedback
example: The exit interview collected truths that would have been career-limiting last month.

hindi: मौजूदा ग्राहक से अधिक आय — सीटें या उपयोग बढ़ना
definition: additional revenue from an existing customer through more seats, usage, or products
example: Expansion revenue is sales you don't have to cold call for.

hindi: विस्तार राजस्व — मौजूदा ग्राहकों के अपग्रेड से बढ़ी कमाई
definition: additional revenue from existing customers upgrading or buying more
example: Expansion revenue saved the quarter, thanks to one customer's hiring spree.

hindi: शीघ्र कराना — किसी कार्य को कतार से आगे निकालना
definition: to rush one item past all queues and WIP limits
example: Everything marked expedite now waits in the expedite queue.

hindi: ख़र्च कंपनी के खाते डालना — भुगतान-वापसी हेतु दर्ज करना
definition: to charge a cost to the company for reimbursement
example: Can I expense the good coffee, or just the sad kind?

hindi: ख़र्च विवरण — भुगतान-वापसी के लिए ख़र्चों की सूची
definition: an itemized list of work expenses submitted for reimbursement
example: His expense report listed 'team morale' under a bar receipt.

hindi: प्रयोग — बदलाव का असर नापने वाला नियंत्रित परीक्षण
definition: a controlled test of a change against a baseline before committing to it
example: Legal approved the experiment; users remain unaware they are in one.

hindi: व्याख्येयता — मॉडल के फ़ैसले की वजह बता पाने की क्षमता
definition: the ability to say why a model made a particular decision
example: Legal wants explainability: 'the model felt like it' won't survive an audit.

hindi: बहुत छोटी समय-सीमा वाला नौकरी-प्रस्ताव — दबाव की रणनीति
definition: a job offer with a short deadline designed to prevent shopping around
example: The exploding offer gave her 48 hours to decide the next four years.

hindi: कंपनी से बाहर का — सोच-समझकर लिखें
definition: outside the company; a flag to watch what you write
example: Careful, there are external folks on this thread.

hindi: नज़र डालने का अनुरोध — समीक्षा की माँग
definition: a request for someone to review or watch something
example: Can I get eyes on the pricing page before it ships?

hindi: संचालन करना — चर्चा या प्रक्रिया को सुचारू चलाना
definition: to guide a meeting or process so it actually goes somewhere
example: She facilitated the workshop so well we finished early. Unheard of.

hindi: संचालक — बैठक को पटरी पर रखने वाला
definition: the person who runs a meeting and keeps it on track
example: A good facilitator ends the debate before minute fifty.

hindi: जल्दी असफल होना — सस्ते में आज़माओ, जल्दी सीखो
definition: to test ideas cheaply and abandon failures early
example: We failed fast on the chatbot, and no one mourned.

hindi: प्रतीकात्मक यात्रा — रिमोट दिन की शुरुआत-अंत की सैर
definition: a deliberate walk or ride bookending the remote workday
example: A fake commute around the block keeps work out of dinner.

hindi: छद्म द्वार परीक्षण — बिना बनी सुविधा का बटन दिखाकर माँग नापना
definition: a button for an unbuilt feature, measuring demand by clicks
example: The fake door got record clicks and one very awkward sales call.

hindi: मिथ्या सकारात्मक — जो सही है उसे ग़लती से समस्या बताना
definition: when a system flags something that is actually fine
example: The fall detector's false positives mean sitting down dramatically now alerts your family.

hindi: तेज़ अनुकरणकर्ता — दूसरों की ग़लतियों से सीखकर नक़ल करने वाली कंपनी
definition: a company that lets pioneers make the mistakes, then copies what works
example: Being a fast follower means our roadmap is their changelog.

hindi: तेज़ रास्ते पर डालना — सामान्य प्रक्रिया छोड़ प्राथमिकता से कराना
definition: to speed something past the normal process
example: The CEO's pet feature got fast-tracked past three reviews.

hindi: विशेषताओं की तुलना — प्रतिद्वंद्वियों से आमने-सामने तालिका
definition: a chart comparing your product's features against competitors', authored by the winner
example: In our feature comparison we have all the checkmarks; funny how that works.

hindi: सुविधा-अतिवृद्धि — धीरे-धीरे जुड़ती अनचाही सुविधाओं की सूजन
definition: the slow accumulation of features nobody asked for
example: The settings page is a museum of feature creep.

hindi: फ़ीचर अभियांत्रिकी — कच्चे डेटा से मॉडल के काम की जानकारी गढ़ना
definition: turning raw data into meaningful inputs a model can actually learn from
example: Good feature engineering turned raw accelerometer noise into 'that was a jumping jack'.

hindi: फ़ीचर स्विच — कोड में लगा टॉगल जिससे सुविधा चालू-बंद हो
definition: a runtime toggle that turns a feature on or off without redeploying
example: Relax, it's behind a feature flag nobody has turned on. Probably.

hindi: फ़ीचर रोक — रिलीज़ से पहले नए फ़ीचर बंद, सिर्फ़ फ़िक्स
definition: a period before release when only fixes, not new features, may land
example: Feature freeze starts Monday, so everyone is merging tonight.

hindi: सुविधा क़ब्रिस्तान — बंद की जा चुकी सुविधाओं की सामूहिक स्मृति
definition: the collective memory of features that shipped and were quietly removed
example: Add it to the feature graveyard, next to the social feed of 2021.

hindi: सुविधा समता — दो संस्करणों में एक जैसी सुविधाएँ होना
definition: when two products or platforms offer the same feature set
example: The Android app reaches feature parity right after iOS ships something new.

hindi: संघीय अधिगम — डेटा डिवाइस पर ही रहे, सीख साझा मॉडल में जाए
definition: training a shared model across users' devices without their raw data ever leaving
example: Federated learning lets the sleep model improve without anyone's sleep leaving their phone.

hindi: प्रतिक्रिया चक्र — उपयोगकर्ता की प्रतिक्रिया से तंत्र का लगातार सुधार
definition: user corrections and outcomes flowing back to improve the system continuously
example: Every thumbs-down on a suggested workout feeds the feedback loop — keep them coming.

hindi: अल्प-उदाहरण — प्रॉम्प्ट में दो-चार नमूने देकर मॉडल को राह दिखाना
definition: giving a model a handful of examples in the prompt to guide its output
example: Three few-shot examples fixed what two pages of instructions couldn't.

hindi: अंतिम रूप देना — आख़िरी बदलाव कर पक्का करना
definition: to settle the last details and make something official
example: We finalized the deck; the 'final_v7' filename disagrees.

hindi: समय निकालना — साझा ख़ाली स्लॉट खोजकर बैठक रखना
definition: to locate a mutually free slot and schedule it
example: Let's find time next week to walk through the proposal.

hindi: सूक्ष्म-समायोजन — अपने डेटा पर पूर्व-प्रशिक्षित मॉडल को और तराशना
definition: further training a pretrained model on your own data for a specific task
example: After fine-tuning on our workout logs, it finally stopped calling burpees 'burples'.

hindi: आपात नाटक — अचानक अत्यावश्यक बना दिया गया काम
definition: a sudden urgent scramble, frequently for something that wasn't urgent
example: Friday's fire drill was cancelled Monday, as fire drills often are.

hindi: आपात बिक्री — मजबूरी में सस्ते दाम पर कंपनी बेचना
definition: selling a company or its assets fast and cheap, usually under distress
example: The 'strategic acquisition' was a fire sale with better fonts.

hindi: आग बुझाना — योजना छोड़ लगातार आपात समस्याएँ निपटाना
definition: constantly handling urgent breakages instead of planned work
example: This quarter's roadmap was 10% features, 90% firefighting.

hindi: अनौपचारिक संवाद — नेता से खुली बातचीत का सत्र
definition: an informal interview-style session with a leader or guest
example: The CEO's fireside chat was cozy until the layoff question.

hindi: बाज़ार में सबसे पहले उतरने वाली कंपनी
definition: the earliest company in a market, hoping the head start becomes an advantage
example: We're the first mover, which mostly means we make the first mistakes.

hindi: वित्त वर्ष — कंपनी का लेखा वर्ष, कैलेंडर वर्ष से अलग हो सकता है
definition: a company's twelve-month accounting period, not always January to December
example: Our fiscal year starts in February, confusing everyone annually.

hindi: पाँच नौ — 99.999% उपलब्धता का स्वप्निल लक्ष्य
definition: 99.999% availability, about five minutes of downtime a year, mostly aspirational
example: We promise five nines; the fine print counts differently.

hindi: पाँच क्यों — बार-बार 'क्यों' पूछकर मूल कारण खोजना
definition: a root-cause technique of asking why repeatedly until the real cause surfaces
example: Five whys in, the root cause was the deadline itself.

hindi: आगे बढ़कर सुधारो — रोलबैक नहीं, नया फ़िक्स तुरंत भेजो
definition: shipping a new fix instead of rolling back the broken release
example: Too late to roll back; we fix forward and pray.

hindi: ध्यान दिलाना — संभावित समस्या की ओर इशारा करना
definition: to mark something for attention before it becomes a problem
example: Just flagging that the demo environment is down again.

hindi: अस्थिर — कभी पास कभी फेल होने वाला (टेस्ट)
definition: failing intermittently without any code change, eroding trust in the tests
example: It's not broken, it's flaky, we rerun it until it agrees.

hindi: कम पदानुक्रम वाला संगठन — प्रबंधन की परतें न्यूनतम
definition: a company with few management layers, in theory reducing hierarchy
example: We're a flat organization, which means everyone reports to the founder's mood.

hindi: समान मूल्य का दौर — वैल्यूएशन न बढ़ी न घटी
definition: a round at the same valuation as before, neither victory nor disaster
example: We're calling the flat round 'stability' in the investor update.

hindi: सपाट हो जाना — आँकड़े की बढ़त का पूरी तरह रुक जाना
definition: to stop growing entirely
example: Signups flatlined in June and the word pivot entered the chat.

hindi: नौकरी छोड़ने की कगार पर खड़ा कर्मचारी
definition: an employee judged likely to quit soon
example: Updating your title on professional networks flags you as a flight risk.

hindi: फ्लाईव्हील — हर चक्कर से अगला आसान बनाता स्व-चालित विकास
definition: a compounding cycle where each turn makes the next one easier
example: Every strategy doc has a flywheel; ours is still hand-cranked.

hindi: एकाग्र-कार्य समय — बिना बाधा काम हेतु सुरक्षित घंटे
definition: calendar time protected for uninterrupted individual work
example: My focus time got eaten by a quick sync again.

hindi: अंजाम तक पहुँचाना — कहा हुआ काम पूरा करना
definition: to actually finish what was promised
example: Ideas are free; following through costs a quarter.

hindi: सूर्य-अनुगामी — समय-क्षेत्रों में चौबीसों घंटे काम सौंपना
definition: handing work across timezones so it continues around the clock
example: Support runs follow-the-sun, so tickets never sleep.

hindi: अनुवर्ती कार्रवाई — चर्चा के बाद की अगली कड़ी
definition: a task, message, or meeting that continues something already discussed
example: I owe you a follow-up with the numbers by Friday.

hindi: अनुवर्ती संपर्क की लय — तय अंतराल पर याद दिलाना
definition: the scheduled rhythm of emails and calls after first contact
example: Our follow-up cadence is polite persistence every three business days.

hindi: पिछली बात याद दिलाना — जवाब की विनम्र तलाश
definition: returning to an unanswered request, politely and relentlessly
example: Following up on my note from last week — any thoughts?

hindi: फ़ू-बार — उदाहरणों में काम आने वाले परंपरागत नकली नाम
definition: the traditional placeholder name used in code examples everywhere
example: The tutorial's foobar shipped to production as an actual table name.

hindi: अपने पैर पर गोली — ऐसी सुविधा जिससे खुद का नुकसान आसान हो
definition: a feature or API that makes it dangerously easy to hurt yourself
example: A delete-all endpoint with no confirmation is a loaded footgun.

hindi: संदर्भ के लिए — पृष्ठभूमि की जानकारी
definition: prefacing background information that explains the ask
example: For context, this is the third redesign this year.

hindi: नज़र में रहने हेतु — जानकारी में रखना
definition: shared so people can't later say they didn't know
example: Adding your manager for visibility, not for escalation. Yet.

hindi: दैवीय-घटना खंड — बाढ़, युद्ध जैसी अनहोनी पर दायित्व से छूट
definition: a clause excusing obligations during extraordinary events like disasters
example: The vendor cited force majeure; the outage cited their intern.

hindi: ज़बरदस्ती धकेलना — साझा इतिहास पर अपना संस्करण थोप देना
definition: overwriting shared git history with your own version, teammates' work be damned
example: He force pushed to main; we speak of him in past tense.

hindi: पूर्वानुमान — भविष्य की आय-ख़र्च का अनुमान
definition: a prediction of future revenue, costs, or demand
example: The forecast assumes every deal closes; the pipeline giggles.

hindi: शाखा बनाना — प्रोजेक्ट की प्रति लेकर अपनी अलग राह चलना
definition: to copy a project and develop it independently
example: They forked the project after one argument about tabs.

hindi: आगे भेजना — मिला संदेश दूसरों तक पहुँचाना
definition: to send a received message on to someone else
example: Forwarding the client's note; read the third paragraph sitting down.

hindi: आधार मॉडल — जिस पर कई उत्पाद बनते हैं, ऐसा बहु-उद्देश्यीय मॉडल
definition: a large general-purpose model that many downstream products build on
example: We don't train foundation models; we rent one and add squats.

hindi: संस्थापक — कंपनी को शून्य से शुरू करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: someone who starts a company and carries it from idea to reality
example: The founder does sales, support, hiring, and occasionally, sleep.

hindi: संस्थापक का सीधे हर स्तर में दखल देने वाला प्रबंधन
definition: a founder bypassing management layers to run details directly
example: Founder mode returned, and with it, 11 p.m. design reviews.

hindi: संस्थापक-हितैषी — शर्तों में संस्थापकों का पक्ष लेने वाला निवेशक
definition: describes investors whose terms and behavior favor founders, at least on paper
example: They're founder-friendly right up until the board vote.

hindi: संस्थापक द्वारा बिक्री — शुरुआती दौर में ख़ुद ग्राहक जुटाना
definition: the early phase when founders personally sell because nobody else can yet
example: Founder-led sales means the CEO still answers the demo requests himself.

hindi: संस्थापक-बाज़ार मेल — संस्थापक के अनुभव और समस्या का तालमेल
definition: the match between a founder's background and the problem they are solving
example: A dentist building dental software — investors love that founder-market fit.

hindi: फ़्री-प्रीमियम मॉडल — मुफ़्त संस्करण, उन्नत सुविधाओं के पैसे
definition: a model offering a free tier and charging for premium features
example: Freemium works: millions use it free, and hundreds pay for it.

hindi: रुकावट — उपयोगकर्ता के काम को धीमा करने वाली हर बाधा
definition: anything that makes a task harder or slower for the user
example: Every extra signup field adds friction, and friction costs conversions.

hindi: दोस्ताना याद-दिहानी — हर बार कम दोस्ताना
definition: a reminder that gets less friendly each time it is sent
example: Third friendly reminder: the survey closes tonight.

hindi: परिजनों से पहला निवेश — भरोसे के आधार पर जुटाई शुरुआती रक़म
definition: the informal first money raised from people who trust the founder personally
example: The friends and family round made Diwali dinners slightly more formal.

hindi: अग्रणी मॉडल — किसी समय का सबसे सक्षम और सबसे बड़ा मॉडल
definition: one of the largest, most capable models available at a given moment
example: Do we need a frontier model to count push-ups? Finance says no.

hindi: पूर्णकालिक कर्मचारी — हेडकाउंट गिनने की इकाई
definition: full-time equivalent; a unit for counting employees in headcount math
example: The project needs three FTEs; we have one and an intern.

hindi: डर, अनिश्चितता और संदेह — प्रतिस्पर्धी के विरुद्ध आशंका फैलाना
definition: fear, uncertainty, and doubt — spreading scary vagueness about a competitor
example: Their rep is spreading FUD about our uptime; our status page disagrees.

hindi: पूर्ण-स्तरीय — फ्रंटएंड से डेटाबेस तक सब सँभालने वाला
definition: covering every layer from user interface to database
example: Full-stack means the bug is always yours.

hindi: फ़ंक्शन आह्वान — मॉडल का सीधे कोड या एपीआई चलाना
definition: a model invoking predefined code or APIs instead of just writing text
example: With function calling, the assistant actually books the class instead of describing booking.

hindi: निवेश का सूखा — जब वेंचर पूँजी मिलना लंबे समय तक कठिन हो
definition: a prolonged period when venture money becomes scarce and cautious
example: During the funding winter, 'growth at all costs' quietly became 'profitability.'

hindi: फ़नल — पहले संपर्क से खरीद तक चरण-दर-चरण घटती उपयोगकर्ता संख्या
definition: the narrowing path users take from first touch to conversion
example: The funnel leaks at step two, like every funnel ever.

hindi: फ़नल विश्लेषण — किस चरण पर उपयोगकर्ता छूटते हैं, इसकी जांच
definition: studying where users abandon each step of a flow
example: Funnel analysis found the leak: step one.

hindi: अवैतनिक अनिवार्य अवकाश — नौकरी बची, वेतन रुका
definition: unpaid mandatory leave that keeps you employed but not paid
example: The furlough was billed as temporary, like most permanent things.

hindi: भविष्य-सुरक्षित बनाना — आगे के बदलावों के लिए तैयार रखना
definition: to design something so later changes will not break it; aspirational
example: We future-proofed the API right up until next quarter.

hindi: जो भी इसका मोल हो — राय, मानना आपकी मर्ज़ी
definition: for what it's worth — input offered gently, take it or leave it
example: FWIW, the customer asked for exactly this last year.

hindi: आपकी कार्रवाई के लिए — करना आपको है
definition: for your action — this one you actually have to do
example: Marked FYA because the last three FYIs were ignored.

hindi: आपकी जानकारी के लिए — जवाब ज़रूरी नहीं
definition: for your information — no reply needed, just know this
example: FYI, the client saw the staging site before we did.

hindi: आपके संदर्भ के लिए — केवल जानकारी हेतु
definition: for your reference — background material, no action expected
example: FYR, last quarter's audit notes before tomorrow's review.

hindi: पासा पलटने वाला — हालात बदल देने वाली चीज़
definition: something that transforms the situation; applied weekly to minor features
example: The new export button was announced as a game changer.

hindi: गैंट चार्ट — कार्यों की अवधि दिखाती पट्टियों वाला समय-चार्ट
definition: a bar chart mapping tasks against time, beloved by project managers
example: The Gantt chart is gorgeous; the project is another matter.

hindi: नोटिस अवधि में वेतन-सहित घर बैठाना — काम से दूर रखने को
definition: being paid through your notice period while barred from working
example: Garden leave: three months of salary to not touch the codebase.

hindi: फ़ॉर्म के पीछे बंद सामग्री — संपर्क देकर ही मिले
definition: content locked behind a form that collects your details first
example: The report is gated behind a form with eleven required fields.

hindi: द्वारपाल — निर्णयकर्ता तक पहुँच रोकने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: the person who controls access to the decision maker
example: The gatekeeper is an executive assistant with excellent instincts and no mercy.

hindi: यूरोपीय डेटा-संरक्षण क़ानून — निजी डेटा पर सख़्त नियम
definition: the EU's data protection law governing how personal data is handled
example: One GDPR deletion request just found our seven backup systems.

hindi: सृजनात्मक एआई — पाठ, चित्र, ध्वनि या कोड रचने वाली प्रणालियाँ
definition: generative AI; systems that create text, images, audio, or code on demand
example: The deck says GenAI six times per slide; investors expect nothing less.

hindi: नरम याद-दिहानी — मीठी चेतावनी
definition: a reminder wearing kid gloves; the gentleness is the warning
example: Gentle reminder that timesheets were due yesterday.

hindi: अचानक चुप हो जाना — बिना बताए जवाब बंद
definition: to stop replying entirely, without explanation or apology
example: The vendor ghosted us right after the proof of concept.

hindi: जोड़ने वाला कोड — दो सिस्टमों को चिपकाने भर का कोड
definition: unglamorous code whose only job is connecting systems together
example: The product is 10% features, 90% glue code.

hindi: टीम को जोड़े रखने वाला अदृश्य काम — पदोन्नति में अनदेखा
definition: essential unglamorous work that keeps teams functioning but rarely gets promoted
example: She did the glue work; the launch email thanked the architect.

hindi: सकल व्यापारिक मूल्य — प्लेटफ़ॉर्म से गुज़रे कुल लेन-देन की रकम
definition: gross merchandise value; total transactions flowing through a marketplace
example: GMV is huge; our slice of it is a garnish.

hindi: संपर्क टूट जाना — ग्राहक का अचानक चुप हो जाना
definition: when a previously engaged prospect stops responding entirely
example: After the pricing slide, the prospect went dark for three weeks.

hindi: गो-लाइव — प्रणाली के वास्तविक उपयोग में आने का दिन
definition: the date a system starts serving real users
example: Go-live went fine; day two is when we met our users.

hindi: बाज़ार-प्रवेश रणनीति — उत्पाद बेचने की समग्र योजना
definition: the overall plan for how a product reaches customers — channels, pricing, sales motion
example: The go-to-market strategy is finalized, pending a new strategy next quarter.

hindi: जाओ/मत-जाओ निर्णय — लॉन्च करें या रोकें की अंतिम बैठक
definition: the final decision meeting on whether to launch or hold
example: The go/no-go meeting was a go, mostly because of sunk cost.

hindi: अनावश्यक चमक — माँगे बिना जोड़ी गई अतिरिक्त पॉलिश
definition: adding unrequested polish or features beyond what the requirements asked for
example: The button animates beautifully; nobody asked; classic gold-plating.

hindi: सुनहरी हथकड़ी — इतना अच्छा वेतन कि नौकरी छोड़ना मुश्किल
definition: pay or unvested equity so good that leaving a job feels impossible
example: He hates the role, but the golden handcuffs vest for two more years.

hindi: निकाले जाने पर अधिकारियों को मिलने वाला भारी मुआवज़ा
definition: a large payout executives receive if ousted, especially after an acquisition
example: The staff got severance calculators; the CEO got a golden parachute.

hindi: स्वर्णिम मार्ग — आधिकारिक, सुगम, अनुशंसित तरीका
definition: the officially supported, well-paved way to build and ship something
example: Stay on the golden path and the platform team stays friendly.

hindi: स्वर्ण सेट — जाँच के लिए प्रमाणित उत्तरों वाला भरोसेमंद नमूना-समूह
definition: a small, trusted set of examples with verified answers used to judge models
example: The golden set is fifty workouts the physio labeled personally; guard it.

hindi: शासन-व्यवस्था — निर्णय और नियंत्रण के तय ढाँचे
definition: the framework of rules and oversight for making decisions
example: Data governance means asking permission before the fun query.

hindi: सामान्य साझेदार — फ़ंड चलाने और निवेश तय करने वाला वरिष्ठ VC
definition: general partner; a senior VC who runs the fund and makes investment decisions
example: The associates loved us, but the GP asked the hard questions.

hindi: जीपीयू — एआई को चलाने वाली चिप, आज की सबसे क़ीमती धातु
definition: graphics processing unit; the chip AI training and inference actually run on
example: The GPUs arrive Thursday; until then, the roadmap is aspirational.

hindi: जीपीयू-निर्धन — बड़े लैब जैसी चिप-संपदा से वंचित
definition: lacking the compute budget of big labs; making do with less
example: We're GPU-poor, so we distill, quantize, and pray.

hindi: समय लेना — किसी के कैलेंडर पर स्लॉट बुक करना
definition: to claim a slot on someone's calendar
example: Grab time with me Friday if the design still feels off.

hindi: सुगम अवनति — आंशिक विफलता में भी शालीनता से चलते रहना
definition: continuing to work in reduced form when parts of the system fail
example: Graceful degradation: the site is down but the error page is lovely.

hindi: पुरानी शर्तें जारी रखना — नए नियम से पुराने ग्राहकों को छूट देना
definition: to let existing customers keep old terms after rules or prices change
example: Early users were grandfathered into the price we now regret.

hindi: अनुभवी दिग्गज — दशकों का अनुभव समेटे वयोवृद्ध इंजीनियर
definition: a veteran engineer who has seen every failure mode at least twice
example: The graybeard read the stack trace and said, again?

hindi: हरा बिल्ड — सारे टेस्ट पास, डैशबोर्ड पर सब ठीक
definition: a build with all tests passing and nothing red on the dashboard
example: Green build on the first try, immediately suspicious.

hindi: कोरी ज़मीन — पुराने बोझ के बिना नई शुरुआत वाला
definition: built fresh with no legacy constraints
example: It's a greenfield project, so enjoy the six good months.

hindi: हरित-क्षेत्र बाज़ार — बिल्कुल नया बाज़ार, कोई पुराना खिलाड़ी नहीं
definition: a brand-new market with no incumbents or legacy systems to displace
example: It's a greenfield market, meaning we must explain the product from zero.

hindi: हरी झंडी देना — परियोजना को औपचारिक मंज़ूरी देना
definition: to officially approve a project to proceed
example: Leadership greenlit the redesign right after the last redesign shipped.

hindi: खोज मारना — कोड या लॉग में पैटर्न छानना
definition: to search code or logs for a pattern, named after the unix tool
example: Before asking the author, grep; the author also greps.

hindi: सकल मार्जिन — राजस्व में से सीधी लागत घटाकर बचा प्रतिशत
definition: revenue minus direct costs, as a percentage of revenue
example: Gross margin looks great if support tickets answer themselves.

hindi: यथार्थ सत्य — प्रशिक्षण और जाँच के लिए प्रमाणित सही उत्तर
definition: the verified correct answer used to train models and score their outputs
example: We need ground truth for 'good form', so film the physiotherapist, not the intern.

hindi: तथ्याधार — मॉडल के जवाबों को असली, जाँचने-योग्य डेटा से जोड़ना
definition: tying a model's answers to real, verifiable data instead of its imagination
example: With grounding on your actual workouts, the coach stopped inventing personal records.

hindi: कमज़ोरी का सौम्य नाम — सुधार की ज़रूरत वाली बात
definition: review-speak for a weakness, phrased as an opportunity
example: Her growth area, per the review, is 'being less right in meetings'.

hindi: जुगाड़ू विकास तरकीबें — कम ख़र्च में तेज़ी से उपयोगकर्ता बढ़ाना
definition: scrappy, experiment-driven tactics to grow users fast on a small budget
example: Our growth hacking budget is one intern and unlimited enthusiasm.

hindi: विकास चक्र — उपयोग से ही नए उपयोगकर्ता पैदा करने वाला चक्र
definition: a self-reinforcing cycle where usage generates new users
example: The deck shows a growth loop; the data shows a line.

hindi: वृद्धि दर — किसी आँकड़े के बढ़ने की रफ्तार
definition: the pace at which a metric increases over time
example: The growth rate is impressive; the base is four users.

hindi: विकास दौर — सिद्ध कारोबार को तेज़ी से बड़ा करने की पूँजी
definition: a late-stage raise to scale a proven business aggressively
example: After the growth round, we opened three offices and one crisis.

hindi: सुरक्षा-मापदंड — प्रयोग से नुकसान न हो, इसकी निगरानी करता आँकड़ा
definition: a metric watched during experiments to ensure a change causes no harm
example: The variant won, but the guardrail metric filed a complaint.

hindi: सुरक्षा-बाड़ — एआई के जवाबों को सुरक्षित और विषय पर रखने वाली सीमाएँ
definition: constraints keeping an AI system's outputs safe, legal, and on-topic
example: Guardrails keep the coach from prescribing supplements or discussing your divorce.

hindi: त्वरित अनौपचारिक परीक्षण — आसपास के लोगों से झटपट प्रतिक्रिया लेना
definition: quick, informal usability testing with whoever is nearby
example: Guerrilla testing in the cafe: five strangers, one prototype, free espresso opinions.

hindi: अंतर्मन से जाँच — आँकड़ों से पहले सहज-बुद्धि की राय
definition: a quick instinct-level check that something feels right
example: Quick gut check: does anyone actually want this feature?

hindi: वर्ष का उत्तरार्ध — जुलाई से दिसंबर की योजना-अवधि
definition: the second half of the year, where first-half promises are relocated
example: It's been moved to H2, the roadmap's witness protection program.

hindi: जुगाड़ — तेज़, गंदा पर काम चलाऊ समाधान
definition: a quick, inelegant solution that works but wasn't built to last
example: It's a temporary hack, added to the codebase permanently.

hindi: हैकाथॉन — कुछ नया बना डालने की मैराथन कोडिंग स्पर्धा
definition: a short intense event where teams build prototypes, powered by pizza and optimism
example: The hackathon demo was glorious; the codebase quietly denies it exists.

hindi: मतिभ्रम — एआई का आत्मविश्वास से ग़लत जानकारी गढ़ना
definition: an AI system confidently producing information that is false or made up
example: It recommended a 45-minute plank and cited a fake study — textbook hallucination.

hindi: तीन-रेखा मेनू — छोटी स्क्रीन पर नेविगेशन छिपाने वाला आइकन
definition: the three-line icon hiding navigation on small screens
example: We solved discoverability by hiding everything in the hamburger menu.

hindi: हस्तांतरण — काम एक टीम से दूसरी को सौंपना
definition: the transfer of work between teams, where context goes to die
example: The design handoff included forty screens and zero edge cases.

hindi: मनचाहा सुनना — ग्राहक की हर बात को हाँ समझ लेना
definition: hearing what you want to hear in a prospect's polite noises
example: 'They said maybe next quarter' — that's happy ears translating 'no.'

hindi: कार्यालय-उपरांत मेलजोल — काम के बाद अनौपचारिक जमावड़ा
definition: informal after-work team drinks or socializing
example: Sprint's done; happy hour is at five, attendance suspiciously encouraged.

hindi: सीधा-सरल रास्ता — वह प्रवाह जिसमें सब कुछ ठीक चलता है
definition: the execution flow where every input is valid and nothing goes wrong
example: The demo covered the happy path; the customers found the other ones.

hindi: सख़्त समय-सीमा — जिस वक़्त मीटिंग से निकलना ही होगा
definition: a fixed time when someone must leave a meeting
example: I have a hard stop at three, thankfully.

hindi: कोड में ठोक देना — मान सीधे कोड में जड़ना, बदलना कठिन
definition: to embed a value directly in code where configuration should be
example: The demo works as long as the customer is named Test User, hardcoded.

hindi: मज़बूतीकरण — रिलीज़ से पहले सुरक्षा और स्थिरता कसना
definition: strengthening a system against failure and attack before release
example: One hardening week, because the other fifty-one were for features.

hindi: स्वीकृत कर्मचारी संख्या — भर्ती की बजट-सीमा
definition: the number of employees a team is budgeted to have
example: We have the work for five engineers and the headcount for two.

hindi: मुख्य आँकड़ा — रिपोर्ट में सबसे ऊपर दिखाया जाने वाला अंक
definition: the single most quotable figure in a report or announcement
example: Growth is the headline number; the footnotes hold the truth.

hindi: पहले से सूचना — बाद में शिकायत न हो
definition: advance notice given so nobody can say they weren't told
example: Heads up, the CEO is walking the floor at noon.

hindi: ग्राहक स्वास्थ्य अंक — खाते की स्थिति का संकेतक
definition: a composite metric estimating how happy and sticky a customer account is
example: The health score was green right up until the cancellation email.

hindi: हीटमैप — कहाँ ज़्यादा क्लिक या ध्यान, रंगों से दिखाता नक्शा
definition: a color-coded view of where users click, scroll, or linger
example: The heatmap shows everyone clicking the logo, which goes nowhere.

hindi: भारी मशक़्क़त — काम का सबसे मेहनत वाला हिस्सा
definition: the hardest, most substantial part of the work
example: The library does the heavy lifting; we take the credit.

hindi: हाइज़ेनबग — देखने की कोशिश करते ही ग़ायब होने वाला बग
definition: a bug that disappears whenever you try to observe it
example: Add a print statement and the heisenbug politely leaves.

hindi: बिल्लियाँ हाँकना — बेक़ाबू लोगों में तालमेल बिठाने की मशक़्क़त
definition: trying to coordinate people who refuse to be coordinated
example: Scheduling eight directors for one call is herding cats.

hindi: मुख्य शीर्ष खंड — पेज के सबसे ऊपर का बड़ा प्रचार-क्षेत्र
definition: the big banner area at the top of a landing page
example: The hero section promises magic; the pricing page provides the disclaimers.

hindi: अनुभवजन्य नियम — त्वरित मूल्यांकन के लिए व्यावहारिक कसौटी
definition: a rule of thumb used to judge usability quickly
example: Visibility of system status is the heuristic; the frozen spinner is the violation.

hindi: अनुभवजन्य समीक्षा — मानक कसौटियों पर विशेषज्ञ की जाँच
definition: an expert review scoring an interface against established usability rules
example: The heuristic evaluation flagged everything the launch deadline had approved.

hindi: लगातार उत्कृष्ट काम करने वाला कर्मचारी
definition: an employee who consistently delivers beyond their level
example: The reward for a high performer is someone else's backlog.

hindi: उच्च-विस्तार — अंतिम रूप के करीब, पूरी बारीकियों समेत
definition: detailed and polished, close to the final product's look
example: We went high-fidelity too early and now everyone's debating button shadows.

hindi: नई भर्तियों पर अस्थायी रोक
definition: a pause on new hiring, usually the first sign of tighter times
example: The hiring freeze arrived one week after the 'aggressive growth' town hall.

hindi: जिस प्रबंधक की टीम के लिए भर्ती हो रही है
definition: the manager the new hire will work for, who owns the hiring decision
example: The recruiter screens, but the hiring manager decides.

hindi: आते ही रफ़्तार पकड़ना — बिना वॉर्म-अप के काम शुरू करना
definition: to be productive immediately, without a settling-in period
example: We expect the contractor to hit the ground running Monday.

hindi: हॉकी-स्टिक वक्र — लंबे ठहराव के बाद अचानक तीखी बढ़त
definition: a growth curve that stays flat, then shoots suddenly upward
example: The hockey stick starts next quarter, as it has every quarter.

hindi: संभावित आरक्षण — ज़रूरत पड़ने पर बैठक हेतु रोका समय
definition: time blocked on calendars in case a meeting is needed
example: There's a hold on Friday in case the deal closes.

hindi: अलग रखा समूह — असली असर नापने के लिए बदलाव से बाहर रखे उपयोगकर्ता
definition: users deliberately kept from a change to measure its true impact
example: The holdout group is happier, which we are choosing not to discuss.

hindi: समग्र — हर पहलू को एक साथ देखने वाला
definition: considering the whole rather than the parts; sounds strategic in any sentence
example: We need a holistic view of the customer journey.

hindi: गृह-कार्यालय — घर में काम की तयशुदा जगह
definition: a dedicated workspace at home
example: The home office doubles as a guest room and triples as storage.

hindi: फ़ौरन जुड़ना — झट से कॉल पर आना
definition: to join a call, usually on short notice
example: Can you hop on for five minutes to unblock deploys?

term: hope this email finds you well
hindi: आशा है आप कुशल होंगे — औपचारिक शुरुआत
definition: the ceremonial opener before asking for something
example: Hope this email finds you well; unfortunately, it finds you on-call.

hindi: खुला माइक — अनजाने में सबको सुनाई गई बात
definition: a microphone accidentally left on, broadcasting words not meant for the room
example: A hot mic during the board call taught us new vocabulary.

hindi: अनारक्षित डेस्क — जो मेज़ ख़ाली मिले वही
definition: unassigned seating where you take whatever desk is free
example: Hot-desking means my monitor settings are never mine.

hindi: डेस्क-आरक्षण — दफ़्तर आने से पहले सीट बुक करना
definition: reserving a desk or room in advance for office days
example: Forgot hoteling again, so I'm working from the couch by reception.

hindi: तुरत मरम्मत — उत्पादन में सीधे लगाई गई आपात पैच
definition: an urgent patch pushed straight to production to stop the bleeding
example: Friday 5 pm hotfix — what could possibly go wrong?

hindi: एच.आर. बिज़नेस पार्टनर — किसी विभाग को समर्पित मानव-संसाधन साथी
definition: HR business partner; the HR person embedded with a specific org
example: The HRBP joined the meeting, which told everyone what kind of meeting it was.

hindi: झटपट मंडली — तुरंत हल के लिए छोटी जुटान
definition: a quick informal gathering to solve something on the spot
example: Two-minute huddle by the whiteboard before the demo?

hindi: मानव-समावेशी प्रक्रिया — एआई के फ़ैसलों पर इंसानी निगरानी
definition: a workflow where people review or correct an AI system's outputs
example: Injury-risk flags stay human-in-the-loop; a physio signs off before anyone gets scared.

hindi: कुछ दिन दफ़्तर, कुछ दिन घर — मिली-जुली कार्य-व्यवस्था
definition: splitting the week between office days and remote days
example: Hybrid means commuting in to take the same video calls.

hindi: अति-विकास — साल-दर-साल दोगुनी रफ़्तार से बढ़ना
definition: an extreme growth phase, roughly doubling revenue or users year after year
example: Hypergrowth is thrilling until you meet the org chart it produces.

hindi: परिकल्पना — परखने लायक अनुमान, जिसे प्रयोग जांचता है
definition: a testable guess about what a change will do
example: The hypothesis was written after the results, which helped it a lot.

hindi: इंडिविजुअल कंट्रिब्यूटर — बिना टीम मैनेज किए काम करने वाला कर्मचारी
definition: individual contributor; an employee who does the work without managing anyone
example: She left management to go back to being an IC, and seems happier.

hindi: आइसबॉक्स — फ़िलहाल ठंडे बस्ते में डाले विचारों की सूची
definition: where backlog items go to be politely frozen instead of deleted
example: It's in the icebox, which has never once thawed.

hindi: बर्फ़ पिघलाने वाला सवाल — माहौल सहज करने की शुरुआत
definition: a light opening question or activity to warm up a meeting
example: The icebreaker took longer than the actual agenda item.

hindi: आदर्श ग्राहक प्रोफ़ाइल — सबसे उपयुक्त ख़रीदार का ख़ाका
definition: ideal customer profile — the type of company most likely to buy and succeed
example: Our ICP is mid-market fintech; our actual customers are whoever replied.

hindi: अगर छूट गया हो — दोबारा साझा की गई बात
definition: in case you missed it — a repost dressed as a favor
example: ICYMI, Friday's all-team email covers the new leave policy.

hindi: विचार-मंथन करना — 'सोचना' का महँगा कॉर्पोरेट रूप
definition: to generate ideas; an expensive way to say think
example: We booked the big room to ideate on the roadmap.

hindi: विचार-सृजन — जानबूझकर ढेर सारे संभावित समाधान सोचना
definition: the deliberate generation of many possible solutions
example: Ideation rules: no bad ideas until Tuesday, when we cut ninety percent.

hindi: अगर ठीक याद है — याद्दाश्त के भरोसे
definition: if I recall correctly — a memory offered without a warranty
example: IIRC we tried that in 2023 and it broke billing.

hindi: मेरी विनम्र राय में — विनम्रता की चादर में राय
definition: in my humble opinion — rarely humble, always an opinion
example: IMHO the logo was fine before the redesign.

hindi: मेरी राय में — निजी विचार
definition: in my opinion — the view is mine, feel free to differ
example: IMO we ship Friday and fix the copy next week.

hindi: छँटनी की चपेट में आया — 'प्रभावित' कहकर निकाला गया
definition: HR's word for laid off, as in 'your role was impacted'
example: The email said impacted employees; the badge reader said it plainer.

hindi: लागू करना — योजना या समाधान को व्यवहार में उतारना
definition: to put a plan, tool, or process into effect
example: We implemented the new process alongside the old one, forever.

hindi: काबिल होते हुए भी खुद को धोखेबाज़ महसूस करना
definition: feeling underqualified and about to be found out, despite real competence
example: Half the senior engineers have imposter syndrome; the other half should.

hindi: इंप्रेशन — सामग्री के किसी को दिखने की एक गिनती
definition: one instance of content being displayed to someone
example: A million impressions, forty clicks, one lesson.

hindi: प्रगति में — शुरू होकर अभी अधूरा
definition: already started and not yet landed, like most things here
example: We have six initiatives in flight and one runway.

hindi: सीमा के भीतर — इस चरण की डिलीवरी में शामिल
definition: included in what the team has agreed to deliver
example: Login is in scope; logging out gracefully, apparently, is not.

hindi: जानकारी में — ज़रूरी सूचनाओं से जुड़े रहना
definition: kept informed about developments
example: Keep me in the loop on the vendor negotiations.

hindi: उलझनों में धँसा — बारीकियों में इतना डूबना कि दिशा खो जाए
definition: lost in details, or overwhelmed by work
example: I was so in the weeds on the migration I missed lunch.

hindi: आंतरिक — बाहर से कराने के बजाय कंपनी के भीतर किया गया
definition: done by the company's own staff rather than outsourced
example: We brought design in-house after the third agency invoice.

hindi: स्वयं चलकर आए ग्राहक — जो ख़ुद संपर्क करें
definition: leads who come to you via content, search, or referrals
example: Inbound is up: mostly students, plus competitors requesting demos.

hindi: खाली इनबॉक्स की अवस्था — क्षणिक सुख
definition: the state of having no unhandled email, achieved briefly, discussed forever
example: He reached inbox zero at 5pm; it lasted eleven minutes.

hindi: प्रोत्साहित करना — इनाम देकर मनचाहा व्यवहार कराना
definition: to motivate behavior with rewards
example: The bonus incentivizes exactly the wrong metric.

hindi: गंभीर गड़बड़ी — उत्पादन की समस्या और उसका संगठित निपटान
definition: a production problem serious enough to trigger a coordinated response
example: It's not an outage, it's an incident, feel better?

hindi: समावेशी डिज़ाइन — हर क्षमता और परिस्थिति के लोगों के लिए रचना
definition: designing for the full range of human abilities and contexts
example: Inclusive design fixed it for screen readers and, surprise, for everyone.

hindi: वृद्धिशील असर — नतीजे का वह हिस्सा जो वैसे भी न आता
definition: the portion of results that would not have happened anyway
example: Ten thousand visits, says the campaign; incrementality asks how many were coming anyway.

hindi: उद्भवन केंद्र — शुरुआती आइडिया को जगह और सहारा देने वाला संस्थान
definition: an organization that nurtures very early ideas with space, support, and services
example: The incubator gave us desks, Wi-Fi, and weekly reminders to incorporate.

hindi: मौजूदा विक्रेता — जिसकी जगह लेनी है
definition: the vendor the customer already uses, and the one you must displace
example: The incumbent is terrible, beloved, and already in the budget.

hindi: क्षतिपूर्ति वचन — दूसरे पक्ष के नुक़सान की भरपाई का दायित्व
definition: a contractual promise to cover the other party's losses
example: The indemnification clause is where both lawyers earn their fees.

hindi: स्वतंत्र निर्माता — बिना निवेशकों के छोटे मुनाफ़ेदार उत्पाद बनाने वाला
definition: a builder who launches small, profitable products without investors
example: The indie hacker earns less than our intern and smiles more than our CEO.

hindi: अनुमान — प्रशिक्षित मॉडल से उत्तर निकालने की प्रक्रिया
definition: running a trained model to get outputs, as opposed to training it
example: Training took a week; inference has to happen before the user finishes their rep.

hindi: मोड़-बिंदु — जहां से रुझान की दिशा या रफ्तार बदल जाए
definition: the moment a curve changes direction or accelerates
example: Every quarter is an inflection point if you squint.

hindi: प्रभावशाली प्रचारक — जिसके अनुयायी उसकी सिफ़ारिश मानें
definition: someone with an audience who promotes products to it, occasionally with disclosure
example: We paid an influencer to love the product for exactly one post.

hindi: सूचना संरचना — सामग्री का वर्गीकरण और ढांचा ताकि चीज़ें मिलें
definition: how content is organized, grouped, and labeled so people can find it
example: Settings has four levels of nesting; our information architecture needs therapy.

hindi: पहल — कई टीमों में फैला बड़ा रणनीतिक कार्य
definition: a large strategic effort that spans teams and usually several epics
example: Every quarter needs a flagship initiative and a name for it.

hindi: पाठ के बीच में — हर बिंदु के नीचे जवाब
definition: within the quoted text itself, where replies answer point by point
example: Replies inline in blue, as tradition demands.

hindi: इनपुट मापदंड — जिसे टीम सीधे बदल सके और जो नतीजों को चलाए
definition: a controllable driver metric that influences the outcomes you want
example: Ship more experiments is the input metric; revenue is the prayer.

hindi: मापन-व्यवस्था — उत्पाद में व्यवहार दर्ज करने वाला कोड
definition: the code added to a product so behavior can be measured
example: We shipped first and added instrumentation later, so history began Tuesday.

hindi: बीमा — नुक़सान की भरपाई का अनुबंधित सुरक्षा-कवच
definition: paid protection against specified losses or damages
example: Cyber insurance now costs more than the breach it covers.

hindi: अन्योन्यक्रिया डिज़ाइन — उपयोगकर्ता की क्रिया पर उत्पाद के व्यवहार की रचना
definition: designing how a product responds to what users do
example: Interaction design decides what happens on tap; ours chose 'nothing, silently'.

hindi: प्रशिक्षु — सीमित अवधि का प्रशिक्षण-कर्मचारी, अक्सर छात्र
definition: a temporary trainee, usually a student, doing real work for a summer
example: The intern's demo worked, which is more than the roadmap could say.

hindi: कंपनी के भीतर टीम या भूमिका बदलने की सुविधा
definition: moving between teams or roles inside the same company
example: Internal mobility is encouraged, once your manager stops blocking the transfer.

hindi: एक उम्मीदवार के लिए इंटरव्यू की पूरी शृंखला
definition: the full sequence of interviews a candidate goes through for one role
example: The interview loop was six rounds, which is five opinions too many.

hindi: निवेश सिद्धांत — किस क्षेत्र से बड़ा मुनाफ़ा आएगा, इसकी धारणा
definition: a fund's stated theory about where big returns will come from
example: Their investment thesis changed from crypto to AI in one weekend.

hindi: बीजक/बिल — किए गए काम के भुगतान की माँग का दस्तावेज़
definition: a document requesting payment for goods or services delivered
example: The agency's invoice arrived before their first deliverable did.

hindi: बिलिंग चक्र — बिल भेजने और भुगतान पाने की नियमित अवधि
definition: the recurring rhythm of sending invoices and collecting payment
example: Our invoice cycle is monthly; their payment cycle is theoretical.

hindi: बौद्धिक संपदा — कोड, डिज़ाइन, ब्रांड जैसी अमूर्त संपत्ति
definition: intellectual property; creations like code, designs, and brands the company owns
example: HR reminded us the hackathon project is company IP now.

hindi: आरंभिक सार्वजनिक निर्गम — कंपनी का शेयर बाज़ार में सूचीबद्ध होना
definition: initial public offering; when a private company lists its shares on a stock exchange
example: The IPO date moved three times; the party budget survived every move.

hindi: हमेशा DNS ही निकलता है — रहस्यमय गड़बड़ी का चिर-परिचित अपराधी
definition: the ops proverb that mysterious outages trace back to DNS, again
example: Three hours of debugging later: it's always DNS.

term: it's not a bug, it's a feature
hindi: बग नहीं, फ़ीचर है — खामी को खूबी बताने की क्लासिक दलील
definition: the classic reframing of a defect as intentional behavior
example: Users can order negative quantities. It's not a bug, it's a feature.

hindi: दोहराकर सुधारना — बार-बार संस्करण बेहतर करते जाना
definition: to improve something through repeated versions
example: Ship it rough, iterate weekly, apologize never.

hindi: पुनरावृत्ति — विकास का एक निश्चित चक्र, स्प्रिंट का समानार्थी
definition: one repeating development cycle; the vendor-neutral word for a sprint
example: We'll polish it in a future iteration, says everyone, always.

hindi: जेलब्रेक — मॉडल से उसके सुरक्षा नियम तुड़वाने की चाल
definition: a prompt trick that makes a model ignore its safety rules
example: A user jailbroke the coach into writing their biology homework; impressive, but no.

hindi: जल्दी-जल्दी नौकरियाँ बदलने की आदत — अक्सर वेतन बढ़ाने को
definition: changing employers every year or two, usually the fastest route to raises
example: Loyalty earned him 3 percent; job hopping earned his peers 30.

hindi: स्वीकृत भर्ती-पद — नौकरी खोलने की औपचारिक अनुमति
definition: an approved requisition to hire for a specific open role
example: The job req was open for six months, then quietly closed in the freeze.

hindi: कार्य-केंद्रित दृष्टि — ग्राहक उत्पाद को काम कराने के लिए 'किराए' पर लेता है
definition: a framework framing products as things users hire to get a job done
example: Jobs to be done says nobody wants a drill; they want the hole.

hindi: कार्य-केंद्रित सोच का संक्षिप्त रूप — उत्पाद किस काम के लिए चुना जाता है
definition: short for jobs to be done
example: The JTBD interview revealed users hire our app mostly out of habit.

hindi: बस हाल पूछ रहा हूँ — असल में जवाब की माँग
definition: a soft follow-up implying the deadline is quietly on fire
example: Just checking in on the draft you promised Monday.

hindi: के-फैक्टर — हर उपयोगकर्ता औसतन कितने नए लाता है, उसका गुणांक
definition: how many new users each existing user brings in
example: A k-factor above one is the dream; ours is a rounding error.

hindi: कानबान — कार्ड और कॉलम से प्रवाह दिखाती निरंतर कार्य-प्रणाली
definition: a method visualizing work as cards flowing across columns, limiting work in progress
example: We switched to kanban so the unfinished work could be seen.

hindi: काम चालू रखना — नयापन नहीं, बस ज़रूरी संचालन
definition: to do the minimum maintenance that keeps operations running
example: Half the budget just keeps the lights on.

term: kick the can down the road
hindi: टालमटोल — कठिन फ़ैसला आगे के लिए सरकाना
definition: to defer a hard decision for someone future to handle
example: We kicked the pricing decision down the road again.

hindi: शुभारंभ बैठक — परियोजना की पहली औपचारिक बैठक
definition: the opening meeting where a project's optimism peaks
example: Great kickoff; the project now begins its long descent into scope.

hindi: बंद कर देना — परियोजना या सुविधा को सीधे समाप्त करना
definition: to cancel a feature or project outright
example: Someone has to kill this feature; it's been on life support since v2.

hindi: आपात स्विच — बिगड़ैल फ़ीचर तुरंत बंद करने का बटन
definition: a control that instantly disables a feature when it misbehaves
example: New feature, new kill switch, old trust issues.

hindi: कृपया — विनम्र आदेश का शब्द
definition: please, in formal Indian office English; softens any command
example: Kindly share the updated tracker by noon.

hindi: सरल रखो — बेवजह की चतुराई से बचो (keep it simple, stupid)
definition: keep it simple, stupid; resist cleverness nobody can maintain
example: KISS, he said, deleting my beautiful abstraction.

hindi: भद्दा जुगाड़ — बेढंगा जोड़-तोड़ जो किसी तरह चलता है
definition: an ugly, awkward patchwork solution that somehow functions
example: The sync system is a kludge held together by cron jobs and hope.

hindi: ज्ञान सीमा-तिथि — इस तारीख़ के बाद की दुनिया से मॉडल अनजान
definition: the date after which a model's training data ends and it knows nothing
example: It recommends last year's fitness trends — blame the knowledge cutoff.

hindi: जाते हुए कर्मचारी से जानकारी हस्तांतरित करने की प्रक्रिया
definition: the rushed ritual of extracting what a departing employee knows
example: Two years of context, one week of knowledge transfer meetings.

hindi: मुख्य प्रदर्शन संकेतक — सफलता नापने का चुना हुआ आँकड़ा
definition: key performance indicator; a number chosen to represent success
example: Every team has five KPIs and full confidence in maybe one.

hindi: परिचालन कार्य — सिस्टम चालू रखने का नियमित रखरखाव
definition: keep the lights on; the maintenance work that funds no promotions
example: Half our capacity is KTLO before any roadmap work starts.

hindi: पश्च संकेतक — घट चुके नतीजे की पुष्टि करने वाला आँकड़ा
definition: a metric that confirms what already happened
example: Revenue is a lagging indicator, and this quarter it lags with feeling.

hindi: छोटे से शुरू, फिर विस्तार — पहले घुसो, फिर बढ़ते जाओ
definition: start with a small deal, then grow revenue inside the account over time
example: Land and expand: sell to one team, then appear in every budget meeting.

hindi: अभियान-पृष्ठ — एक ही कार्रवाई के लिए बना वेबपेज
definition: a single-purpose web page built to convert a campaign's visitors into leads
example: The landing page has one button and, somehow, three stakeholders.

hindi: विलंब बजट — जवाब में अधिकतम स्वीकार्य देरी की सीमा
definition: the maximum response time a feature is allowed before users feel it
example: Rep feedback has a 200-millisecond latency budget; philosophy can take a second.

hindi: समान स्तर पर भूमिका-परिवर्तन — पदोन्नति नहीं
definition: changing roles at the same level, trading novelty for no raise
example: The lateral move gave her a new team and the same band.

hindi: उत्पाद को पहली बार बाज़ार में उतारना
definition: to release a product to the public for the first time
example: We launch Tuesday, assuming nothing breaks Monday night, which it will.

hindi: लॉन्च अभियान — नए उत्पाद के प्रचार की समन्वित मुहिम
definition: the coordinated marketing push around a product release
example: The launch campaign is ready; the product is 'day-one patchable.'

hindi: विमोचन दिवस — उत्पाद के सार्वजनिक होने का दिन
definition: the day the product finally goes public
example: Launch day plan: press release at nine, hotfix by noon.

hindi: आर्थिक कारणों से कर्मचारियों की छँटनी
definition: terminating employees for business reasons rather than performance
example: The layoff email began with 'our greatest asset has always been people'.

hindi: संभावित ग्राहक — जिसने उत्पाद में रुचि दिखाई हो
definition: a person or company that has shown interest and might become a customer
example: Half the leads from the webinar were students and one was our own intern.

hindi: लीड सृजन — संभावित ग्राहकों की जानकारी जुटाना
definition: lead generation — activities that collect contact info from potential buyers
example: The ebook is lead gen: twelve pages of content, one page of form.

hindi: मुख्य निवेशक — जो दौर की शर्तें तय करता और बाक़ियों को जोड़ता है
definition: the investor who sets the round's terms and brings others along
example: Everyone's interested, but nobody wants to be the lead investor.

hindi: लीड-चुंबक — ईमेल पते के बदले मुफ़्त सामग्री
definition: a free resource offered in exchange for contact details
example: The lead magnet is a 'free guide' that costs exactly one email address.

hindi: लीड का अंक-निर्धारण — रुचि के आधार पर प्राथमिकता
definition: ranking leads by fit and behavior so sales calls the likeliest first
example: Lead scoring gave the intern 98 points for opening our email eleven times.

hindi: लीड समय — अनुरोध से आपूर्ति तक की कुल अवधि
definition: the clock from request to delivery, as customers experience it
example: Lead time on small requests is a quarter, somehow.

hindi: अग्रिम संकेतक — भविष्य के नतीजों की पहले झलक देने वाला आँकड़ा
definition: a metric that moves early and hints where results are heading
example: Signups are our leading indicator; dread is our lagging one.

hindi: दुबला स्टार्टअप तरीक़ा — बड़े प्लान की जगह छोटे तेज़ प्रयोग
definition: a method of building through rapid experiments and validated learning, not big upfront plans
example: Lean startup in practice: ship the test on Tuesday, apologize on Wednesday.

hindi: सीखें — अनुभव से निकले सबक़; 'lessons' का कॉर्पोरेट रूप
definition: lessons taken from an experience; grammatically suspect, universally used
example: The launch failed, but we documented the learnings.

hindi: विरासती कोड — पुराना चालू कोड जिसे छूने से सब डरते हैं
definition: old code that still runs the business and terrifies everyone who touches it
example: Legacy code is just code that makes money, unfortunately.

hindi: क़ानूनी समीक्षा — जोखिम के लिए वकीलों की जाँच
definition: having lawyers examine something for risk before it ships or is signed
example: The blog post is in legal review, so see you next month.

hindi: क़ानूनी भाषा — आम इंसान को समझ न आने वाली शब्दावली
definition: dense legal jargon ordinary humans cannot parse
example: The one-page agreement is forty pages of legalese now.

hindi: नौकरी से निकालना — 'जाने देना' कहकर
definition: fired or laid off, softened to sound like releasing a bird
example: They let him go, as if he'd been asking to leave.

hindi: साझा समझ बनाना — सबको एक ही जानकारी पर लाना
definition: to establish a shared understanding before discussing further
example: Before we debate, let's level set on what actually shipped.

hindi: कर्मचारी का स्तर तय करना — वेतन और अपेक्षाएँ उसी से जुड़ी
definition: assigning an employee a level that sets their pay and expectations
example: Two identical engineers, two different levelings, one awkward lunch.

hindi: इस्तेमाल करना — किसी मौजूदा चीज़ से ज़्यादा फ़ायदा उठाना
definition: to use something existing for advantage; corporate for 'use'
example: We should leverage the existing design system instead of rebuilding it.

hindi: मुझे ठीक लगता है — कोड समीक्षा की स्वीकृति (looks good to me)
definition: looks good to me; the reviewer's stamp of approval on a change
example: He typed LGTM forty seconds after I opened the pull request.

hindi: देयता/जोखिम — क़ानूनी या वित्तीय ज़िम्मेदारी
definition: legal or financial responsibility for something that could go wrong
example: Legal calls the old admin panel a liability; we call it Tuesday.

hindi: लाइसेंसिंग — शुल्क लेकर उपयोग की अनुमति देना
definition: granting permission to use software or IP, usually for a fee
example: Our licensing model has four tiers and zero clarity.

hindi: जीवनशैली व्यवसाय — मालिक के आराम के लिए, अनंत विस्तार के लिए नहीं
definition: a business built to fund its owner's life, not to scale endlessly
example: He calls it a lifestyle business; his VC friends call it a tragedy.

hindi: बढ़त — किसी बदलाव के खाते में गई आँकड़े की वृद्धि
definition: the increase in a metric credited to a specific change
example: The lift vanished the week after launch, as lifts do.

hindi: जस का तस स्थानांतरण — बिना बदले क्लाउड पर उठा धरना
definition: moving a system to new infrastructure unchanged, problems lovingly preserved
example: The lift and shift moved our tech debt to the cloud intact.

hindi: मद — बजट या बिल की एक अलग प्रविष्टि
definition: a single entry in a budget or invoice
example: Snacks are now a line item, so eat responsibly.

hindi: पहले भुगतान का हक़ — बिक्री पर निवेशक को सबसे पहले पैसा
definition: the investor's right to get paid back first when the company sells
example: The exit made headlines; after liquidation preferences, the founders made lunch money.

hindi: तरलता घटना — काग़ज़ी हिस्सेदारी का असली पैसे में बदलना
definition: any transaction that converts paper equity into actual money
example: HR calls it a liquidity event; employees call it finally buying a car.

hindi: सूचीबद्ध मूल्य — छूट से पहले का आधिकारिक दाम
definition: the official published price nobody actually pays
example: List price exists mainly so the discount has something to be subtracted from.

hindi: विशाल भाषा मॉडल — आधुनिक एआई सहायकों का मूल इंजन
definition: large language model; the text-predicting engine behind modern AI assistants
example: We swapped LLMs over the weekend and nobody noticed, which is either great or terrifying.

hindi: एलएलएम-निर्णायक — एक मॉडल से दूसरे मॉडल के उत्तर जँचवाना
definition: using one language model to grade another model's outputs at scale
example: LLM-as-judge scores the coach's replies, and yes, we eval the judge too.

hindi: मुझे बता देना — जवाब मिले तो सूचित करें
definition: let me know — tell me once you have an answer
example: LMK if the numbers look off before I present them.

hindi: स्थानीयकरण — उत्पाद को हर बाज़ार की भाषा-संस्कृति के अनुरूप ढालना
definition: adapting a product's language, formats, and content for each market
example: Localization is more than translation, as our German buttons discovered.

hindi: प्रयास स्तर — काम में लगने वाली मेहनत का अनुमान
definition: level of effort; how much work something takes, in vague units
example: Give me a rough LOE before we promise it to the board.

hindi: ग्राहक कंपनी — नाम गिनाने लायक़ क्लाइंट
definition: a customer, counted as a brand name you can display on the website
example: The deal barely broke even, but it's a great logo for the homepage.

hindi: ग्राहक-संख्या छीजन — राजस्व नहीं, कितनी कंपनियां गईं इसकी गिनती
definition: customer accounts lost, counted by company rather than revenue
example: Revenue churn is fine; logo churn says the small customers are fleeing.

hindi: सबसे लंबा काम — पूरी समयसीमा तय करने वाला सबसे धीमा हिस्सा
definition: the slowest piece of work, the one that determines when everything ships
example: Compliance review is the long pole, as always.

hindi: रंग-रूप और अनुभव — उत्पाद की समग्र छवि और एहसास
definition: the overall visual style and experiential character of a product
example: The client loves the look and feel, just wants both changed.

hindi: शामिल करना — किसी को बातचीत की जानकारी में जोड़ना
definition: to bring someone into a conversation they will need
example: Loop in legal early; they bill by the surprise.

hindi: स्थानधारक पाठ — असली सामग्री की जगह भरा जाने वाला नकली लैटिन
definition: placeholder Latin text used before real copy exists
example: The lorem ipsum shipped to production, where it reads better than our copy.

hindi: अपेक्षा से कम काम कर पाने वाला कर्मचारी — अक्सर PIP की ओर
definition: an employee rated as underdelivering, often the first step toward a PIP
example: The new metric reclassified half the org as low performers overnight.

hindi: अल्प-विस्तार — मोटे तौर पर विचार परखने भर का खाका
definition: rough and sketch-like, meant to test ideas cheaply
example: Keep it low-fidelity so stakeholders comment on the flow, not the font.

hindi: आसान निशाना — कम मेहनत में मिलने वाला फ़ायदा
definition: the easiest wins available, requiring minimal effort
example: Let's grab the low-hanging fruit before redesigning the whole flow.

hindi: जानबूझकर बहुत कम पेशकश करना
definition: to offer noticeably below market, hoping the candidate doesn't know better
example: They lowballed her, then acted surprised when she had competing offers.

hindi: सीमित साझेदार — वे संस्थाएँ जिनका पैसा VC फ़ंड लगाते हैं
definition: limited partner; the institutions and individuals whose money VC funds invest
example: When markets dip, even VCs have to call their LPs gently.

hindi: ग्राहक जीवनकाल मूल्य — एक ग्राहक से कुल अपेक्षित कमाई
definition: lifetime value; total revenue expected from one customer
example: LTV exceeds CAC in the model, which is where it lives.

hindi: भोजन-संग-शिक्षण — लंच पर ज्ञान सत्र
definition: a talk over lunch where someone teaches the team something
example: Friday's lunch and learn covers our new billing system.

hindi: विलय और अधिग्रहण — कंपनियों की ख़रीद-फ़रोख़्त
definition: mergers and acquisitions; the business of buying and combining companies
example: The M&A team showed up, and everyone updated their resumes quietly.

hindi: मशीन लर्निंग — नियम लिखने के बजाय डेटा से पैटर्न सीखना
definition: systems that learn patterns from data instead of following hand-written rules
example: It's machine learning when it works and 'the algorithm' when it doesn't.

hindi: जादुई संख्या — कोड में बिना व्याख्या पड़ा नंगा स्थिरांक
definition: an unexplained constant hardcoded where a named value should be
example: Why 86400? The magic number knows; the author doesn't.

hindi: निर्माता-समय — रचना हेतु लंबे अखंड घंटे
definition: long unbroken work blocks creators need, unlike managers' hour-sliced calendars
example: One 3 p.m. meeting can wreck an afternoon of maker time.

hindi: प्रबंधक — टीम के लोगों और नतीजों का ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति
definition: the person accountable for a team's output, growth, and bad news delivery
example: A good manager blocks the chaos; a bad one forwards it.

hindi: बिना निकाले इस्तीफे की ओर धकेलना
definition: engineering someone's exit through pressure and paperwork instead of firing them
example: No one fired him; managing out just made staying unbearable.

hindi: अनिवार्य करना — ऊपर से आदेश के रूप में लागू करना
definition: to require something by order from above
example: They mandated the tool; adoption remains a suggestion.

hindi: अनिवार्य मनोरंजन — जबरन टीम-बिल्डिंग गतिविधि
definition: compulsory team-building activities, enjoyment attendance required
example: Thursday's mandatory fun is trivia; attendance is tracked.

hindi: मुनाफ़े का अंतर — बिक्री मूल्य में से लागत घटाकर बचा हिस्सा
definition: the share of revenue left after costs
example: Every discount comes straight out of the margin, sales.

hindi: मंच बाज़ार — ख़रीदार-विक्रेता को जोड़कर हर सौदे से कमीशन
definition: a platform connecting buyers and sellers and taking a cut of each transaction
example: The marketplace takes fifteen percent and, in exchange, both sides blame us.

hindi: दोहरी रिपोर्टिंग वाला संगठन — काम और विभाग के अलग-अलग बॉस
definition: a structure where people answer to both a functional manager and a project lead
example: In our matrix organization, I need two approvals to take Friday off.

hindi: मासिक सक्रिय उपयोगकर्ता — महीने में कम से कम एक बार आने वाले
definition: monthly active users; unique people active at least once a month
example: MAU looks great if you never ask what active means.

hindi: न्यूनतम पकड़ने योग्य असर — प्रयोग जो सबसे छोटा बदलाव भांप सके
definition: minimum detectable effect; the smallest change an experiment can reliably measure
example: Our MDE is five percent; our hoped-for lift is one.

hindi: बैठक-फैलाव — मीटिंगों का धीरे-धीरे बढ़ना
definition: the gradual growth of meetings in number, length, or attendees
example: Meeting creep turned thirty minutes into an hour with twelve guests.

hindi: बैठक-थकान — अत्यधिक मीटिंगों से क्लांति
definition: exhaustion from too many meetings in a day or week
example: By Thursday the meeting fatigue is visible on every face.

hindi: बैठक-स्वच्छता — एजेंडा, समयपालन और स्पष्ट नतीजे
definition: good habits like agendas, punctuality, and clear outcomes
example: Basic meeting hygiene: an agenda, an owner, an end time.

hindi: बैठक-बोझिल — मीटिंगों से लदा कार्यक्रम
definition: having a schedule dominated by meetings
example: Product is a meeting-heavy job; bring snacks and opinions.

hindi: अपेक्षाओं के अनुरूप — ठीक-ठाक रेटिंग जो तारीफ नहीं लगती
definition: the middle rating; officially fine, emotionally deflating
example: A year of weekends distilled into 'meets expectations'.

hindi: आंतरिक सूचना-पत्र — निर्णय की लिखित सूचना
definition: a short internal document announcing or explaining a decision
example: The reorg memo raised more questions than it answered.
