hindi: मानसिक थकान उतारने की छुट्टी
definition: a day off to recover from stress rather than physical illness
example: After the launch, the whole team quietly took mental health days in shifts.

hindi: मानसिक प्रतिरूप — चीज़ कैसे काम करती है इसकी उपयोगकर्ता की धारणा
definition: the user's internal idea of how something works
example: Users' mental model says trash is recoverable; our delete button thinks otherwise.

hindi: मार्गदर्शक — अनुभव से सलाह देने वाला सहयोगी
definition: an experienced colleague who gives guidance, distinct from one who wields influence
example: Her mentor's best advice was to go find a sponsor.

hindi: मर्ज टकराव — दो लोगों के बदलाव आपस में भिड़ना
definition: when two people's changes collide and someone must reconcile them by hand
example: Nothing bonds a team like a three-way merge conflict at 6 pm.

hindi: संदेश-निर्धारण — ग्राहकों से क्या और कैसे कहना है
definition: the agreed set of words a company uses to describe itself and its value
example: Marketing spent two weeks on messaging; sales still says 'it's like email, but better.'

hindi: सूक्ष्म पाठ — बटनों, फ़ॉर्मों और त्रुटियों के छोटे-छोटे शब्द
definition: the tiny words on buttons, forms, and error messages
example: Good microcopy is why users forgive you; ours says 'Error 402'.

hindi: सूक्ष्म अन्योन्यक्रिया — छोटी क्रिया पर छोटी, संतोषजनक प्रतिक्रिया
definition: a small moment of feedback, like a toggle animating on tap
example: The like-button microinteraction got two sprints; search got a shrug.

hindi: हर छोटे काम पर नियंत्रण — भरोसे की जगह निगरानी
definition: supervising every small detail instead of trusting people with outcomes
example: The micromanagement was so thorough it needed its own status meeting.

hindi: सूक्ष्म-सेवाएँ — छोटी स्वतंत्र सेवाओं में बँटा वास्तुशिल्प
definition: an architecture of many small independent services, trading one problem for a distributed one
example: We split the monolith into forty microservices and one shared outage.

hindi: मध्यम बाज़ार — छोटे और विशाल ग्राहकों के बीच का वर्ग
definition: the segment between SMB and enterprise, big enough to pay, small enough to decide
example: Mid-market: enterprise expectations, SMB budgets.

hindi: मील का पत्थर — परियोजना की महत्वपूर्ण पड़ाव-तिथि
definition: a significant checkpoint marking real progress in a project
example: We hit the milestone by moving the milestone.

hindi: न्यूनतम प्रिय उत्पाद — छोटा मगर दिल जीतने लायक संस्करण
definition: the smallest version users would actually love, not merely tolerate
example: We aimed for minimum lovable product and shipped minimum, mostly.

hindi: कार्यवृत्त — बैठक की लिखित कार्यवाही
definition: the written record of what a meeting discussed and decided
example: The minutes say we agreed; my memory disagrees.

hindi: अति आवश्यक — जिसके बिना कामकाज ठप हो जाए
definition: essential to operations; failure is not survivable
example: The spreadsheet nobody understands is, of course, mission-critical.

hindi: उपशमन — जोखिम का असर घटाने की योजना
definition: the plan for softening a risk you can't eliminate
example: Our mitigation for the deadline risk is hope, documented.

hindi: एमएलऑप्स — उत्पादन में मॉडल चलाने और सँभालने की इंजीनियरिंग
definition: the engineering practice of deploying, monitoring, and maintaining machine learning in production
example: MLOps is DevOps plus the model quietly getting worse for no visible reason.

hindi: सुरक्षा खाई — प्रतिस्पर्धियों से कारोबार बचाने वाली स्थायी बढ़त
definition: a durable advantage that protects a business from competitors
example: Our moat, according to the deck, is 'passion'; according to finance, nothing.

hindi: समूह प्रोग्रामिंग — पूरी टीम मिलकर एक ही कोड पर
definition: the whole team collaborating on one piece of code at one screen
example: Mob programming today, so bring opinions and snacks.

hindi: मोबाइल-प्रथम — छोटी स्क्रीन से डिज़ाइन शुरू करने की रीति
definition: designing for small screens first, then scaling up
example: We're mobile-first, which is why the desktop app feels like a stretched phone.

hindi: प्रतिरूप — स्क्रीन कैसी दिखेगी उसका स्थिर, विस्तृत चित्र
definition: a static, detailed picture of what a screen will look like
example: The mockup looks great; now someone has to actually build it.

hindi: अवरोधक संवाद-बॉक्स — बाकी स्क्रीन रोककर ध्यान माँगने वाला पॉपअप
definition: a popup that blocks the page until the user deals with it
example: A modal opened over the modal; the designer has been notified.

hindi: मॉडल — डेटा से सीखा हुआ तंत्र जो इनपुट से अनुमान या उत्तर बनाता है
definition: a trained system that turns input data into predictions or generated output
example: The new model nails squats but still thinks a lunge is a yoga pose.

hindi: मॉडल कार्ड — मॉडल का उद्देश्य, डेटा और सीमाएँ बताने वाला दस्तावेज़
definition: a short document describing a model's purpose, training data, limits, and risks
example: The model card admits it struggles with pilates; respect the honesty.

hindi: बंदर-पैच — चलते सिस्टम का व्यवहार बाहर से बदल देना
definition: a runtime modification of existing code from outside, powerful and regrettable
example: The monkey patch fixed the library and broke two others.

hindi: एकाश्म सिस्टम — सब कुछ एक ही बड़े ऐप में
definition: a single large application containing everything, unfashionable yet frequently victorious
example: The monolith outlived three plans to kill it.

hindi: एकल भंडार — सारा कोड एक ही रिपॉज़िटरी में
definition: one repository holding all the company's code
example: The monorepo clone takes forty minutes, great coffee culture though.

hindi: माह-दर-माह — पिछले महीने से तुलना करके
definition: compared with the previous month
example: Month-over-month looks bad, so this review is quarterly now.

hindi: भाव-फलक — शैली की दिशा तय करने वाला चित्र-संग्रह
definition: a collage of images setting a design's visual direction
example: The moodboard is beaches and serenity; the product is expense reports.

hindi: मुख्य नौकरी के साथ-साथ दूसरा काम करना
definition: working a second job alongside your main one, often quietly
example: His side app made money, so legal called it moonlighting.

hindi: चाँद-निशाना — कम संभावना, विशाल इनाम वाला महत्वाकांक्षी दाँव
definition: a wildly ambitious project with low odds and enormous payoff
example: The moonshot got a lab, a name, and no deadline anyone believes.

hindi: मॉस्को विधि — must, should, could, won't में प्राथमिकता बाँटना
definition: prioritizing requirements into must, should, could, and won't have
example: After MoSCoW, everything landed in must, defeating the entire method.

hindi: माउस हिलाने वाला जुगाड़ — ऑनलाइन दिखने की तरकीब
definition: a device or app keeping your status active while you are away
example: The mouse jiggler keeps him green during school pickup.

hindi: तेज़ चलो, टूटे तो टूटे — रफ़्तार को स्थिरता से ऊपर रखना
definition: the ethos of prioritizing speed over stability, consequences later
example: We moved fast and broke things, mostly the login page.

hindi: असर डालना — नतीजों में दिखने लायक़ बदलाव लाना
definition: to produce a measurable, noticeable improvement
example: A new logo won't move the needle on revenue.

hindi: कई हिस्सों वाला — जितने हिस्से, उतनी टूटने की जगहें
definition: the many interdependent pieces that make something fragile
example: This launch has too many moving parts and one intern.

hindi: मार्केटिंग द्वारा परखा संभावित ग्राहक — रुचि के संकेतों के आधार पर
definition: marketing-qualified lead — someone whose engagement suggests they may be worth sales attention
example: Downloading one ebook made me an MQL; now I get three emails a day.

hindi: मासिक आवर्ती राजस्व — हर महीने दोहराई जाने वाली कमाई
definition: monthly recurring revenue from subscriptions
example: MRR dipped, so the all-hands is now a listening tour.

hindi: मुख्य सेवा समझौता — भविष्य के सब कामों की छतरी-शर्तें
definition: master service agreement; umbrella terms covering all future work with a vendor
example: The MSA took four months; the actual project took three.

hindi: बहु-एजेंट — मिलकर या एक-दूसरे को जाँचते हुए काम करते कई एआई
definition: several AI agents cooperating or checking each other to finish a task
example: Our multi-agent setup: one plans workouts, one checks safety, one apologizes for the others.

hindi: कई संपर्क साधना — ग्राहक कंपनी में अनेक रिश्ते बनाना
definition: building relationships with several stakeholders in an account so one departure can't kill the deal
example: Multi-threading saved the deal when our champion left for a competitor.

hindi: बहु-माध्यम — पाठ, चित्र और ध्वनि सब एक साथ समझने वाला
definition: handling multiple input or output types — text, images, audio, video — in one model
example: The multimodal model reads your form video and roasts your lunge in writing.

hindi: बहु-चर परीक्षण — कई बदलावों के मेल एक साथ आज़माने वाला प्रयोग
definition: an experiment testing several element combinations at once
example: The multivariate test needs traffic we will have by 2031.

hindi: सूचनाएँ बंद करना — बिना छोड़े चुप कराना
definition: to silence a channel or thread's notifications while staying in it
example: I muted the celebrations channel during quarter close.

hindi: न्यूनतम व्यवहार्य उत्पाद — सबसे सादा संस्करण जिससे माँग परखी जाए
definition: minimum viable product; the simplest version that lets you test real demand
example: The MVP is a spreadsheet and a phone number, and it works.

hindi: एक का नमूना — सिर्फ एक उदाहरण से निकाला गया निष्कर्ष
definition: a conclusion drawn from a single example
example: The CEO's neighbor hated the onboarding; n=1 became the roadmap.

hindi: चिह्नित बड़ा ग्राहक — विशेष रणनीति वाला खाता
definition: a high-value target company assigned to a specific rep with a specific plan
example: It's a named account, which means two VPs also claim credit for it.

hindi: मार्गदर्शन ढांचा — उत्पाद में इधर-उधर जाने के रास्ते
definition: the menus and links that let users move around a product
example: If users need a tutorial for the navigation, the navigation failed.

hindi: गोपनीयता समझौता — कंपनी की जानकारी बाहर न बताने का क़रार
definition: non-disclosure agreement; a contract to keep shared information secret
example: Sign the NDA before we show you the roadmap we'll abandon.

hindi: पड़ोसी देश से काम — मिलते-जुलते समय-क्षेत्र वाले देश को काम देना
definition: outsourcing to a nearby country with overlapping working hours
example: We tried nearshoring so standup could stay in daylight.

hindi: नकारात्मक छीजन — मौजूदा ग्राहकों की बढ़त का छोड़ने वालों से भारी पड़ना
definition: when expansion revenue from existing customers exceeds losses from departures
example: Negative churn is the goal; ours is aggressively positive.

hindi: मोल-भाव करना — शर्तों पर सौदेबाज़ी करना
definition: to bargain over terms until both sides can live with them
example: Never negotiate the renewal in December; they smell the deadline.

hindi: वेतन और शर्तों पर मोल-भाव
definition: the back-and-forth over salary, equity, and terms before accepting an offer
example: One email of negotiation was worth more than last year's entire raise.

hindi: दिलचस्प जाल में फँसाना — ऐसी पहेली फेंकना कि इंजीनियर सब छोड़ बैठे
definition: to derail an engineer by presenting a problem too interesting to ignore
example: One casual puzzle nerd-sniped three engineers for an afternoon.

hindi: तीस दिन में भुगतान — बिल की तारीख़ से 30 दिन की मोहलत
definition: payment terms giving the buyer thirty days after the invoice date
example: Net-30 means day 29 for them and rent day for us.

hindi: नेटवर्क प्रभाव — हर नया उपयोगकर्ता सबके लिए मूल्य बढ़ाता है
definition: when each new user makes the product more valuable for everyone else
example: Network effects are great once you have a network; therein lies the job.

hindi: तंत्रिका जाल — परतों में जुड़ी इकाइयों से बना सीखने वाला ढाँचा
definition: a model built from layers of simple units that learn patterns together
example: The neural network learned squat form from ten thousand wobbly videos.

hindi: हाल में डिग्री पूरी कर पहली नौकरी में आया कर्मचारी
definition: an entry-level hire fresh out of university
example: The new grad fixed the flaky test everyone else had learned to ignore.

hindi: अगले क़दम — आगे क्या करना है, उसकी सूची
definition: the agreed actions that follow a meeting
example: Let's end with next steps so this hour counted for something.

hindi: अच्छा-हो-तो — ज़रूरी नहीं, पर वांछनीय सुविधा
definition: a feature everyone wants and nobody will fund
example: It got labeled a nice-to-have, which is how features are euthanized.

hindi: यहाँ-का-नहीं रोग — बाहरी समाधान ठुकराकर खुद बनाना (not invented here)
definition: rejecting outside solutions to build your own, because it wasn't invented here
example: Classic NIH syndrome: we rebuilt the database, badly.

hindi: निंजा डेवलपर — चुपचाप कमाल दिखाने वाले का चलताऊ (अब व्यंग्य) खिताब
definition: ironic job-ad title for a developer with quietly magical skills
example: We hired a code ninja; he vanished, like a real ninja.

hindi: छोटी-सी आपत्ति — समीक्षा में मामूली, न रोकने वाली टिप्पणी
definition: a trivial review comment the author may fix or ignore without blocking approval
example: Nit: extra blank line on 42. Otherwise LGTM.

hindi: प्राकृतिक भाषा संसाधन — मशीन से इंसानी भाषा समझवाने का क्षेत्र
definition: natural language processing; the field of making software understand human language
example: Before LLMs, our NLP was a regex file everyone was afraid to open.

hindi: कुछ करना नहीं — केवल सूचना
definition: reassurance that this message is purely informational, breathe easy
example: Weekly status attached, no action needed unless something looks wrong.

hindi: बिना सोचे हाँ — इतना साफ़ फ़ैसला कि सोचना न पड़े
definition: a decision so obvious it needs no thought
example: Fixing the checkout bug first is a no-brainer.

hindi: बैठक-मुक्त दिवस — पूरे दिन कोई मीटिंग नहीं
definition: a weekday the team keeps free of all meetings
example: Wednesday is no-meeting day, except for the exceptions.

hindi: ग़ैरहाज़िर — स्वीकार करके भी न आने वाला
definition: someone who accepts a meeting and never appears
example: The organizer was the no-show, which is a bold move.

hindi: प्रतिस्पर्धा-निषेध — प्रतिद्वंद्वी के यहाँ काम करने पर रोक की शर्त
definition: a clause restricting you from joining or starting a competitor
example: His non-compete covers an industry he's eager to leave anyway.

hindi: अनियत — एक ही सवाल पर हर बार अलग जवाब देने वाला
definition: giving different outputs for the same input, as language models often do
example: The bug isn't reproducible because the model is non-deterministic — QA loves that.

hindi: सिरे से ख़ारिज — ऐसा प्रस्ताव जो शुरू ही नहीं हो सकता
definition: an idea with no chance of acceptance
example: Doubling the budget is a non-starter this quarter.

hindi: ध्रुव तारा — दिशा दिखाने वाला सबसे बड़ा लक्ष्य
definition: the single guiding goal everything else should serve
example: Weekly active users is our north star, until the next offsite.

hindi: ध्रुवतारा सुविधा — उत्पाद की पहचान बनाने वाली केंद्रीय खूबी
definition: the defining capability a product is known and chosen for
example: Search is our north-star feature, which is awkward given its results.

hindi: ध्रुवतारा मापदंड — कंपनी की असली प्रगति दिखाने वाला एक प्रमुख आँकड़ा
definition: the single metric a company treats as its truest measure of value delivered
example: We changed our north-star metric twice this year, which says something.

hindi: नोट कर लिया — सुना, मानना अलग बात
definition: message received and filed; agreement not included
example: Noted. I'll raise it again when the budget reopens.

hindi: इस्तीफे और आख़िरी दिन के बीच की अवधि
definition: the time between resigning and your actual last day
example: Her notice period was two weeks of handover and goodbye lunches.

hindi: नवीनता प्रभाव — सिर्फ नएपन की वजह से आया अस्थायी उछाल
definition: a temporary lift caused by newness rather than lasting value
example: Week one loved it; the novelty effect resigned by week three.

hindi: कोई बात नहीं — सहर्ष स्वीकृति
definition: no problem — an easy yes, or a gracious you're-welcome
example: NP, I'll swap my slot with yours.

hindi: नेट प्रमोटर स्कोर — ग्राहक सिफारिश करने को कितने तैयार, इसका पैमाना
definition: net promoter score; how likely customers are to recommend you
example: NPS rose two points, so the survey link moved above the fold.

hindi: शुद्ध राजस्व प्रतिधारण — मौजूदा ग्राहकों से बचा और बढ़ा राजस्व
definition: net revenue retention; revenue kept and grown from existing customers
example: NRR above one hundred means expansion is outrunning churn, briefly.

hindi: हल्के से याद दिलाना — बिना डाँटे टोकना
definition: to gently remind someone about something they have not done yet
example: Nudge me on Thursday if I haven't replied by then.

hindi: धीरे-धीरे रुचि पकाना — लीड को ख़रीदने लायक़ तैयार करना
definition: to keep unready leads warm with helpful content until they can buy
example: We're nurturing that lead, which is marketing for 'emailing them monthly forever.'

hindi: आपत्तियों का जवाब — ग्राहक की शंकाएँ दूर करना
definition: responding to a prospect's concerns about price, timing, or competitors without flinching
example: Objection handling 101: 'too expensive' usually means 'convince me it's worth it.'

hindi: एक-का-हेरफेर — गिनती में ठीक एक से चूकने की क्लासिक भूल
definition: the classic error of counting one too many or too few
example: The two hard problems: naming, cache invalidation, and off-by-one errors.

hindi: कार्येतर समय — दफ़्तरी घंटों से बाहर
definition: time outside the normal working day
example: Deploy freezes exist so off-hours stay off.

hindi: विदा हो रहे कर्मचारी से एक्सेस और सामान वापस लेने की प्रक्रिया
definition: the process of removing a departing employee's access, badge, and responsibilities
example: Offboarding took ten minutes; getting laptop access had taken three weeks.

hindi: नौकरी का औपचारिक प्रस्ताव — वेतन और शर्तों सहित
definition: a formal proposal of employment with compensation and terms
example: The offer arrived Friday at 5 p.m., expiring Monday at 9.

hindi: खुला परामर्श समय — कोई भी सवाल लेकर आ सकता है
definition: a standing open slot where anyone can drop in with questions
example: Bring your API questions to the platform team's office hours.

hindi: दफ़्तर की गुटबाज़ी और प्रभाव का खेल
definition: the informal maneuvering for influence that no org chart shows
example: He said he stays out of office politics, which is itself a strategy.

hindi: विदेश में काम कराना — लागत घटाने को काम दूसरे देश ले जाना
definition: moving work to another country, usually to cut costs
example: Offshoring saved money until the timezone math arrived.

hindi: बाहरी बैठक — दफ़्तर से दूर रणनीति और टीम-जुड़ाव
definition: a work retreat away from the office for strategy or bonding
example: The strategy emerged at the offsite; it stayed there too.

hindi: लक्ष्य और मुख्य परिणाम — प्रगति नापने का ढांचा
definition: objectives and key results; a goal paired with measurable outcomes
example: The OKR promised a retention lift; the dashboard disagrees.

hindi: काम पर लग गया — ज़िम्मा ले लिया
definition: confirmation that you've taken the task and started
example: On it — fix going out within the hour.

hindi: नज़र में है — ध्यान में है, भले अभी कार्रवाई न हो
definition: known and being tracked, though not yet acted on
example: The bug is on my radar, right behind forty other things.

hindi: एक राय पर — सबकी समझ एक जैसी होना
definition: sharing the same understanding
example: Quick call to make sure we're on the same page?

hindi: पटरी पर — योजना के अनुसार चल रहा
definition: proceeding according to plan, or at least reported that way
example: We're on track, assuming the track moves with us.

hindi: आपात ड्यूटी — तय अवधि में अलर्ट सँभालने की ज़िम्मेदारी
definition: the rotation duty of answering production alerts, day or night
example: I'm on-call this week, so my phone sleeps closer than my spouse.

hindi: डिवाइस-स्थित — बिना सर्वर भेजे फ़ोन या घड़ी पर ही प्रोसेसिंग
definition: running entirely on the user's phone or watch, no server round trip
example: Pose analysis is on-device now: faster, private, and immune to airplane mode.

hindi: नए कर्मचारी को काम और संस्कृति से परिचित कराने की प्रक्रिया
definition: the process of settling a new hire into their role, tools, and team
example: Her onboarding was a laptop, forty Slack channels, and a wiki last updated in 2021.

hindi: प्रारंभिक परिचय क्रम — नए उपयोगकर्ता को उत्पाद से जोड़ने वाले पहले कदम
definition: the guided first-use steps that turn a signup into an active user
example: Our onboarding flow asks twelve questions before showing any value.

hindi: आमने-सामने बैठक — प्रबंधक और सदस्य की निजी मीटिंग
definition: a recurring private meeting between two people, usually manager and report
example: Bring the promotion question to our one-on-one on Thursday.

hindi: आपके प्रबंधक का प्रबंधक — एक स्तर ऊपर का बॉस
definition: your manager's manager, the next level up the chain
example: The promo needs sign-off from your one-over-one, so be visible.

hindi: एक-पन्ना सार — पूरे प्रस्ताव का एक पृष्ठ का ख़ाका
definition: a single-page summary of a proposal, usually four pages long
example: Send a one-pager the VP can read in the elevator.

hindi: अंतिम चरण की लंबी इंटरव्यू-शृंखला, अब अक्सर वीडियो पर
definition: the final multi-hour interview round, historically in-office, now often virtual
example: The onsite ran five hours; lunch was the only round she passed comfortably.

hindi: दफ़्तर से बाहर — छुट्टी पर, पहुँच से दूर
definition: out of office — away from work and, in theory, not reading this
example: I'm OOO next week, so please panic responsibly.

hindi: खुला कार्यालय — दीवार-रहित, सहयोग और शोर दोनों
definition: an office layout without walls, built for collaboration and noise
example: The open floor plan is great, say the people with offices.

hindi: मंच खोलना — सबको बोलने का न्योता
definition: to invite anyone present to speak or ask questions
example: I'll open the floor after the demo; be gentle.

hindi: अमल में लाना — विचार को रोज़मर्रा की प्रक्रिया बनाना
definition: to turn an idea into repeatable day-to-day process
example: Great vision — now who will operationalize it?

hindi: संचालक — कंपनी को सचमुच चलाने-बढ़ाने का अनुभव रखने वाला
definition: someone who has actually run and scaled companies, not just invested or advised
example: We wanted an operator on the board, not another spreadsheet enthusiast.

hindi: परिचालन ख़र्च — कारोबार रोज़ चलाने की लागत
definition: operating expenses; the ongoing costs of running the business
example: Cloud bills are opex, which is why finance reads our dashboards.

hindi: आग्रही डिज़ाइन — एक सही तरीका चुनकर बाकी विकल्प हटा देना
definition: deliberately supporting one right way instead of endless options
example: The tool is opinionated, and its opinion of your workflow is low.

hindi: संभावित सौदा — बिक्री-क्रम में दर्ज सक्रिय प्रस्ताव
definition: a potential deal formally tracked in the pipeline with a stage and a value
example: It became an opportunity the moment the prospect said 'interesting.'

hindi: सहमति-आधारित डेटा — उपयोगकर्ता की स्पष्ट हाँ के बाद ही लिया गया डेटा
definition: data collected only after users explicitly agree to share it
example: The health model trains on opt-in data only, which legal mentions in every meeting.

hindi: छवि — बात सही हो या न हो, दिखती कैसी है
definition: how a decision looks to others, regardless of its merits
example: Cutting free coffee saved little, but the optics were terrible.

hindi: कर्मचारी शेयर कोष — भावी कर्मचारियों के लिए अलग रखे शेयर
definition: shares set aside to grant future employees, usually carved out before a round
example: The investors asked us to enlarge the option pool from our side.

hindi: वैकल्पिक उपस्थिति — आना अनिवार्य नहीं
definition: invited but not required to attend
example: I was optional, so I optionally did my actual job.

hindi: संगठन का ढांचा-चित्र — कौन किसे रिपोर्ट करता है
definition: the diagram of who reports to whom across a company
example: The product shipped late, so everyone studied the org chart for clues.

hindi: बिना विज्ञापन मिला — स्वाभाविक रूप से आया ट्रैफ़िक
definition: reached without paid promotion, via search, sharing, or word of mouth
example: Organic traffic doubled after we accidentally ranked for someone else's brand.

hindi: लक्ष्य पूरा होने पर कुल कमाई — बिक्री भूमिकाओं का वेतन-गणित
definition: on-target earnings; base plus commission if you hit full quota
example: OTE assumed a quota only two reps had ever hit.

hindi: संपर्क से बाहर — कुछ समय के लिए अनुपलब्ध होना
definition: unreachable or unavailable for a period; also paying personally
example: I'm out of pocket Friday afternoon for a flight.

hindi: दायरे से बाहर — जो इस काम में शामिल नहीं
definition: explicitly not included in the current work, however much anyone wishes
example: Great idea; it's out of scope, which is where great ideas live.

hindi: अनुपस्थिति का स्वतः जवाब — छुट्टी की स्वचालित सूचना
definition: the automatic email saying you're away and naming your unlucky backup
example: His out-of-office reply names a backup who left last month.

hindi: अपनी पहल से संपर्क — कंपनी की ओर से पहला क़दम
definition: sales activity where you contact prospects first — cold calls, cold emails, sequences
example: Outbound works; the first two hundred emails are just warming up.

hindi: विचलित बिंदु — बाकी डेटा से बहुत अलग पड़ता माप
definition: a data point far outside the pattern of the rest
example: One enterprise deal is an outlier, not a strategy.

hindi: आउटपुट मापदंड — मेहनत का अंतिम नतीजा दिखाने वाला आँकड़ा
definition: a result metric you care about but cannot move directly
example: You cannot assign someone an output metric, though we keep trying.

hindi: संपर्क अभियान — संभावित ग्राहकों तक पहुँचने की कोशिश
definition: the activity of contacting potential customers through calls, emails, and messages
example: Our outreach strategy is three emails, one call, and quiet resignation.

hindi: बाहर से काम कराना — काम बाहरी फर्म को सौंपना
definition: contracting work out to an external company
example: Outsourcing the support queue outsourced the customer goodwill too.

hindi: क्षमता से अधिक लेना — जितना हो सके उससे ज़्यादा काम उठाना
definition: to accept more sprint work than the team can actually finish
example: We overcommit every sprint to keep our disappointment consistent.

hindi: वादे से ज़्यादा देना — अपेक्षा से बेहतर नतीजा देना
definition: to exceed what was promised
example: Underpromise, overdeliver, and never reveal the formula.

hindi: चुपचाप एक साथ कई पूर्णकालिक नौकरियाँ करने वाला
definition: secretly holding multiple full-time remote jobs at once
example: Two laptops, three standups, one suspiciously quiet calendar: overemployed.

hindi: अति-अनुकूलन — रटे हुए डेटा पर उम्दा, नए डेटा पर नाकाम
definition: a model memorizing its training data and failing on anything new
example: Perfect on our test gym, lost in every other gym — that's overfitting.

hindi: उपरिव्यय — किराया, प्रशासन जैसे अप्रत्यक्ष स्थायी ख़र्च
definition: ongoing indirect costs like rent and admin that keep the lights on
example: The office is overhead; the espresso machine is morale.

hindi: माँग से भरा दौर — जितनी जगह थी उससे ज़्यादा निवेशक तैयार
definition: having more investor demand than the round has room for
example: The round is oversubscribed, a sentence founders practice saying casually.

hindi: अतिरिक्त समय — तय घंटों से ज़्यादा काम
definition: work beyond scheduled hours, paid or quietly expected
example: The launch didn't require overtime, just evenings and a Sunday.

hindi: स्वामित्व लेना — काम की पूरी ज़िम्मेदारी उठाना
definition: to be fully responsible for something, credit and blame included
example: You own onboarding now — congratulations and condolences.

hindi: लाभ-हानि विवरण — आय बनाम ख़र्च का हिसाब
definition: profit and loss statement; a summary of income versus expenses
example: The new VP asked who owns the P&L before asking our names.

hindi: पी-हैकिंग — मनचाहा नतीजा दिखने तक विश्लेषण से छेड़छाड़
definition: torturing analysis until an insignificant result looks significant
example: Slicing by left-handed Tuesday users is not insight, it is p-hacking.

hindi: पी-वैल्यू — नतीजा महज़ संयोग होने की संभावना का माप
definition: the probability the observed result happened by chance
example: The p-value is 0.06, so we are calling it directionally significant.

hindi: सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकता — सब छोड़कर तुरंत करने योग्य काम
definition: the highest priority; drop everything, this is on fire
example: It's a P0, so cancel your evening and possibly your weekend.

hindi: उच्च प्राथमिकता — अत्यावश्यक, पर सब कुछ रोकने योग्य नहीं
definition: urgent work that matters immensely yet somehow isn't a P0
example: They filed it as P1, the diplomatic way of saying today.

hindi: अनुमान में गुंजाइश जोड़ना — सुरक्षा के लिए समय या रक़म बढ़ाना
definition: to quietly add buffer to an estimate
example: Pad the estimate; the calendar has opinions we haven't met.

hindi: अलर्ट घंटी — ऑन-कॉल इंजीनियर को जगाने वाला संदेश-तंत्र
definition: whatever device or app wakes the on-call engineer when production breaks
example: The pager went off at 3 am, as is tradition.

hindi: सशुल्क प्रचार — विज्ञापन ख़रीदकर पाई गई पहुँच
definition: advertising you buy — search ads, social ads, sponsorships
example: Paid media works instantly and stops working the instant you stop paying.

hindi: दुखती रग — ग्राहक या टीम की सबसे बड़ी परेशानी
definition: a specific recurring frustration for customers or teams
example: Manual invoicing is our customers' biggest pain point.

hindi: जोड़ी प्रोग्रामिंग — दो डेवलपर, एक कीबोर्ड
definition: two developers writing code together at one keyboard
example: Pair programming: one types, one prevents crimes.

hindi: छोटी चुभन — अकेले मामूली, मिलकर कष्टदायी बनने वाली खामी
definition: a small annoyance that's trivial alone and painful in bulk
example: We fixed a hundred paper cuts and reviews called the app 'suddenly nice'.

hindi: दस्तावेज़ी सबूत — फ़ैसलों का लिखित सिलसिला
definition: the documented evidence of decisions and actions
example: Put it in email; verbal approvals leave no paper trail.

hindi: आमूल बदलाव — सोचने के ढंग में बुनियादी परिवर्तन
definition: a fundamental change in approach; frequently claimed, rarely occurring
example: The memo called the new filing system a paradigm shift.

hindi: संतान के जन्म या गोद लेने पर मिलने वाला अवकाश
definition: paid leave for a new child, by birth or adoption
example: He returned from parental leave to three reorgs and a new logo.

hindi: समता — प्रतिद्वंद्वी या दूसरे प्लेटफ़ॉर्म के बराबर होना
definition: matching what a competitor or another platform already offers
example: We spent the year chasing parity and calling it strategy.

hindi: टाल-सूची — अभी टाले गए मुद्दों की सूची
definition: a list where off-topic questions are parked, often permanently
example: Put it in the parking lot, next to last month's questions.

hindi: पेटेंट — आविष्कार पर सीमित अवधि का एकाधिकार
definition: a legal monopoly on an invention for a limited time
example: We patented the algorithm; a troll patented the idea of algorithms.

hindi: लागत वसूली अवधि — ग्राहक-लागत वापस कमाने में लगने वाला समय
definition: months needed for a customer's revenue to cover their acquisition cost
example: An eighteen-month payback period, optimistically labeled patience.

hindi: वेतन-व्यवस्था — कर्मचारियों को वेतन देने की प्रणाली
definition: the system and money for paying employees
example: Miss payroll once and the culture deck stops working.

hindi: समस्या कुर्सी और कीबोर्ड के बीच — यानी उपयोगकर्ता ही गड़बड़ (problem exists between keyboard and chair)
definition: problem exists between keyboard and chair; the user is the bug
example: Diagnosis after four hours: PEBKAC, closed with unusual satisfaction.

hindi: बीच में झांकना — प्रयोग पूरा होने से पहले नतीजे देख लेना
definition: checking experiment results early, which quietly corrupts them
example: No peeking until the test ends, we agreed, refreshing hourly.

hindi: परत-दर-परत खोलना — समस्या की तहें एक-एक कर समझना
definition: to examine a problem one layer at a time
example: Every time we peel the onion on billing, someone cries.

hindi: सहकर्मियों द्वारा लिखी समीक्षा-टिप्पणी
definition: review comments written about you by colleagues at your level
example: Peer feedback season is when everyone suddenly replies to your messages.

hindi: मानव संसाधन विभाग का आधुनिक नाम
definition: the modern rebrand of the HR department, same forms, warmer font
example: People ops sent a survey about the survey fatigue survey.

hindi: दैनिक भत्ता — यात्रा के दौरान रोज़ का तय ख़र्च
definition: a fixed daily allowance for meals and expenses while traveling
example: The per diem covers dinner if dinner is a sandwich.

hindi: मेरी पिछली ईमेल के अनुसार — विनम्र भाषा में 'पढ़ा क्यों नहीं'
definition: polite corporate code for 'I already answered this; please read'
example: Per my last email, the deadline has not moved.

hindi: काम का आवधिक मूल्यांकन — रेटिंग और वेतन इसी से तय
definition: the periodic evaluation of your work that feeds ratings and raises
example: The performance review compressed a year of work into three adjectives.

hindi: प्रतिनिधि उपयोगकर्ता चरित्र — शोध से गढ़ा काल्पनिक ग्राहक
definition: a fictional character representing a key user type, built from research
example: Our persona 'Busy Priya' would have abandoned this signup form by step two.

hindi: वैयक्तिकरण — हर उपयोगकर्ता के हिसाब से अनुभव ढालना
definition: tailoring content, plans, or difficulty to each individual user automatically
example: Personalization means your warm-up knows about your desk job and your left knee.

hindi: निजी दुलारी सुविधा — किसी प्रभावशाली की पसंद के दम पर टिकी सुविधा
definition: a feature that survives because someone powerful loves it
example: Nobody uses it, but it's the founder's pet feature, so it stays.

hindi: पालतू बनाम मवेशी — सर्वर सहेजो मत, बदल डालो का सिद्धांत
definition: treat servers as replaceable herd members, not beloved pets nursed back to health
example: Pets vs cattle, yet here we are, hand-feeding server number seven.

hindi: कृपया संलग्न देखें — फ़ाइल साथ में है
definition: please find attached — the file is on this email, promise
example: PFA the revised invoice; kindly ignore the previous three.

hindi: चरण द्वार — अगले चरण से पहले अनिवार्य समीक्षा-पड़ाव
definition: a formal checkpoint a project must pass before the next phase begins
example: We're stuck at the phase gate awaiting one signature and one miracle.

hindi: फ़ोन-कक्ष — खुले दफ़्तर में छोटा ध्वनिरोधी केबिन
definition: a tiny soundproof pod for calls in an open office
example: All four phone booths are taken; the stairwell it is.

hindi: पहली छँटनी-कॉल — आगे की इंटरव्यू से पहले की जांच
definition: an initial call that filters candidates before the full interview loop
example: The phone screen went well, which earned her five more interviews.

hindi: पीआई नियोजन — कई टीमों की साझा तिमाही योजना-बैठक
definition: the big-room event where many teams plan a shared program increment
example: PI planning: two days, forty people, one wall of sticky notes.

hindi: राय लेना — किसी के अनुभव से मुफ़्त सलाह लेना
definition: to ask someone for informal advice, usually unpaid
example: Can I pick your brain over coffee about pricing?

hindi: व्यक्तिगत पहचान सूचना — जिस डेटा से व्यक्ति पहचाना जा सके
definition: personally identifiable information; any data that can be traced to a specific person
example: Scrub the PII before the logs go anywhere near a training run.

hindi: प्रायोगिक शुरुआत — छोटे स्तर पर सीमित आज़माइश
definition: a small, time-boxed deployment before a full rollout
example: The pilot went so well it's been extended indefinitely, unpaid.

hindi: संदेश ऊपर टाँकना — सबकी नज़र में रखना
definition: to fasten an important message to the top of a channel
example: Pinned the wifi password so people stop asking weekly.

hindi: संदेश भेजकर ध्यान खींचना — किसी को छोटा सा संदेश करना
definition: to send someone a quick message to get their attention
example: Ping me when the build is green and I'll deploy.

hindi: प्रदर्शन-सुधार योजना — अक्सर निकालने की औपचारिक भूमिका
definition: performance improvement plan; officially a rescue, frequently a documented exit
example: The PIP had goals no one had met while employed there.

hindi: क़तार — आते हुए सौदों, कामों या उम्मीदवारों की धारा
definition: the stream of deals, work, or candidates on the way in
example: The pipeline looks healthy until you call the leads.

hindi: प्रस्ताव प्रस्तुति — उत्पाद या विचार बेचने की बात
definition: a persuasive presentation of a product, company, or idea
example: She refined the pitch until even engineering admitted it sounded plausible.

hindi: प्रस्तुति स्लाइडें — उत्पाद या कंपनी बेचने के लिए
definition: the slide deck used to sell a product, company, or vision
example: Version 47 of the pitch deck finally has fewer than sixty slides.

hindi: दिशा बदलना — पुराना आइडिया छोड़कर नया व्यवसाय मॉडल अपनाना
definition: to change a company's core product or strategy after the original one fails to take off
example: We pivoted from meal plans to AI coaching — the third pivot this year.

hindi: बदलो या मरो — रणनीति बदलना ही बचने का आख़िरी रास्ता
definition: the moment when changing strategy is the only alternative to shutting down
example: The offsite agenda had one item: pivot-or-die, lunch included.

hindi: बिंदु-सटीक — डिज़ाइन से हूबहू, पिक्सेल तक मेल खाता
definition: matching the design mockup exactly, down to the pixel
example: The engineer made it pixel-perfect; the designer moved the pixels.

hindi: स्थान-रक्षक — विवरण तय होने से पहले रोका गया समय
definition: a tentative calendar block reserving time before details are final
example: I sent a placeholder for Tuesday; agenda to follow, allegedly.

hindi: प्लानिंग पोकर — सब एक साथ अंक दिखाकर आकलन करना
definition: an estimation game where everyone reveals a size at once to avoid anchoring
example: Planning poker ended in a tie between three and thirteen.

hindi: ठहराव — बढ़त रुककर आँकड़े का सपाट हो जाना
definition: a stretch where a growing metric stops growing
example: We renamed the plateau a period of consolidation.

hindi: मंच रणनीति — वह आधार बनना जिस पर दूसरे कारोबार टिकें
definition: a strategy to become the base layer other businesses build on
example: It started as an invoicing tool; the deck now calls it a platform play.

hindi: कार्यपुस्तिका — आज़माए तरीक़ों का दोहराने लायक़ संग्रह
definition: a documented set of repeatable tactics for a situation
example: The sales playbook is thorough; nobody has opened it.

hindi: खुद काम भी करे और टीम भी संभाले — दो नौकरियाँ, एक वेतन
definition: a manager still expected to do hands-on work alongside managing
example: The player-coach role means two jobs, each done at half strength.

hindi: प्रोडक्ट-मार्केट फ़िट का संक्षिप्त रूप — बाज़ार में उत्पाद की पक्की माँग
definition: short for product-market fit, the milestone every early startup chases
example: The board asked for PMF evidence; we showed a graph and prayed.

hindi: परियोजना प्रबंधन कार्यालय — प्रक्रिया और टेम्पलेट का केंद्र
definition: project management office; the team that owns process, templates, and status decks
example: The PMO needs the status in their template by Thursday.

hindi: दूसरी कंपनी का कर्मचारी फुसलाकर ले जाना
definition: to lure an employee away from another company
example: The rival poached their whole platform team over one quarter.

hindi: अवधारणा का प्रमाण — ख़रीद से पहले सीमित तकनीकी परीक्षण
definition: proof of concept — a limited trial proving the product works before a real purchase
example: The POC succeeded, so they've requested a second, larger POC.

hindi: आकलन करना — कहानी को स्टोरी पॉइंट देना
definition: to assign story points to a backlog item during estimation
example: We still need to point the stories before planning tomorrow.

hindi: नीति — कंपनी का लिखित नियम
definition: an official company rule about how things must be done
example: There's a policy for laptops and somehow also for plants.

hindi: परिष्कार — उत्पाद को पूर्ण एहसास देने वाली अंतिम सफ़ाई
definition: the final refinement that makes a product feel finished
example: It works; it just needs two weeks of polish and a miracle.

hindi: कमी-पूरक कोड — पुराने ब्राउज़र में नई सुविधा की नक़ल
definition: code that recreates a modern feature in environments too old to have it
example: Half our bundle is polyfills for browsers nobody admits using.

hindi: पोर्टफ़ोलियो कंपनी — जिसमें फ़ंड ने निवेश किया है
definition: a startup that a fund has invested in
example: As a portfolio company, we get advice, intros, and quarterly panic emails.

hindi: मुद्रा आकलन — वीडियो से शरीर के जोड़ों की स्थिति पहचानना
definition: detecting body joint positions from video to analyze movement and form
example: Pose estimation says your elbows flare on push-ups; the camera has receipts.

hindi: बाज़ार में स्थान-निर्धारण — प्रतिस्पर्धा के बीच अलग पहचान
definition: how a product is framed in buyers' minds relative to alternatives
example: Our positioning changed three times this year; the product did not.

hindi: नया निवेश जुड़ने के तुरंत बाद की कंपनी की क़ीमत
definition: a company's value immediately after the new investment is added
example: Post-money valuation is pre-money plus the check nobody rounds down.

hindi: घटना-समीक्षा — विफलता के बाद कारणों की जाँच बैठक
definition: a review after a failure to document what happened and prevent a repeat
example: The post-mortem doc is longer than the outage was.

hindi: उत्तर-प्रशिक्षण — मूल प्रशिक्षण के बाद मॉडल को उपयोगी बनाने का काम
definition: everything done after pretraining — fine-tuning, feedback, safety work — to make a model useful
example: The base model was raw talent; post-training taught it manners.

hindi: पावर लॉ — गिनती के निवेश ही पूरे फ़ंड की कमाई कर देते हैं
definition: the pattern where one or two investments return more than the rest combined
example: The power law means the fund needs one of us to be enormous.

hindi: पावर यूज़र — उत्पाद को औसत से कहीं ज़्यादा और गहराई से चलाने वाला
definition: a heavy user who exercises the product far beyond the average
example: Our power users found features we forgot we shipped.

hindi: उत्पाद-उपयोग से परखा ग्राहक — इस्तेमाल ने ख़रीद-रुचि दिखाई
definition: product-qualified lead — a user whose product usage signals they're ready to pay
example: A PQL hit the seat limit twice this week; sales is already circling.

hindi: उत्पाद आवश्यकता दस्तावेज़ — क्या और क्यों बनाना है उसका लेख
definition: product requirements document; what to build and why, in writing
example: The PRD is six pages of context and one line of requirements.

hindi: नए निवेश से पहले की कंपनी की क़ीमत
definition: a company's value before the new investment money is added
example: They argued about pre-money valuation for three weeks and one dinner.

hindi: पूर्व-समीक्षा — शुरू से पहले संभावित विफलता के कारणों की कल्पना
definition: imagining a project has already failed, then listing why, before it starts
example: The pre-mortem predicted everything except how right it was.

hindi: पूर्व-पठन — बैठक से पहले भेजा गया दस्तावेज़
definition: a document sent before a meeting so discussion starts informed
example: Nobody opened the pre-read, so we read it together, silently.

hindi: आय-पूर्व — अभी कमाई शुरू नहीं, उम्मीदें भरपूर
definition: not yet earning money, a stage described optimistically in every deck
example: We're pre-revenue, which sounds better than 'nobody pays us yet.'

hindi: सबसे शुरुआती निवेश दौर — जब सिर्फ़ आइडिया और टीम हो
definition: the earliest funding stage, often just an idea, a deck, and a founder
example: Our pre-seed came from two angels and a very trusting uncle.

hindi: असमय अनुकूलन — नापने से पहले तेज़ करने की ज़िद
definition: tuning performance before measuring whether it matters
example: He micro-optimized a loop that runs once, at startup, yearly.

hindi: समय से पहले खिसकाना — पोस्टपोन का उल्टा
definition: to move something earlier — the opposite of postpone, Indian English's gift
example: Can we prepone the review to Wednesday and enjoy Friday?

hindi: दिखावटी उपस्थिति — मौजूद पर अनुत्पादक
definition: being visibly present or online without being productive
example: Late-night green dots are presenteeism, not progress.

hindi: शीर्ष विक्रेता सम्मान — सर्वश्रेष्ठ प्रदर्शन पर पुरस्कार यात्रा
definition: the annual award trip for top-performing salespeople
example: He mentions President's Club the way other people mention their kids.

hindi: प्रेस विज्ञप्ति — मीडिया के लिए आधिकारिक घोषणा
definition: an official announcement sent to journalists, written like news and read like marketing
example: The press release says 'industry-leading'; the industry was not consulted.

hindi: दबाव-परीक्षण करना — योजना की कमज़ोरियाँ जाँचना
definition: to challenge a plan hard to find its weak points
example: Pressure-test the pricing before the customers do it for free.

hindi: मूल्य पृष्ठ — वेबसाइट पर प्लान और उनके दाम
definition: the website page listing plans and prices, plus one column that says contact us
example: The pricing page has three tiers; everyone asks about a secret fourth.

hindi: प्राथमिक मापदंड — प्रयोग की जीत-हार पहले से तय करने वाला आँकड़ा
definition: the one metric named in advance to judge an experiment
example: The primary metric lost, so the recap leads with a secondary one.

hindi: छाप-छाप कर डिबगिंग — जगह-जगह प्रिंट डालकर बग खोजना
definition: hunting bugs by sprinkling print statements everywhere, debugger be damned
example: Advanced tooling installed, printf debugging chosen anyway.

hindi: प्राथमिकता देना — सबसे ज़रूरी काम पहले रखना
definition: to rank work so the most important happens first
example: We prioritized everything, which is how nothing shipped.

hindi: प्राथमिकता — काम का सापेक्ष महत्व-क्रम
definition: an item's rank in the queue; meaningless when everything shares it
example: Everything is priority one, so nothing is.

hindi: गोपनीयता नीति — उपयोक्ता डेटा के इस्तेमाल का घोषित नियम
definition: a public statement of how user data is collected and used
example: Update the privacy policy before marketing updates the tracking.

hindi: निजता-रक्षक — निजी डेटा उजागर किए बिना काम करने वाला
definition: designed to deliver AI features without exposing individuals' personal data
example: The insights are privacy-preserving: we learn trends, not that you skipped Tuesday.

hindi: आनुपातिक अधिकार — अगले दौर में हिस्सा बनाए रखने का हक़
definition: an investor's right to keep their ownership percentage by joining future rounds
example: The angel exercised her pro rata; she likes owning exactly one percent.

hindi: पहलक़दम — समस्या आने से पहले क़दम उठाने वाला
definition: acting before being asked or before problems appear
example: Be proactive: file the ticket before the outage.

hindi: परिवीक्षा अवधि — शुरुआती दौर जिसमें नौकरी आसानी से समाप्त हो सकती है
definition: an initial period during which a new hire can be dismissed easily
example: He shipped nothing risky until probation ended.

hindi: समस्या क्षेत्र — समाधान सोचने से पहले समस्या की पूरी समझ
definition: the territory of user needs, understood before proposing solutions
example: Stay in the problem space; nobody said the answer is an app.

hindi: ख़रीद प्रक्रिया — कंपनी के लिए सामान-सेवाएँ ख़रीदने की औपचारिक व्यवस्था
definition: the formal process of buying goods and services for a company
example: Procurement needs three quotes before we can buy one license.

hindi: उत्पादन वातावरण — असली उपयोगकर्ताओं वाला लाइव सिस्टम
definition: the live production environment where real users and real consequences live
example: Wait, is this terminal pointed at prod?

hindi: प्रोडक्ट ओनर — बैकलॉग की प्राथमिकता तय करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: the person who owns the backlog and decides what's worth building
example: Ask the product owner; the backlog is her kingdom.

hindi: उत्पाद-सूझ — क्या बनाना सार्थक होगा इसकी अंतर्दृष्टि
definition: the intuition for what users need and what's worth building
example: Product sense is knowing which of ten reasonable ideas actually matters.

hindi: उत्पाद-प्रेरित वृद्धि — बिक्री टीम से पहले उत्पाद ख़ुद बिके
definition: a strategy where self-serve product usage drives acquisition and expansion
example: Product-led growth: the free tier does the cold calling.

hindi: उत्पाद-बाज़ार मेल — जब ग्राहक उत्पाद को सचमुच चाहने लगें
definition: the stage where a product satisfies strong market demand and customers keep coming back
example: We can't scale marketing until we find product-market fit.

hindi: उत्पादकता का नाटक — दिखावे की व्यस्तता
definition: visible busyness performed to look productive rather than be productive
example: Instant replies at midnight are productivity theater, not throughput.

hindi: लाभ केंद्र — सीधे कमाई करने वाला विभाग
definition: a part of the business that directly generates revenue
example: Sales calls itself a profit center at every all-hands.

hindi: क्रमिक प्रकटीकरण — ज़रूरत पड़ने पर ही ब्योरा दिखाना
definition: revealing details gradually so users aren't overwhelmed at once
example: It's progressive disclosure, not burying the export button five menus deep.

hindi: पदोन्नति का निर्धारित मौसम — साल के तय दौर
definition: the fixed windows each year when promotions are considered
example: Miss the promo cycle by a week, wait six months.

hindi: प्रशंसक ग्राहक — उत्पाद की सिफ़ारिश करने को तत्पर
definition: a customer enthusiastic enough to recommend you, per the survey anyway
example: He's a promoter on the survey and a detractor in the hallway.

hindi: पदोन्नति के लिए तैयार प्रमाण-दस्तावेज़
definition: the evidence document assembled to argue someone deserves promotion
example: The promotion packet took longer to write than the project it described.

hindi: प्रॉम्प्ट — एआई को दिया गया निर्देश या सवाल
definition: the text you give an AI model to tell it what to do
example: Half the job is writing code; the other half is begging via prompt.

hindi: प्रॉम्प्ट अभियांत्रिकी — मनचाहा उत्तर पाने के लिए निर्देश गढ़ने की कला
definition: crafting and refining prompts so a model reliably does what you want
example: Three days of prompt engineering later, it stopped signing every reply 'Namaste, gym fam'.

hindi: प्रॉम्प्ट इंजेक्शन — पढ़वाई गई सामग्री में छिपे निर्देशों से मॉडल का अपहरण
definition: hiding malicious instructions in content a model reads, hijacking its behavior
example: A workout note said 'ignore previous instructions' — nice prompt injection attempt, Kevin.

hindi: संभावित ग्राहक — जिससे सौदे की उम्मीद हो
definition: a potential customer a salesperson is actively pursuing
example: The prospect loved the demo, which means nothing until legal sees the contract.

hindi: ग्राहक-खोज — नए संभावित ख़रीदार तलाशने का काम
definition: the work of finding and contacting potential new customers
example: Prospecting hour: coffee, a list of fifty names, and unearned optimism.

hindi: कार्यशील नमूना — असली उत्पाद जैसा व्यवहार करता क्लिक-योग्य मॉडल
definition: a clickable model that simulates the product before it's built
example: The prototype demos beautifully as long as you click only the one working button.

hindi: पास दिखने वालों को अनजाने में तरजीह — दूरस्थ कर्मचारियों की कीमत पर
definition: favoring people physically visible in the office over remote colleagues
example: Proximity bias meant the promotion went to whoever sat near the VP.

hindi: स्थानापन्न मापदंड — असली लक्ष्य की जगह नापा जाने वाला आसान आँकड़ा
definition: an easier-to-measure stand-in for the outcome you actually care about
example: Time in app is a proxy metric for value, or for confusion.

hindi: बिना डर के गलती या असहमति कह पाने का माहौल
definition: a climate where people can admit mistakes or disagree without punishment
example: Psychological safety is measured by who speaks after the VP does.

hindi: सवेतन अवकाश — छुट्टी के भुगतान-सहित दिन
definition: paid time off; vacation days the company pays you not to work
example: He scheduled PTO, then attended two meetings from the beach.

hindi: मर्ज का अनुरोध — बदलाव को समीक्षा हेतु पेश करना
definition: a proposed change submitted for review before merging
example: My pull request is small, only 87 files.

hindi: फ़ैसला दाग़ना — आख़िरकार क़दम उठा ही देना
definition: to finally commit and act
example: After three quarters of debate, we pulled the trigger.

hindi: आगे सरकाना — निर्णय या काम अगले चक्र पर टालना
definition: to defer a task or decision to a later sprint or quarter
example: Let's punt this to next quarter, where problems go to rest.

hindi: क्रय आदेश — ख़रीद की औपचारिक अनुमति का दस्तावेज़
definition: an official document authorizing a purchase from a vendor
example: No purchase order, no license keys; finance is unmoved.

hindi: आगे टालना — तिथि या कार्य को बाद में खिसकाना
definition: to move a date or task later on purpose
example: Let's push the release to Tuesday, famously a lucky day.

hindi: प्रतिरोध करना — असहमति जताकर माँग का जवाब देना
definition: to respectfully resist a request or decision
example: The team pushed back on the deadline; the deadline blinked.

hindi: सीमाएँ लाँघना — मुमकिन की हद से आगे जाना
definition: to go beyond accepted limits
example: The design team pushed the envelope; legal pushed it back.

hindi: फ़िलहाल रोकना — बात को बाद के लिए टाँक देना
definition: to pause a topic with the intention of returning, rarely honored
example: Let's put a pin in it until after launch.

hindi: प्रश्नोत्तर — श्रोताओं के सवालों का सत्र
definition: a segment where the audience asks questions
example: Keep five minutes for Q&A or people will ambush you after.

hindi: त्रैमासिक समीक्षा — तिमाही नतीजों और योजना की बैठक
definition: quarterly business review; a formal look at the quarter's numbers and plans
example: The QBR deck is ninety slides; the decision is one.

hindi: गुणात्मक शोध — क्यों और कैसे समझाने वाली बातचीत और अवलोकन
definition: qualitative research; the interviews and observations explaining why
example: The qual explains what the dashboard numbers are mumbling about.

hindi: परखा हुआ संभावित ग्राहक — बजट और ज़रूरत की पुष्टि के बाद
definition: a lead vetted for budget, need, and authority before sales spends time on it
example: It's only a qualified lead if someone besides the intern answered the email.

hindi: परखना — लीड में दम है या नहीं, जाँचना
definition: to assess whether a lead is worth pursuing, and walk away if not
example: Qualify hard: the fastest deal you'll ever work is the one you qualify out.

hindi: मात्रात्मक शोध — कितना और कितने बताने वाले आँकड़े
definition: quantitative data; the numbers saying how much and how many
example: The quant says users leave at step three; the qual says why.

hindi: परिमाणीकरण — मॉडल के अंकों की परिशुद्धता घटाकर उसे हल्का-तेज़ बनाना
definition: shrinking a model's numbers to lower precision so it runs faster and smaller
example: After quantization the model fits on the watch and only got slightly dumber.

hindi: तिमाही — वित्त वर्ष का तीन महीने का हिस्सा (Q1–Q4)
definition: a three-month business period; companies plan and report by Q1 through Q4
example: The feature slipped a quarter, which is corporate for three months.

hindi: त्रैमासिक — हर तिमाही होने वाला
definition: happening once every quarter
example: The quarterly review is where roadmaps go to be rewritten.

hindi: तिमाही नियोजन — हर तिमाही का प्राथमिकता-निर्धारण अनुष्ठान
definition: the ritual of choosing next quarter's priorities while finishing last quarter's
example: Quarterly planning ate three weeks of the quarter it planned.

hindi: जुगाड़ू — जल्दी का कामचलाऊ हल
definition: done fast and imperfectly to serve an immediate need
example: A quick and dirty script became our billing system.

hindi: छोटी कॉल — झटपट, प्रायः बिन तयशुदा बातचीत
definition: a short, often unscheduled voice or video conversation
example: A quick call is rarely quick and never just a call.

hindi: छोटा सा सवाल — जो अक्सर छोटा नहीं होता
definition: an opener that promises brevity and rarely delivers it
example: His 'quick question' at 4:58 had three sub-questions.

hindi: झटपट जीत — कम मेहनत में जल्दी दिखने वाला नतीजा
definition: a fast, low-effort improvement used to show momentum
example: Fixing the pricing-page typo was today's quick win.

hindi: उपेक्षा से इस्तीफा दिलवाना — काम और मौके छीनकर
definition: starving someone of work, raises, and attention until they resign
example: Quiet firing looks like a calendar that slowly empties.

hindi: बिना इस्तीफे बस उतना ही काम जितने के पैसे मिलते हैं
definition: doing exactly your job description and nothing more, without resigning
example: HR called it quiet quitting; he called it working the hours he's paid.

hindi: गणपूर्ति — निर्णय हेतु न्यूनतम उपस्थिति
definition: the minimum attendance needed for a meeting to decide anything
example: Three declines later, we lost quorum and rescheduled again.

hindi: बिक्री लक्ष्य — तय अवधि में अनिवार्य आँकड़ा
definition: the revenue number a salesperson must hit per quarter or year
example: He hit quota in November and spent December 'strategically planning.'

hindi: कोटेशन — काम या सामान की प्रस्तावित क़ीमत
definition: a vendor's stated price for specified work or goods
example: Get a second quote; the first one funded someone's yacht.

hindi: भूलभुलैया — ऐसा विषय जिसमें उतरते ही समय खो जाए
definition: a topic that consumes far more time the deeper you go
example: The logging bug was a three-day rabbit hole.

hindi: भूमिका मैट्रिक्स — कौन उत्तरदायी, जवाबदेह, परामर्शित, सूचित
definition: a matrix naming who's responsible, accountable, consulted, and informed
example: We built a RACI, then argued over who owns the RACI.

hindi: पूर्ण चुप्पी — कोई जवाब नहीं
definition: a total absence of replies from someone expected to respond
example: Two weeks of radio silence since we sent the proposal.

hindi: पुनर्प्राप्ति-सम्वर्धित सृजन — पहले दस्तावेज़ खोजो, फिर मॉडल से उत्तर बनवाओ
definition: retrieval-augmented generation; fetching relevant documents and letting the model answer from them
example: RAG means the bot quotes our help docs instead of its dreams.

hindi: लाल-पीला-हरा स्थिति — रंगों से परियोजना की सेहत
definition: red, amber, green; project health compressed into a traffic light
example: The RAG status turned amber, the color of managed panic.

hindi: गुज़ारे लायक़ मुनाफ़ा — बस संस्थापकों का ख़र्च निकलना
definition: earning just enough to cover the founders' bare living costs
example: We're ramen profitable, which the team celebrated with actual ramen.

hindi: नए विक्रेता का गति पकड़ना — पूर्ण लक्ष्य तक पहुँचना
definition: to get a new rep up to full productivity and full quota
example: Reps ramp in three months, according to a plan written by someone who never has.

hindi: गति बढ़ाना — क्षमता या प्रयास क्रमशः बढ़ाना
definition: to increase capacity, effort, or speed gradually
example: We're ramping up hiring right after the budget freeze thaws.

hindi: अंधी गली में घुसना — बेनतीजा बहस में समय गँवाना
definition: to sink meeting time into an unproductive tangent
example: We ratholed on naming for twenty of our thirty minutes.

hindi: मूल्यांकन-अंक — जिससे बोनस और पदोन्नति तय होती है
definition: the score a review assigns you, driving bonus and promotion odds
example: The rating scale has five points and two that are ever used.

hindi: मूल कारण विश्लेषण — समस्या की असली वजह की जाँच
definition: root cause analysis; the formal hunt for why something actually broke
example: The RCA is due Friday; the root cause is due whenever.

hindi: दायरा फिर तय करना — बदले हालात में काम की सीमा दोबारा खींचना
definition: to redefine the boundaries of work after reality intervenes
example: Week three: we re-scoped the project into a different project.

hindi: के विषय में — जवाब का शीर्षक-चिह्न
definition: regarding — the prefix email adds to every reply in a chain
example: The subject is now 'Re: Re: Re: Final final v3'.

hindi: पहुंच — सामग्री देखने वाले अलग-अलग लोगों की कुल संख्या
definition: the number of distinct people who saw something
example: Our reach is huge if you count the intern's test accounts.

hindi: संपर्क करना — किसी से बात शुरू करना
definition: to contact someone; corporate for call, message, or email
example: Someone from sales will reach out shortly, and often.

hindi: पढ़े जाने की रसीद — संदेश खुलने का सबूत
definition: proof a message was opened, ending all plausible deniability
example: Read receipts are on, so 'just saw this' won't fly.

hindi: परिणाम-प्रस्तुति — नतीजों का सार साझा करना
definition: a summary presentation of results or decisions to a wider group
example: The research readout is Tuesday; leadership gets the short version.

hindi: तर्कशील मॉडल — जवाब से पहले चरण-दर-चरण सोचने वाला मॉडल
definition: a model that works through problems step by step before answering, trading speed for accuracy
example: The reasoning model took eleven seconds to conclude you should drink water.

hindi: आधार बदलना — अपने बदलाव नई मुख्य शाखा पर फिर चढ़ाना
definition: to replay your commits on top of the latest main branch, rewriting history
example: Rebase before merging, and may the conflicts be gentle.

hindi: भेजा ईमेल वापस खींचना — अक्सर नाकाम कोशिश
definition: to try to unsend an email; everyone gets notified you tried
example: He recalled the salary email, so everyone opened it immediately.

hindi: सिफ़ारिश इंजन — हर उपयोगकर्ता की अगली पसंद भाँपने वाला तंत्र
definition: a system predicting what each user wants next, from workouts to videos
example: The recommendation engine suggests rest days now, and retention went up.

hindi: मिलान करना — दो हिसाबों का फ़र्क़ सुलझाना
definition: to match two sets of records and resolve the differences
example: Someone must reconcile card statements with expense reports. Someone.

hindi: बैठक की रिकॉर्डिंग — अनुपस्थितों के लिए सहेजा वीडियो
definition: the saved video of a meeting for those who missed it
example: I'll watch the recording, we say, and never do.

hindi: भर्तीकर्ता — उम्मीदवार खोजने और प्रक्रिया चलाने वाला
definition: the person who finds candidates and shepherds them through the hiring process
example: The recruiter said the team was like a family, which explained a lot.

hindi: आवर्ती — कैलेंडर पर तय अंतराल से दोहराने वाला
definition: repeating automatically on the calendar at a set interval
example: The invite was recurring, so nobody remembers why it exists.

hindi: ख़तरे का संकेत — चेतावनी देने वाला लक्षण
definition: a warning sign that something is wrong
example: A vendor with no references is a red flag.

hindi: लालफ़ीताशाही — काम रोकने वाली नौकरशाही प्रक्रियाएँ
definition: bureaucratic procedures that slow everything down
example: Two-day fix, six weeks of red tape.

hindi: रेड टीमिंग — कमज़ोरियाँ खोजने के लिए अपने ही सिस्टम पर हमला
definition: deliberately attacking your own AI system to find failures before users do
example: Red teaming day: everyone tries to make the coach say something lawsuit-worthy.

hindi: संशोधन चिह्नित करना — अनुबंध में बदलाव सुझाना
definition: to mark up a contract with proposed edits
example: Legal redlined the contract until it was mostly red.

hindi: पद समाप्त होने से नौकरी जाना — ब्रिटिश प्रयोग
definition: the British term for a layoff, where the role, not the person, is 'redundant'
example: The London office announced redundancies; the Slack emoji were universal.

hindi: कोड की पुनर्रचना — व्यवहार बदले बिना ढाँचा सुधारना
definition: to restructure code for clarity without changing its behavior
example: I'll just quickly refactor this, he said, three days ago.

hindi: उम्मीदवार के पुराने सहकर्मियों से पूछताछ
definition: calls to a candidate's former colleagues to verify how they actually work
example: The reference check was glowing, as references chosen by the candidate tend to be.

hindi: कर्मचारी द्वारा सुझाया गया उम्मीदवार — अक्सर बोनस के साथ
definition: a candidate recommended by a current employee, often for a bonus
example: He submitted the referral, collected the bonus, and apologized privately.

hindi: रेफ़रल योजना — ग्राहक द्वारा नया ग्राहक लाने पर इनाम
definition: a scheme rewarding customers for bringing in new customers
example: The referral program pays fifty dollars per friend; friendships priced accordingly.

hindi: परिशोधन — बैकलॉग कार्यों को स्पष्ट और आकलन-योग्य बनाना
definition: the politer modern name for grooming: clarifying and sizing upcoming backlog items
example: We renamed grooming to refinement; the tickets are equally vague.

hindi: पुराने अनुदान के ऊपर नया इक्विटी अनुदान
definition: an additional equity grant layered on as earlier grants finish vesting
example: No refresh this cycle means the recruiter messages suddenly look interesting.

hindi: इनकार — सुरक्षा नियमों के चलते मॉडल का अनुरोध ठुकराना
definition: a model declining a request its safety training judges inappropriate
example: The model's refusal rate spiked; now it won't even discuss protein shakes.

hindi: पुरानी खराबी की वापसी — नया बदलाव पुराना फ़ीचर तोड़ दे
definition: a bug where something that used to work breaks after a change
example: The fix shipped, along with a regression in login.

hindi: औसत की ओर वापसी — असामान्य नतीजों का खुद सामान्य पर आ जाना
definition: extreme results drifting back toward normal on their own
example: The record week regressed to the mean, taking the forecast with it.

hindi: जिनका जाना कंपनी को अखरता है — अच्छे लोगों का पलायन
definition: departures the company actually minds; the people they wanted to keep
example: The dashboard splits leavers into regretted attrition and everyone management annoyed.

hindi: ख़र्च-वापसी — अपनी जेब से किया ख़र्च कंपनी से वापस मिलना
definition: money paid back for expenses you covered out of pocket
example: The reimbursement arrived two laptops after the conference.

hindi: पहिया दोबारा बनाना — बनी-बनाई चीज़ फिर से बनाना
definition: to rebuild something that already exists and works
example: We reinvented the wheel, but ours has our logo.

hindi: अस्वीकार करना — प्रस्ताव औपचारिक रूप से ठुकराना
definition: to formally turn something down
example: Finance rejected the expense titled 'vibes'.

hindi: विमोचन टिप्पणियाँ — नए संस्करण के बदलावों का उपयोगकर्ता-सार
definition: the user-facing summary of what's new in a release
example: The release notes are cheerful; the incident channel tells the fuller story.

hindi: रिलीज़ ट्रेन — तय समय पर छूटती नियमित रिलीज़
definition: a fixed release schedule that departs on time with whatever's ready
example: Miss the release train and you wait six weeks on the platform.

hindi: मूलतः दूरस्थ कार्य-संस्कृति — दफ़्तर अपवाद है, नियम नहीं
definition: designed so remote is the default and the office is optional
example: We're remote-first, except for decisions, which happen at headquarters.

hindi: नवीनीकरण — अनुबंध या सदस्यता की अवधि आगे बढ़ाना
definition: extending a contract or subscription for another term
example: The renewal auto-triggered before anyone remembered we hate the tool.

hindi: टीमों और रिपोर्टिंग का फेरबदल
definition: a reshuffle of teams and reporting lines, arriving roughly twice a year
example: The third reorg this year gave him a fourth manager.

hindi: दोहराव गणना — कैमरे या सेंसर से कसरत के रेप गिनना
definition: automatically counting exercise repetitions from camera or sensor data
example: Rep counting works great until someone does half-reps and disputes the machine.

hindi: सबको एक साथ जवाब — पूरी सूची को उत्तर
definition: to answer everyone on the email, whether they wanted it or not
example: Someone hit reply-all to say congrats, and forty people agreed.

hindi: आवश्यकताएँ — उत्पाद को अनिवार्य रूप से क्या करना है
definition: the agreed list of what the product must do
example: The requirements changed twice during this sentence.

hindi: समय बदलना — बैठक नई तारीख़ पर खिसकाना
definition: to move a meeting to a different time
example: Can we reschedule Thursday's sync? My calendar imploded.

hindi: दिया हुआ नौकरी-प्रस्ताव वापस लेना
definition: to withdraw a job offer after extending it
example: The startup rescinded the offer two weeks before his start date.

hindi: स्वेच्छा से नौकरी छोड़ने की औपचारिक घोषणा
definition: formally quitting your job, ideally before it quits you
example: The resignation letter was three polite lines hiding two years of reasons.

hindi: उत्तरदायी एआई — निष्पक्षता, सुरक्षा और जवाबदेही के साथ एआई बनाना
definition: building and shipping AI with fairness, safety, privacy, and accountability designed in
example: Responsible AI review comes before launch, not after the press cycle.

hindi: अनुकूली — हर स्क्रीन आकार पर ठीक दिखने वाला
definition: adapting layout to look right on any screen size
example: It's responsive: it looks equally cramped on every device.

hindi: पुनर्गठन — ढांचा बदलने की आड़ में अक्सर पद-कटौती
definition: reorganizing the business in ways that usually include eliminating roles
example: Restructuring was announced; everyone refreshed the org chart and their resumes.

hindi: अग्रिम बंधी फ़ीस — सेवाएँ उपलब्ध रखने के लिए नियमित भुगतान
definition: a recurring fee paid to keep a firm's services on call
example: The law firm is on retainer, so go ahead and ask them.

hindi: प्रतिधारण — लौटते रहने वाले उपयोगकर्ताओं का अनुपात
definition: the share of users who keep coming back over time
example: Retention is flat, which marketing insists is the new up.

hindi: रुके रहने के लिए दिया जाने वाला बोनस
definition: money paid specifically to keep you from leaving during a rocky period
example: The retention bonus said 'stay'; the reorg said 'why'.

hindi: पुनःप्रशिक्षित करना — ताज़ा डेटा पर मॉडल को दोबारा सिखाना
definition: to train a model again on fresh data after performance slips
example: Winter data is in; retrain before the model forgets outdoor runs exist.

hindi: टीम-प्रवास — योजना और मेलजोल की बहु-दिवसीय यात्रा
definition: a multi-day team trip mixing planning with bonding
example: The retreat agenda says vision; the photos say karaoke.

hindi: पुनरावलोकन — स्प्रिंट के बाद क्या सुधारें, इसकी टीम बैठक
definition: the end-of-sprint meeting where the team inspects how it works and picks improvements
example: The retrospective's top action: actually do last retro's actions.

hindi: इंटर्नशिप के बाद पक्की नौकरी का प्रस्ताव
definition: a full-time offer extended to an intern after their internship
example: The whole internship was quietly an audition for the return offer.

hindi: राजस्व — बिक्री से आई कुल रक़म
definition: money a company earns from selling its products or services
example: Revenue is up; whether profit exists is a separate meeting.

hindi: बदलाव पलटना — कमिट का उल्टा लगाकर पुरानी स्थिति बहाल करना
definition: to undo a change by applying its exact opposite
example: When in doubt, revert first, debate later.

hindi: समीक्षा करना — जाँचकर राय या मंज़ूरी देना
definition: to examine work and give feedback or approval
example: Please review the doc, not just the title.

hindi: पुनर्लेखन — पुराना सिस्टम फेंक नए सिरे से बनाना
definition: scrapping an existing system to build it again from scratch
example: The rewrite is on schedule: year two of the six-month plan.

hindi: प्रस्ताव आमंत्रण — विक्रेताओं से औपचारिक बोली माँगना
definition: request for proposal; a formal invitation for vendors to bid
example: Six vendors answered the RFP; one answered the actual question.

hindi: कार्यबल में कटौती — छँटनी का औपचारिक-कानूनी नाम
definition: reduction in force; the formal, legal-flavored term for layoffs
example: Legal says RIF, the deck says restructuring, the team says Tuesday's layoffs.

hindi: उचित आकार देना — घटाने का सौम्य शब्द, प्रायः छँटनी के लिए
definition: to adjust to the 'correct' size; usually a euphemism for cuts
example: The org was right-sized; the work, curiously, was not.

hindi: छँटनी का सौम्य नाम — कर्मचारियों की संख्या घटाना
definition: reducing staff numbers, phrased to sound like optimization rather than layoffs
example: The all-hands announced rightsizing; twelve desks were empty by Friday.

hindi: जोखिम मूल्यांकन — संभावित ख़तरों की पहचान और आकलन
definition: identifying and weighing potential problems before proceeding
example: The risk assessment rated 'intern with prod access' as medium.

hindi: जोखिम पंजिका — संभावित खतरों और उपायों की सूची
definition: the official list of what could go wrong and who's watching it
example: The risk register's top risk: nobody reads the risk register.

hindi: मानवीय प्रतिक्रिया से पुनर्बलन — लोगों की पसंद से मॉडल को सुधारना
definition: reinforcement learning from human feedback; training a model on people's preference ratings
example: RLHF is why the coach says 'great effort' instead of the truth.

hindi: रोडमैप — आगामी कार्य की समयबद्ध योजना-झलक
definition: a high-level plan of what will ship and roughly when, subject to reality
example: The roadmap is speculative fiction, updated quarterly.

hindi: रॉकस्टार डेवलपर — भर्ती-विज्ञापनों की अतिशयोक्ति भरी उपाधि
definition: recruiter-speak for a brilliant developer, often signaling unrealistic expectations
example: The posting wants a rockstar; the salary wants a cover band.

hindi: निवेश पर प्रतिफल — लगाए पैसे के बदले मिला फायदा
definition: return on investment; what you got back relative to what you spent
example: The ROI of the rebrand remains a matter of faith.

hindi: समेकन रणनीति — कई छोटी कंपनियाँ ख़रीदकर एक बनाना
definition: a strategy of buying many small companies and merging them into one
example: Their roll-up bought every dental clinic in three states.

hindi: पिछले संस्करण पर वापसी — खराब रिलीज़ को उलटना
definition: reverting production to the previous version after a bad release
example: The rollback took two minutes; the postmortem took two weeks.

hindi: क्रमिक विस्तार — फ़ीचर को चरणों में जारी करना
definition: releasing something gradually to users, in stages you can retreat from
example: The rollout is at five percent, where it's been resting comfortably.

hindi: मूल कारण — लक्षण नहीं, असली वजह
definition: the underlying reason a failure happened, as opposed to its symptoms
example: The root cause was a config change; the symptom was everything.

hindi: बारी-बारी क्रम — सबकी बारी से बात
definition: a format where everyone speaks in turn
example: Quick round-robin: one update each, thirty seconds, no slides.

hindi: समय पर शेयर में बदलने वाली स्टॉक-इकाई
definition: restricted stock unit; equity that becomes real shares as it vests
example: The RSUs vest quarterly, and so does his motivation.

hindi: पहले दस्तावेज़ पढ़ो — जवाब मैनुअल में ही है (read the fine manual)
definition: read the fine manual; the answer was in the documentation all along
example: He asked in three channels before the gentle RTFM arrived.

hindi: दफ़्तर वापसी का आदेश — रिमोट काम समेटने की नीति
definition: return to office; a mandate ending or shrinking remote work
example: The RTO memo cited collaboration; the parking garage cited capacity.

hindi: बत्तख से बातचीत — समस्या ज़ोर से समझाते ही हल सूझ जाना
definition: explaining your problem aloud, often to an inanimate object, until the solution reveals itself
example: Ten minutes of rubber-ducking and the bug confessed on its own.

hindi: बिना सोचे मुहर लगाना — असल जाँच के बग़ैर मंज़ूरी देना
definition: to approve something without real scrutiny
example: The board rubber-stamped the plan between coffee and lunch.

hindi: चालीस का नियम — वृद्धि दर और मुनाफा मिलाकर चालीस पार हो
definition: growth rate plus profit margin should total at least forty percent
example: We pass the rule of 40 whenever we redefine one of the terms.

hindi: राय जाँचना — प्रस्ताव दिखाकर प्रतिक्रिया देखना
definition: to float an idea and see how people react
example: Run it up the flagpole at Monday's leads meeting.

hindi: कार्यक्रम-क्रम — मिनट-दर-मिनट योजना
definition: the minute-by-minute plan for a big meeting or event
example: The all-hands run of show gives the CEO twelve minutes.

hindi: समय से आगे खिंचना — तय अंत के बाद भी चलना
definition: to continue past a meeting's scheduled end time
example: We ran over again, straight into my lunch.

hindi: रन रेट — मौजूदा रफ्तार को सालभर तक खींचा गया अनुमान
definition: current performance extrapolated over a full year
example: Our run rate assumes December behaves like our best week ever.

hindi: आपात निर्देश-पुस्तिका — संकट में क्या करें, कदम-दर-कदम
definition: step-by-step instructions for handling a known operational situation
example: The runbook's step three: page someone who knows what to do.

hindi: बची हुई पूँजी की अवधि — कंपनी कितने महीने और चल सकती है
definition: the number of months a startup can operate before its money runs out
example: After the funding round, we have eighteen months of runway.

hindi: सेवा रूपी सॉफ़्टवेयर — सदस्यता पर किराए जैसा सॉफ़्टवेयर
definition: software as a service; software rented by subscription instead of sold outright
example: Everything is SaaS now, including, somehow, our office plants.

hindi: लंबी सेवा के बाद विस्तारित अवकाश
definition: an extended leave, often after years of tenure, to rest or wander
example: Her sabbatical plan was six weeks of not opening the laptop.

hindi: भविष्य की हिस्सेदारी का सरल क़रार — अभी पैसा, शेयर अगले दौर में
definition: simple agreement for future equity; money now for shares at the next round
example: We signed the SAFE in a week; the lawyers were almost disappointed.

hindi: बिक्री चक्र — पहले संपर्क से सौदे तक की अवधि
definition: the time from first contact to signed deal
example: Our sales cycle is 90 days, or 300 if procurement notices.

hindi: बिक्री सक्षमता — विक्रेताओं को सामग्री और प्रशिक्षण देना
definition: equipping reps with the training, content, and tools to sell effectively
example: Sales enablement built a beautiful portal; reps still ask for 'that one deck.'

hindi: बिक्री अभियंता — तकनीकी सवालों के जवाब देने वाला विशेषज्ञ
definition: the technical expert who joins sales calls to answer the hard questions
example: The sales engineer's job: make the demo survive contact with a real question.

hindi: सेवा योग्य बाज़ार — TAM का वह हिस्सा जिसे आप वाक़ई सेवा दे सकते हैं
definition: serviceable addressable market; the slice of TAM your product can realistically serve
example: The SAM slide is where the trillion quietly becomes a billion.

hindi: नमूना आकार — प्रयोग में शामिल उपयोगकर्ताओं की संख्या
definition: how many users a test includes, which decides how much to trust it
example: Bold conclusion for a sample size of eleven.

hindi: जानबूझकर कम वादा करना — बाद में बढ़कर दिखाने हेतु
definition: to pad an estimate or commit low so you can overdeliver later
example: He sandbags every sprint, then finishes early and looks heroic.

hindi: जान-बूझकर कम बताना — बाद की वाहवाही के लिए सौदे छिपाना
definition: understating your forecast or hiding deals to beat expectations later
example: He 'found' three deals on the last day of the quarter; sandbagging season again.

hindi: प्रयोग-स्थल — जहाँ तोड़फोड़ से कोई असली नुकसान नहीं
definition: an isolated environment where you can experiment without breaking anything real
example: Try it in the sandbox first; prod has feelings.

hindi: तर्क-जाँच — कोई बड़ी चूक तो नहीं, इसकी त्वरित पड़ताल
definition: a quick check that something is not obviously wrong
example: Sanity check: does this discount actually leave us a margin?

hindi: ढाँचा-कोड — शुरुआत के लिए खड़ा किया गया अस्थायी ढाँचा
definition: generated or temporary structure that gets a project standing before real work begins
example: The scaffolding from the tutorial is still in production.

hindi: बड़े पैमाने पर बढ़ाना — लागत बढ़ाए बिना कारोबार बढ़ाना
definition: to grow revenue and operations fast without costs growing just as fast
example: It works for ten customers; now we find out if it scales.

hindi: विस्तार-चरण कंपनी — PMF के बाद तेज़ फैलाव में जुटी
definition: a startup past product-market fit, now focused on rapid expansion
example: We're officially a scale-up now, so the chaos has middle managers.

hindi: बुकिंग कड़ी — दूसरों के लिए स्लॉट चुनने का लिंक
definition: a personal booking page others use to pick a meeting slot
example: Sending a scheduling link to a peer reads a little royal.

hindi: दायरा तय करना — काम कितना बड़ा है, यह परिभाषित करना
definition: to define how big a piece of work is before committing to it
example: Let's scope it first and panic afterward, in order.

hindi: दायरा-विस्तार — योजना के बाद चुपचाप बढ़ती माँगें
