definition: the quiet expansion of a project's requirements after everyone agreed on them
example: One small tweak plus one small tweak equals scope creep.

hindi: कार्य-सीमा कटौती — समय पर पहुँचने के लिए सुविधाएँ घटाना
definition: removing planned work to hit a deadline
example: One more scope cut and we're shipping a login page.

hindi: स्क्रीन वाचक — दृष्टिबाधितों के लिए स्क्रीन पढ़कर सुनाने वाला सॉफ़्टवेयर
definition: software that reads interfaces aloud for blind and low-vision users
example: The screen reader announces our buttons as 'button', 'button', and 'button'.

hindi: स्क्रीन साझा — अपनी स्क्रीन सबको दिखाना
definition: showing your screen to everyone on a call
example: Close your tabs before the screen share, learned everyone, eventually.

hindi: लेखक — बैठक के नोट्स दर्ज करने वाला
definition: the person taking notes and capturing decisions in a meeting
example: Rotate the scribe role so notes aren't always Priya's job.

hindi: स्क्रम — स्प्रिंट और निश्चित भूमिकाओं वाला एजाइल ढांचा
definition: the most common agile framework, organizing work into sprints with fixed roles and ceremonies
example: Half the team read the scrum guide; the other half just attends the meetings.

hindi: स्क्रम मास्टर — प्रक्रिया चलाने और बाधा हटाने वाला सूत्रधार
definition: the facilitator who runs scrum's ceremonies and clears the team's blockers
example: Our scrum master's whole job is defending the team's calendar.

hindi: स्क्रमों का स्क्रम — कई टीमों के प्रतिनिधियों की समन्वय बैठक
definition: a coordination standup where representatives of several scrum teams sync
example: The scrum of scrums exists so standup can have a standup.

hindi: स्क्रम-किंतु — 'हम स्क्रम करते हैं, बस...' वाला आधा-अधूरा स्क्रम
definition: doing scrum except for the parts you skip, explained with 'but'
example: We do scrum, but no retros; textbook ScrumBut.

hindi: बिक्री विकास प्रतिनिधि — बैठकों के लिए नए ग्राहक खोजने वाला
definition: sales development representative — the rep who prospects and books meetings for AEs
example: The SDR sent eighty emails today; two bounced, one replied 'unsubscribe.'

hindi: मौसमी असर — कैलेंडर से बंधे आँकड़ों के अनुमानित उतार-चढ़ाव
definition: predictable ups and downs tied to the calendar
example: Growth is down, but so is everyone in December; blame seasonality.

hindi: सीट — प्रति-उपयोक्ता सॉफ़्टवेयर शुल्क की इकाई
definition: one paid user license in per-user software pricing
example: We pay for forty seats and eleven people log in.

hindi: मौजूदा शेयरों की बिक्री — एक्ज़िट से पहले पुराने हिस्सेदारों की कमाई
definition: a sale of existing shares, letting early holders cash out before an exit
example: The founders took a small secondary and suddenly believed in work-life balance.

hindi: ख़ास नुस्ख़ा — कामयाबी का गुप्त कारण
definition: the special ingredient behind a company's success
example: Our support team is the secret sauce; guard them.

hindi: सुरक्षा समीक्षा — जोखिमों के लिए सिस्टम या विक्रेता की जाँच
definition: an assessment of a system or vendor for security risks
example: The security review flagged the plugin we already deployed.

hindi: बीज दौर — उत्पाद बनाने और बाज़ार परखने के लिए पहला औपचारिक निवेश
definition: the first formal funding round, used to build the product and find fit
example: The seed round closed in March; the celebration pizza was expensed in April.

hindi: खंड — साझा गुण के आधार पर बना उपयोगकर्ताओं का उपसमूह
definition: a subset of users grouped by a shared trait
example: Every segment is growing except the one that pays.

hindi: चयन पूर्वाग्रह — गैर-प्रतिनिधि नमूना चुनने से झुका नतीजा
definition: skew from studying a group that was never representative
example: We surveyed our happiest users and confirmed users are happy.

hindi: अपने काम का खुद लिखा मूल्यांकन
definition: the review-season essay where you rate your own year's work
example: The self-assessment is where humility goes to hurt your rating.

hindi: स्वयं-व्याख्यायी कोड — इतना साफ़ कि टिप्पणी न लगे (अक्सर बहाना)
definition: code claimed to be so clear it needs no comments, a claim rarely audited
example: It's self-documenting, he said, of the function named process2.

hindi: स्वयं-सेवा ख़रीद — बिना विक्रेता से बात किए
definition: bought and set up by the customer alone, no salesperson involved
example: Self-serve revenue is the best kind: nobody had to attend a meeting.

hindi: अर्थ-आधारित खोज — शब्द नहीं, मतलब मिलाकर ढूँढने वाली खोज
definition: search that matches meaning rather than exact keywords
example: Semantic search knows 'sore everywhere' means they want the recovery page.

hindi: अर्थपूर्ण संस्करण — major.minor.patch नंबरिंग की परिपाटी
definition: semantic versioning; numbering releases as major.minor.patch with promises attached
example: They call it semver, yet every minor release breaks us.

hindi: सेंसर संलयन — कई सेंसरों के संकेत मिलाकर साफ़ तस्वीर बनाना
definition: combining signals from multiple sensors into one clearer picture of what's happening
example: Sensor fusion blends heart rate, motion, and GPS into one coherent 'you're jogging'.

hindi: खोज-इंजन अनुकूलन — खोज परिणामों में ऊपर दिखने की तकनीक
definition: search engine optimization — shaping content so search engines rank it higher
example: The SEO team wants 'best CRM 2026' in the title of everything, including birthday cards.

hindi: स्वचालित संपर्क शृंखला — ईमेल और कॉल की तय कड़ी
definition: an automated series of emails and call tasks aimed at a prospect
example: Step six of the sequence is the breakup email; it gets the most replies.

hindi: क्रमिक उद्यमी — एक के बाद एक कंपनियाँ शुरू करने वाला
definition: a founder who starts company after company, exit or no exit
example: She's a serial entrepreneur; this is startup number four and counting.

hindi: पहला बड़ा वेंचर दौर — शुरुआती सफलता दिखने के बाद का निवेश
definition: the first major venture round, raised once a startup shows real traction
example: Every slide in our Series A deck says 'growth' at least twice.

hindi: सीरीज़ A के बाद का दौर — चलते मॉडल को बड़ा करने की पूँजी
definition: the round after Series A, meant for scaling a model that already works
example: Post Series B, we suddenly have a legal team and a travel policy.

hindi: टीम की बाधाएँ हटाने को प्राथमिकता देने वाली प्रबंधन-शैली
definition: a management style framed around removing the team's obstacles rather than commanding
example: He practices servant leadership, which mostly means apologizing for the roadmap.

hindi: सेवा खाका — ग्राहक अनुभव और पर्दे-पीछे की प्रक्रिया का जुड़ा नक्शा
definition: a map linking the customer journey to the behind-the-scenes operations
example: The service blueprint revealed the 'instant' refund involves three humans and a fax.

hindi: सत्र — उपयोगकर्ता की एक बार की लगातार गतिविधि
definition: one continuous stretch of user activity in the product
example: Average session length is ninety seconds, our most honest metric.

hindi: सत्र रीप्ले — असली उपयोगकर्ता की स्क्रीन-गतिविधि की रिकॉर्डिंग
definition: recordings of real user sessions, watched to see where people struggle
example: One session replay of a confused user beats forty dashboard debates.

hindi: सर्वोच्च आपात स्तर — सबसे गंभीर श्रेणी की गड़बड़ी
definition: the highest-severity incident, all hands, everything else can wait
example: Declare a sev1 and cancel my dentist appointment.

hindi: नौकरी से निकालने पर दिया गया मुआवज़ा-पैकेज
definition: the payout given when you're terminated, usually tied to tenure
example: The severance was two weeks per year, and a fast NDA.

hindi: छाया आईटी — बिना मंज़ूरी इस्तेमाल हो रहे टूल और सिस्टम
definition: software teams use without IT's approval or knowledge
example: The official tool has 12 users; shadow IT has 300.

hindi: देखभाल से पार लगाना — काम को हर पड़ाव से सुरक्षित निकालना
definition: to guide something patiently through a long process
example: She shepherded the proposal through five reviews and two reorgs.

hindi: पच्चर कोड — असंगत हिस्सों के बीच फ़िट बैठाने वाली पतली परत
definition: a thin compatibility layer wedged between mismatched components
example: A small shim, they said; it now has its own on-call.

hindi: जारी कर दो — काफ़ी अच्छा है, अभी रिलीज़ करो
definition: declaration that the work is good enough to release right now
example: It passes the tests and it's 6 pm — ship it.

hindi: जारी करने योग्य — असली उपयोगकर्ताओं तक भेजने लायक तैयार
definition: finished enough to release to real users
example: It's ship-ready except for the crash, which we're calling rare.

hindi: अंतिम सूची में रखना — विकल्प छाँटकर चुनिंदा रखना
definition: to narrow candidates down to a final few
example: We shortlisted three vendors and the one sales already promised.

hindi: हाथ उठाकर मत — झटपट गिनती
definition: a quick vote taken by raising hands
example: Show of hands: who has actually read the spec?

hindi: शो रोक देने वाला दोष — रिलीज़ असंभव कर देने वाली खामी
definition: a defect severe enough to halt a release entirely
example: Minor visual glitch, they said; the showstopper deleted accounts.

hindi: बीमारी की छुट्टी
definition: a day off for illness, taken instead of coughing through standup
example: He took a sick day and still shipped a hotfix, which defeats the point.

hindi: अलग बातचीत — मुख्य चर्चा से हटकर छोटी बात
definition: a quick side conversation outside the main discussion
example: Quick sidebar after this call about the demo?

hindi: अनुमोदन — आगे बढ़ने की औपचारिक स्वीकृति
definition: formal approval that lets work proceed or ship
example: We have sign-off from everyone except the person who matters.

hindi: नौकरी शुरू करने पर एकमुश्त राशि — अक्सर वापसी-शर्त सहित
definition: a lump sum paid for joining, often repayable if you leave early
example: The sign-on bonus was generous, with a twelve-month leash attached.

hindi: संकेत बनाम शोर — मतलब की जानकारी और बेमतलब उतार-चढ़ाव का फर्क
definition: separating meaningful movement in data from random fluctuation
example: Two days of data is noise; three days is a board slide.

hindi: हस्ताक्षर खंड — ईमेल के अंत में नाम-पद
definition: the block of name, title, and quotes ending every email
example: Her signature is longer than most of her emails.

hindi: अलग-थलग ढाँचा — दूसरों से कटकर काम करता विभाग
definition: a team that hoards information and works in isolation
example: The data lives in three silos and two grudges.

hindi: रामबाण — हर समस्या का एकमुश्त इलाज
definition: a single fix that solves everything; does not exist
example: The new tool is great, but it's no silver bullet.

hindi: एक ही स्क्रीन पर सब — सारे आँकड़े एक जगह देखने का वादा
definition: one unified view of everything, promised by every tool
example: The new tool is a single pane of glass, our seventh.

hindi: एकमात्र प्रामाणिक स्रोत — सबके लिए एक ही सही जगह
definition: the one authoritative place where correct data lives, in theory
example: We have three single sources of truth.

hindi: साइट-नक्शा — उत्पाद के सभी पन्नों और उनके जुड़ाव का चित्र
definition: a diagram of all pages and how they connect
example: The sitemap has forty pages; analytics says users visit five.

hindi: ढांचा स्क्रीन — सामग्री लोड होते समय दिखने वाला धूसर खाका
definition: a placeholder layout shown while real content loads
example: Users now recognize our skeleton screen better than our content.

hindi: दांव पर हिस्सेदारी — नतीजे से अपना नफ़ा-नुक़सान जुड़ा होना
definition: personal stake in an outcome, so failure costs you too
example: Advisors advise; founders have skin in the game.

hindi: अपने बॉस के बॉस से सीधी मुलाकात
definition: a meeting with your manager's manager, skipping the layer between
example: In the skip-level she finally learned why the roadmap kept changing.

hindi: सेवा-स्तर अनुबंध — जवाब और अपटाइम की संविदागत गारंटी
definition: service level agreement — the contractual promise of response times and uptime
example: The SLA guarantees a response in four hours; a solution is sold separately.

hindi: काट-छांट कर देखना — डेटा को कई कोणों से बांटकर परखना
definition: to break data apart along different dimensions until something interesting appears
example: We sliced and diced until the quarter looked survivable.

hindi: खिसकना — तय तिथि से आगे टल जाना
definition: to move past a planned date, quietly and usually more than once
example: The launch slipped a week, in the way weeks become months.

hindi: लघु भाषा मॉडल — फ़ोन पर चलने लायक़ छोटा, किफ़ायती मॉडल
definition: a compact model cheap enough to run on phones or laptops
example: A small language model on the watch handles rep talk; the cloud handles philosophy.

hindi: समझदार पूँजी — पैसे के साथ अनुभव और संपर्क भी लाने वाला निवेश
definition: investment that brings expertise and connections along with the cash
example: We picked the smart money over the bigger check; the intros paid off.

hindi: लघु और मध्यम व्यवसाय — छोटे ग्राहकों का वर्ग
definition: small and medium-sized business — customers with quick decisions and modest budgets
example: SMB customers decide in a week and leave just as fast.

hindi: धुआँ परीक्षण — बुनियादी जाँच कि कुछ सुलग तो नहीं रहा
definition: a quick basic check that the system starts and nothing is obviously on fire
example: The smoke test passed, so we're at least 10% confident.

hindi: संदेश कुछ देर टालना — बाद में फिर दिखे
definition: to hide a message until a time when you'll ignore it again
example: I snoozed the invoice reminder to Friday. Twice.

hindi: अनोखा सर्वर — हाथ से सँवारा, दोबारा न बन पाने वाला
definition: a hand-configured server so unique nobody can rebuild it
example: Don't reboot the snowflake server; nobody remembers how it works.

hindi: सुरक्षा अनुपालन प्रमाणन — डेटा-सुरक्षा नियंत्रणों की ऑडिट रिपोर्ट
definition: a security compliance audit that big customers demand from SaaS vendors
example: The deal is waiting on SOC 2, so everyone suddenly loves process.

hindi: सामाजिक प्रमाण — दूसरों का भरोसा दिखाकर विश्वास जगाना
definition: evidence that other people already use and trust a product
example: Three customer logos on the landing page — instant social proof.

hindi: सबको बताना — फ़ैसले से पहले विचार लोगों तक पहुँचाना
definition: to float an idea around so nobody is surprised later
example: Socialize the proposal with the leads before the review.

hindi: सम्मानजनक समापन — डूबती कंपनी का बिककर बच जाना
definition: a face-saving acquisition that rescues a struggling startup from shutting down
example: It wasn't the exit we dreamed of, but a soft landing beats a shutdown.

hindi: धीमी शुरुआत — बड़े लॉन्च से पहले सीमित रिलीज़
definition: a quiet, limited release used to test before the real launch
example: The soft launch went so quietly that even our moms missed it.

hindi: एकल उद्यमी — अकेले ही पूरा कारोबार चलाने वाला
definition: an entrepreneur who builds and runs the business entirely alone
example: As a solopreneur, every all-hands meeting is just him and his coffee.

hindi: समाधान क्षेत्र — तय समस्या के संभावित हलों की दुनिया
definition: the range of possible ways to solve a defined problem
example: We jumped to the solution space before agreeing what the problem was.

hindi: प्राप्य बाज़ार — निकट भविष्य में वाक़ई जीतने लायक़ हिस्सा
definition: serviceable obtainable market; the share you can actually win near term
example: Nobody claps at the SOM slide, but it's the only honest one.

hindi: देर से जवाब के लिए क्षमा — विलंब की माफ़ी
definition: the apology that opens replies sent days, or eras, later
example: Sorry for the late reply; this was under 400 unread emails.

hindi: सत्य-स्रोत — जिस एक जगह के आँकड़े आधिकारिक माने जाएँ
definition: the one system whose numbers are treated as authoritative
example: We have three sources of truth, so technically none.

hindi: उम्मीदवारों की सक्रिय खोज — आवेदन का इंतज़ार नहीं
definition: proactively finding candidates rather than waiting for applications
example: Half of sourcing is cold messages beginning with an apology for the cold message.

hindi: कार्य विवरण — अनुबंध में तय काम, समयसीमा और डिलिवरेबल
definition: statement of work; the contract section defining exactly what will be delivered
example: If it's not in the SOW, it's a change request.

hindi: खाली सूचीबद्ध कंपनी — विलय से स्टार्टअप को शेयर बाज़ार में लाती है
definition: a shell company that lists publicly, then merges with a startup to take it public
example: They went public via SPAC and learned what quarterly earnings feel like.

hindi: उलझा हुआ कोड — नूडल्स-सा गुत्थमगुत्था, समझ से परे प्रवाह
definition: tangled code whose control flow twists like noodles, defying comprehension
example: I traced the spaghetti code for an hour and ended where I started.

hindi: एक प्रबंधक के अधीन कर्मचारियों की संख्या
definition: the number of direct reports a single manager oversees
example: After the reorg, her span of control doubled but her hours stayed at all of them.

hindi: अगुवाई करना — नई मुहिम का नेतृत्व करना
definition: to lead a new effort from the front
example: He spearheaded the migration and got the arrows to prove it.

hindi: विनिर्देश — क्या बनना है उसका लिखित ब्योरा
definition: the written description of exactly what to build
example: The spec says 'intuitive'; the engineers have questions.

hindi: वाक्-से-पाठ — बोली गई बात को लिखित शब्दों में बदलना
definition: converting spoken audio into written words automatically
example: Speech-to-text handles workout logging, though 'eight reps' still sometimes lands as 'ate crepes'.

hindi: ख़र्च — किसी मद पर जा रही कुल रक़म
definition: the total amount being spent on something, as finance says it
example: Our cloud spend has its own gravity now.

hindi: तात्कालिक बिक्री बोनस — ख़ास उत्पाद बेचने पर इनाम
definition: a short-term bonus for selling a specific product or hitting a sprint goal
example: A $500 spiff on the new module and suddenly every demo features it.

hindi: स्पाइक — अनिश्चितता जाँचने हेतु समयबद्ध खोजी कार्य
definition: a timeboxed investigation to answer a technical question before committing to build
example: Let's do a spike before we promise anything to sales.

hindi: अतिप्रवाह — स्प्रिंट में न समाकर आगे बहा काम
definition: planned work that didn't fit the sprint and flows into the next one
example: We planned for zero spillover, which was itself optimistic planning.

hindi: अलग इकाई बनाना — हिस्से को स्वतंत्र कंपनी या टीम बनाना
definition: to split part of a company or project into its own entity
example: The side project got spun off before it got good.

hindi: जल्दी खड़ा करना — नई टीम या सिस्टम फ़ौरन शुरू करना
definition: to quickly get a new team, project, or system running
example: We spun up a task force to study our task forces.

hindi: बंद कमरों में आपकी पैरवी करने वाला वरिष्ठ
definition: a senior person who advocates for your promotion in rooms you're not in
example: A mentor gives advice; a sponsor says your name in calibration.

hindi: तुरंत दिया गया छोटा पुरस्कार-बोनस
definition: a small, immediate bonus for a specific piece of good work
example: The outage he fixed at 3 a.m. earned a spot bonus and insomnia.

hindi: स्प्रिंट — विकास कार्य का छोटा निश्चित चक्र, प्रायः दो सप्ताह
definition: a short fixed period, usually two weeks, in which a team commits to specific work
example: We'll pick that up next sprint, which is agile for eventually.

hindi: स्प्रिंट लक्ष्य — स्प्रिंट का एक साझा उद्देश्य
definition: the single objective a sprint's work is supposed to serve
example: Our sprint goal is finishing last sprint's goal.

hindi: स्प्रिंट नियोजन — स्प्रिंट का काम चुनने की बैठक
definition: the meeting where a team picks and commits to the sprint's work
example: Sprint planning took four hours, which was not in the plan.

hindi: स्प्रिंट समीक्षा — हितधारकों को पूर्ण कार्य दिखाना
definition: the end-of-sprint session showing finished work to stakeholders
example: The sprint review demo worked, so the sprint gets remembered fondly.

hindi: बिक्री टीम द्वारा परखा संभावित ग्राहक — असली सौदे की संभावना
definition: sales-qualified lead — vetted by sales as a genuine opportunity, not the database language
example: Marketing sent fifty MQLs; sales accepted four as SQLs and complained anyway.

hindi: कमिट समेटना — कई कमिट मिलाकर एक करना
definition: to combine many messy commits into one tidy commit before merging
example: Squash it; nobody needs nine commits named 'fix typo'.

hindi: क्रमबद्ध करना — हर काम को ऊपर से नीचे तक एक क्रम देना
definition: to force-order every item so there are no convenient ties
example: Stack rank the features; 'all of them' is not a ranking.

hindi: कर्मचारियों को आपस में क्रम देना — किसी को नीचे आना ही है
definition: force-ranking employees against each other so someone must land at the bottom
example: Stack ranking turned a great team into five careful rivals.

hindi: वरिष्ठ से ऊपर के इंजीनियरिंग स्तर — स्टाफ, प्रिंसिपल आदि
definition: engineering levels above senior — staff, principal, and beyond
example: At staff+, the job is mostly documents and diplomacy.

hindi: पूर्व-उत्पादन वातावरण — रिलीज़ से पहले की रिहर्सल जगह
definition: a production-like environment where changes rehearse before the real show
example: It worked on staging, which resembles production the way a photo resembles a person.

hindi: हितधारक — परियोजना के परिणाम में रुचि रखने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: anyone with an interest in a project's outcome and opinions about it
example: The demo went well until a stakeholder discovered opinions.

hindi: मानकीकृत करना — सबके लिए एक तय तरीक़ा लागू करना
definition: to make everyone use one agreed way of doing things
example: We standardized on one framework, plus the four legacy ones.

hindi: स्थायी बैठक — कैलेंडर पर हमेशा दोहराती मीटिंग
definition: a meeting that recurs on the calendar indefinitely
example: This standing meeting outlived the project it was created for.

hindi: स्टैंडअप — रोज़ की छोटी टीम बैठक जिसमें प्रगति और बाधाएँ बताते हैं
definition: a short daily meeting where each person shares progress, plans, and blockers
example: Our fifteen-minute standup has a forty-five-minute average.

hindi: स्थिति-कार्य-कदम-नतीजा ढांचे में जवाब देने की इंटरव्यू तकनीक
definition: answering behavioral questions as situation, task, action, result
example: He STAR-methoded 'tell me about a conflict' into a tidy fable.

hindi: सांख्यिकीय सार्थकता की बोलचाल — नतीजा असली माने जाने की कसौटी
definition: shorthand for statistically significant
example: Is it stat sig, asked everyone, before the chart finished loading.

hindi: सांख्यिकीय शक्ति — असली असर को पकड़ पाने की प्रयोग की क्षमता
definition: an experiment's ability to detect a real effect if one exists
example: The test lacked statistical power, so we learned nothing with great precision.

hindi: सांख्यिकीय रूप से सार्थक — नतीजा संयोग नहीं, असल असर लगता है
definition: unlikely to be explained by random chance
example: It is statistically significant, just not significant in any other sense.

hindi: उपलब्धता की स्थिति — ऑनलाइन, व्यस्त या दूर
definition: the dot and label claiming whether you're available
example: His status says available; his replies say otherwise.

hindi: स्थिति रिपोर्ट — प्रगति की नियमित औपचारिक सूचना
definition: a recurring report on progress, risks, and how fine everything is
example: The status update says on track; the team says otherwise.

hindi: गुप्त अवस्था — लॉन्च से पहले चुपचाप काम करना
definition: operating secretly before launch to avoid tipping off competitors
example: They're in stealth mode, which hasn't stopped the founder from tweeting hints daily.

hindi: संचालन समिति — परियोजना की निगरानी करती वरिष्ठ समिति
definition: the steering committee; senior people who meet monthly to redirect your project
example: Steerco approved the plan they rewrote at the last steerco.

hindi: छलांग-भर बदलाव — धीरे-धीरे नहीं, एकदम नए स्तर पर पहुंचना
definition: a sudden jump to a new level rather than gradual improvement
example: We need a step change, announced the same slide as last year.

hindi: चिपकाव — आदत बनने का संकेत, अक्सर DAU बटा MAU
definition: how habitually users return, often measured as DAU over MAU
example: Our stickiness suggests users visit weekly, mostly to reset passwords.

hindi: वृत्तिका — किसी ख़ास मद के लिए तय छोटी रक़म
definition: a fixed sum paid for a specific purpose, like learning or wellness
example: The wellness stipend quietly became everyone's unused-gym fund.

hindi: तय दाम पर शेयर खरीदने का अधिकार
definition: the right to buy company shares later at a preset price
example: The stock options are either a house deposit or wallpaper.

hindi: स्टोरी मैपिंग — उपयोगकर्ता-यात्रा के क्रम में कहानियाँ सजाना
definition: arranging stories along the user journey to see releases and gaps
example: Story mapping covered a wall and humbled the roadmap.

hindi: स्टोरी पॉइंट — कार्य के सापेक्ष आकार की अमूर्त इकाई
definition: an abstract unit for estimating a task's relative size, deliberately not hours
example: Three story points, he said, with the confidence of a coin flip.

hindi: कथा-पट — अनुभव को दृश्य-दर-दृश्य चित्रों में दिखाना
definition: a comic-strip sketch of a user's experience, scene by scene
example: The storyboard has our user smiling by frame four; ambitious.

hindi: अनौपचारिक मत — राय भाँपने का ग़ैर-बाध्यकारी वोट
definition: an informal, non-binding vote to gauge opinion
example: A straw poll before lunch showed the rename was doomed.

hindi: कच्चा ख़ाका — बहस शुरू करने के लिए बनाया शुरुआती प्रस्ताव
definition: a rough first proposal made to be criticized and improved
example: Here's a strawman for the pricing tiers; tear it apart.

hindi: सरल बनाना — प्रक्रिया से फ़ालतू क़दम हटाना
definition: to simplify a process by removing steps, meetings, or occasionally people
example: We streamlined expense approvals from five clicks to four.

hindi: तनाव-परीक्षण करना — चरम हालात में टिकाव जाँचना
definition: to check how something holds up under extreme conditions
example: We stress-tested the budget against 'what if nobody renews'.

hindi: क्षमता से बड़ा काम — तरक्की का (और थकान का) मौका
definition: a task above your current level, offered as growth, unpaid at the new level
example: The stretch assignment was staff-level work at senior-level pay.

hindi: अतिरिक्त लक्ष्य — क्षमता बचे तो करने योग्य महत्वाकांक्षी काम
definition: an ambitious extra target beyond the committed plan
example: The stretch goal became a commitment somewhere between drafts.

hindi: विकल्प भुनाते समय शेयर का पूर्व-निर्धारित दाम
definition: the fixed price you pay per share when exercising options
example: Great strike price, assuming the company is ever worth more than it.

hindi: शैली मार्गदर्शिका — रंग, टाइपोग्राफ़ी और लहजे के लिखित नियम
definition: the documented rules for colors, type, spacing, and tone
example: The style guide says sentence case; the app disagrees on every screen.

hindi: ईमेल का विषय — खुलने या दबने का फ़ैसला
definition: the email's title, deciding whether it gets opened or archived
example: The subject line said 'quick thing'; it was a reorg.

hindi: मुख्य भूमिकाओं के उत्तराधिकारी पहले से तैयार रखना
definition: preparing who takes over key roles before the current holders leave
example: Succession planning started the week after the CTO's surprise resignation.

hindi: बंद करना — पुरानी सुविधा को आदरपूर्वक विदा करना
definition: to retire a product or feature gracefully
example: We're sunsetting the old dashboard; mourners welcome.

hindi: किसी उत्पाद या टीम को धीरे-धीरे बंद करना
definition: gradually shutting down a product or team, with poetic lighting
example: They're sunsetting the app, along with the team that built it.

hindi: सहायता अनुरोध — ग्राहक की दर्ज की गई समस्या
definition: a logged customer issue, numbered, queued, and prioritized
example: Ticket #4512 is marked urgent; it was filed in March.

hindi: दबी बात सामने लाना — चर्चा में उठाना
definition: to bring a buried issue or fact into open view
example: Surfacing this from page six of the thread before it dies.

hindi: उत्तरजीवी पूर्वाग्रह — सिर्फ बचे हुओं को देखकर निष्कर्ष निकालना
definition: drawing conclusions only from what survived while ignoring what vanished
example: Retention looks great among users who stayed, notes the survivorship bias.

hindi: सतत गति — बिना थके लगातार निभाई जा सकने वाली रफ़्तार
definition: a working speed a team can maintain indefinitely without burning out
example: We believe in sustainable pace, except in Q4, Q2, and Q3.

hindi: मोटा अनुमान — बिना ठोस आधार का आत्मविश्वासी आकलन
definition: scientific wild-ass guess; an estimate with confidence but without evidence
example: That timeline was a SWAG, so treat the decimals with respect.

hindi: झुंड बनाना — पूरी टीम का एक काम पर टूट पड़ना
definition: for the whole team to jump on one item until it's finished
example: Drop everything and swarm the release blocker.

hindi: मेहनत की हिस्सेदारी — पैसे की जगह श्रम से कमाया स्वामित्व
definition: ownership earned through unpaid work instead of invested money
example: My salary is sweat equity and whatever's left in the snack drawer.

hindi: स्विमलेन — बोर्ड पर व्यक्ति या श्रेणी की अलग पंक्ति
definition: a horizontal row on a board separating work by person, team, or type
example: The urgent swimlane now contains most of the board.

hindi: तालमेल बैठक — जानकारी मिलाने की छोटी मीटिंग
definition: a short meeting to exchange updates
example: Can we do a quick sync before the client call?

hindi: निवेशकों का समूह — एक ही सौदे में मिलकर पैसा लगाना
definition: a group of investors joining together in one deal
example: The syndicate has eleven investors and one very tired lawyer.

hindi: तालमेल — मिलकर काम करने से बढ़ा हुआ असर
definition: combined effect greater than the sum of parts; the go-to justification for any merger or reorg
example: The acquisition deck promised synergies nobody has located since.

hindi: कृत्रिम डेटा — असली डेटा की कमी में मशीन से बनाया प्रशिक्षण डेटा
definition: artificially generated data used for training when real data is scarce or sensitive
example: We generated synthetic data for rare injuries rather than waiting for real ones.

hindi: सिस्टम प्रॉम्प्ट — एआई का व्यवहार तय करने वाले छिपे स्थायी निर्देश
definition: hidden standing instructions that set an AI product's behavior before users type anything
example: Someone edited the system prompt, and the coach turned aggressively cheerful overnight.

hindi: T-आकार कौशल — एक गहरी विशेषज्ञता, बाकी में कामचलाऊ चौड़ाई
definition: deep in one specialty with working breadth across many others
example: We want T-shaped engineers: deep in one thing, dangerous in everything.

hindi: टी-शर्ट आकलन — कामों को S, M, L आकार देना
definition: estimating work as small, medium, or large before anyone commits to numbers
example: T-shirt sizing says it's a large; the deadline says medium.

hindi: स्थगित करना — मुद्दे को बाद के लिए टाल देना
definition: to postpone discussion of a topic until later
example: We tabled the pricing debate for the third straight week.

hindi: न्यूनतम शर्त — मुक़ाबले में बने रहने की बुनियादी ज़रूरत
definition: the bare minimum features required to compete at all
example: Dark mode isn't a differentiator anymore; it's table stakes.

hindi: न्यूनतम अनिवार्य सुविधा — बाज़ार में टिके रहने भर की शर्त
definition: a feature users expect by default; its absence disqualifies you
example: Dark mode went from delighter to table-stakes feature in about two years.

hindi: टैब बनाम स्पेस — इंडेंटेशन पर अंतहीन धर्मयुद्ध
definition: the eternal indentation holy war no team fully survives
example: The style guide settled tabs vs spaces; the comments disagree.

hindi: ध्येय वाक्य — ब्रांड की एक-पंक्ति पहचान
definition: the short memorable phrase that sits under the company logo
example: After six workshops, the tagline is 'Work, but better.'

hindi: अलग से बात करना — मीटिंग के बाहर चर्चा टालना
definition: to move a discussion out of the meeting, sometimes never to resume
example: Great question — let's take it offline.

hindi: कार्यभार सँभालना — किसी और का काम या ज़िम्मेदारी लेना
definition: to assume control of work someone else was doing
example: She took over the migration and found the real timeline.

hindi: मोर्चा सँभालना — किसी काम में अगुआ बनना
definition: to be the lead person on a task
example: Priya's taking point on the audit; direct all panic to her.

hindi: कमीशन दर — हर लेन-देन से प्लेटफ़ॉर्म का रखा हिस्सा
definition: the percentage of each transaction a marketplace keeps
example: We raised the take rate and the sellers took notice.

hindi: घर पर करने का इंटरव्यू-असाइनमेंट
definition: a coding or design assignment candidates complete on their own time
example: The take-home said two hours; the honest estimate was a weekend.

hindi: प्रति कर्मचारी प्रतिभा का अनुपात — छोटी पर दमदार टीम का आदर्श
definition: the idea that fewer, stronger people beat many average ones
example: The memo praised talent density; the team read it as a warning.

hindi: कुल संभावित बाज़ार — हर संभव ग्राहक मिलने पर कुल कमाई
definition: total addressable market; the full revenue opportunity if you captured every possible customer
example: Our TAM is huge if every human buys four subscriptions.

hindi: विषयांतर — मुद्दे से भटकी चर्चा
definition: a side discussion that drifts from the agenda
example: Fascinating tangent; parking lot it and back to the launch.

hindi: स्पर्श लक्ष्य — उंगली से दबाने लायक न्यूनतम जगह
definition: the touchable area of a control, ideally finger-sized
example: The tap targets are ant-sized, so users keep favoriting by accident.

hindi: पुष्टि बाकी — लगभग तय, मुहर बाकी
definition: to be confirmed — decided in spirit, unconfirmed on paper
example: Friday 3pm TBC, pending the one person who never confirms.

hindi: अभी तय नहीं — बाद में तय होगा
definition: to be determined — undecided, and staying that way for now
example: Venue TBD, which means nobody has booked one.

hindi: सच कहूँ तो — साफ़ बात की भूमिका
definition: to be honest — candor incoming, brace slightly
example: TBH the deck needs one more pass before the board sees it.

hindi: कुल अनुबंध मूल्य — पूरी अवधि की अनुबंध-राशि
definition: total contract value — the full worth of a contract across its entire term
example: Sales quotes TCV, finance quotes ACV, and everyone quotes whichever is bigger.

hindi: टीम-भावना निर्माण — भरोसा बढ़ाने की गतिविधियाँ
definition: activities meant to strengthen trust and rapport within a team
example: Nothing bonds a team like team building nobody asked for.

hindi: तकनीकी कर्ज़ — जल्दबाज़ी के शॉर्टकट जो बाद में महँगे पड़ते हैं
definition: the future cost of quick-and-dirty code choices made to ship faster today
example: We'll pay down the tech debt next quarter, said every quarter.

hindi: टीम की तकनीकी दिशा तय करने वाला इंजीनियर — बिना प्रबंधकीय अधिकार
definition: the engineer setting a team's technical direction, usually without people authority
example: As tech lead, she owns the architecture and none of the raises.

hindi: भूमिका बाँधना — किसी काम या चर्चा को शुरू करने लायक़ तैयार करना
definition: to prepare something so it is ready to begin
example: I'll tee up the discussion with a short memo.

hindi: टेलीमेट्री — उत्पाद से अपने आप वापस भेजा गया उपयोग-डेटा
definition: usage data automatically sent back from the product
example: Telemetry says nobody uses the feature; the author disputes the telemetry.

hindi: तापमान — मॉडल के उत्तरों में यादृच्छिकता तय करने वाली सेटिंग
definition: a setting controlling how random or predictable a model's output is
example: Turn the temperature down; motivational quotes shouldn't rhyme with 'quadriceps'.

hindi: मन टटोलना — राय की त्वरित थाह
definition: a quick poll of how people feel about something
example: Temperature check on the new deadline: thumbs up or down?

hindi: अनिश्चित स्वीकृति — शायद आऊँगा वाला जवाब
definition: marked as maybe attending on a calendar invite
example: Twelve invitees, nine tentative: so, a meeting with vibes.

hindi: किसी कंपनी में बिताई गई कुल अवधि
definition: how long someone has been at a company
example: Four years of tenure here counts as elder statesman.

hindi: निवेश शर्तों का प्रारंभिक दस्तावेज़ — सौदे की मुख्य शर्तें
definition: a non-binding summary of the key terms of an investment deal
example: We got the term sheet Friday and stopped sleeping Saturday.

hindi: वह स्तर जिसके आगे पदोन्नति अनिवार्य नहीं
definition: the level where you may stay indefinitely without being pushed to advance
example: Senior is the terminal level; past that, promotion is optional ambition.

hindi: सेवा शर्तें — उत्पाद इस्तेमाल के नियमों का दस्तावेज़
definition: the legal rules users accept to use a product
example: Nobody reads the terms of service, including, occasionally, us.

hindi: बिक्री क्षेत्र — विक्रेता को सौंपा इलाक़ा या उद्योग
definition: the region, industry, or account list a salesperson is assigned to work
example: His territory is 'EMEA plus whatever nobody else wanted.'

hindi: उत्पादन में ही परीक्षण — असली उपयोगकर्ता ही अनजाने टेस्टर
definition: skipping proper testing and letting real users find the bugs
example: Everyone has a test environment; some teams also have production.

hindi: ग्राहक प्रशंसा-कथन — संतुष्ट ग्राहक की टिप्पणी
definition: a customer quote praising the product, used in marketing
example: The testimonial is glowing because we wrote it and they approved it.

hindi: पाठ-से-वाक् — लिखे शब्दों से स्वाभाविक आवाज़ बनाना
definition: generating natural-sounding spoken audio from written text
example: Text-to-speech gives the coach a voice; marketing spent a month choosing its vibe.

hindi: लीक से हटकर सोचना — घिसे-पिटे ढर्रे छोड़कर सोचना
definition: to think unconventionally; the most conventional request in business
example: The brief just says: think outside the box, but cheaper.

hindi: तृतीय-पक्ष — बाहरी कंपनी द्वारा प्रदत्त
definition: provided by an external company rather than built or done internally
example: The outage was a third-party issue, which soothes no customer.

hindi: विचार अग्रणी — जिसकी राय उद्योग में मानी जाती है
definition: someone whose opinions carry industry weight, sometimes self-declared
example: He became a thought leader by posting daily about leadership.

hindi: जुड़ी बातचीत की कड़ी — एक विषय के जवाब एक जगह
definition: a chain of replies on one topic, kept out of the main channel
example: Answer in the thread so the channel stays readable.

hindi: थ्रूपुट — प्रति अवधि पूर्ण कार्यों की संख्या
definition: how many items a team finishes per unit of time
example: Throughput doubled once we stopped starting things.

hindi: दीवार पार फेंकना — काम अगली टीम पर डालकर पल्ला झाड़ना
definition: handing work to the next team with zero context and zero responsibility
example: Dev threw it over the wall; ops threw it back with interest.

hindi: बलि चढ़ाना — ख़ुद बचने के लिए साथी पर दोष डालना
definition: to blame a colleague publicly to protect yourself
example: He threw the vendor under the bus in the client call.

hindi: अँगूठा निशान — सहमति की मुहर
definition: the minimum unit of agreement, one emoji long
example: A thumbs-up from her counts as formal sign-off.

hindi: अग्रिम धन्यवाद — काम से पहले आभार
definition: thanks in advance — gratitude paid before the work is done
example: Could someone rerun the numbers before noon? TIA.

hindi: टिकट — ट्रैकर में दर्ज एक कार्य-इकाई
definition: a single tracked unit of work in whatever tool the team uses
example: If it's not a ticket, it didn't happen.

hindi: विशेष दस्ता — एक अहम समस्या के लिए चुनी गई छोटी टीम
definition: a small hand-picked group assembled to attack one urgent problem
example: A tiger team formed at midnight to fix checkout.

hindi: मूल्य मिलने तक का समय — साइनअप से पहले फायदे तक की देरी
definition: how long a new user takes to get real benefit
example: Our time-to-value is twenty minutes, nineteen of them onboarding.

hindi: समय-सीमा बाँधना — कार्य को निश्चित अवधि में सीमित करना
definition: to cap an activity at a fixed duration and stop when time expires
example: Let's timebox this debate to ten minutes and regret it later.

hindi: समय-प्रहरी — बैठक में घड़ी पर नज़र रखने वाला
definition: the person assigned to watch the clock during a meeting
example: As timekeeper, I'm obligated to say we're ten minutes over.

hindi: समयरेखा — कब क्या होगा, उसकी रूपरेखा
definition: when things will supposedly happen, in order
example: The timeline is aggressive, the word we use instead of fictional.

hindi: समय-क्षेत्र मेल — साझा कार्य-घंटे
definition: the shared hours when distributed teammates are all working
example: Our timezone overlap is ninety minutes, so we guard it.

hindi: पद-नाम बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर देना — वेतन की जगह भारी टाइटल
definition: handing out impressive titles instead of pay or actual scope
example: Title inflation made him a VP of a team of one.

hindi: बहुत लंबा, नहीं पढ़ा — ऊपर लिखा छोटा सार
definition: too long; didn't read — a one-line summary placed above the detail
example: TL;DR: launch moved to Tuesday, nothing else changed.

hindi: क्षणिक सूचना-पट्टी — किनारे उभरकर अपने आप ग़ायब होने वाला संदेश
definition: a brief notification that pops up and fades away on its own
example: The toast confirmed the save and vanished before anyone could read it.

hindi: बाद में करूँगा का निशान — कोड में छोड़ा गया शाश्वत वादा
definition: a comment marking work promised for later, where later means never
example: The TODO from 2016 celebrated its tenth anniversary untouched.

hindi: यांत्रिक मशक्कत — बार-बार का हाथ से होने वाला थकाऊ परिचालन काम
definition: repetitive manual operational work that automation should have eaten by now
example: Two hours of daily toil; automating it stays on the someday list.

hindi: टोकन — पाठ की सबसे छोटी इकाई जिसे मॉडल पढ़ता-लिखता है
definition: the small chunk of text a model reads and writes, roughly part of a word
example: Every emoji in the coach's pep talk costs us tokens.

hindi: कुल आमदनी — ख़र्च घटाने से पहले की कमाई
definition: total revenue, before any costs are subtracted
example: The top line looks great if you ignore everything below it.

hindi: बिक्री-कीप का ऊपरी हिस्सा — पहली बार रुचि दिखाने वाले
definition: the earliest stage of buyer interest, where awareness is broad and intent is thin
example: The blog drives top of funnel; whether anyone buys is a later problem.

hindi: ज़ेहन में सबसे ऊपर — जो सबसे पहले याद आए
definition: the first thing someone thinks of
example: Keep security top of mind, at least until the audit passes.

hindi: उद्धरण के ऊपर जवाब लिखना — पुराना नीचे छोड़कर
definition: to reply above the quoted email instead of point by point
example: He top-posts, so scroll down to find what actually happened.

hindi: कुल पारिश्रमिक — वेतन, बोनस और शेयर मिलाकर
definition: salary, bonus, and equity added together, the number that actually matters
example: Base looked modest until total comp included the equity refresh.

hindi: हाल-चाल लेना — काम के सिलसिले में छोटी-सी बातचीत
definition: to make brief contact to exchange updates
example: Just touching base on that invoice from March.

hindi: संपर्क बिंदु — ग्राहक या टीम से जुड़ने का हर मौक़ा
definition: any point of contact with a customer or team
example: The invoice email is a touchpoint, so stop making it ugly.

hindi: खुली सभा — नेतृत्व से सवाल-जवाब वाली कंपनी बैठक
definition: a company-wide meeting with leadership updates and open questions
example: Ask about the reorg at the town hall, not in chat.

hindi: पकड़ — बाज़ार में मिलती स्वीकृति और रफ़्तार
definition: early evidence that customers actually want the thing
example: The side project got more traction than the main product.

hindi: ट्रेडमार्क — ब्रांड नाम या चिह्न का क़ानूनी संरक्षण
definition: legal protection for a brand name, logo, or slogan
example: Rename the feature; that word is someone's trademark.

hindi: समझौता-विनिमय — एक लाभ पाने के लिए दूसरे की कीमत चुकाना
definition: giving up one good thing to get another
example: Every design decision is a tradeoff; today speed beat elegance, again.

hindi: नीचे जुड़े पुराने ईमेल — पूरी मेल-शृंखला
definition: the quoted chain of earlier emails below; Indian English staple
example: Context is in the trail mail, all sixty screens of it.

hindi: प्रशिक्षण डेटा — वे उदाहरण जिनसे मॉडल सीखता है
definition: the examples a model learns from; its quality decides the model's quality
example: The model judges everyone's squat depth harshly; check the training data's gym.

hindi: श्रेणी-वृक्ष परीक्षण — मेनू ढांचे में चीज़ें मिलती हैं या नहीं जाँचना
definition: testing whether users can find things in your menu structure alone
example: Tree testing confirmed 'Preferences' and 'Settings' are a coin flip.

hindi: रुझान रेखा — डेटा की दिशा दिखाने वाली रेखा
definition: a line drawn through data points to show direction
example: The trend line points up if you delete March.

hindi: छाँटना — गंभीरता के आधार पर प्राथमिकता तय करना
definition: to sort incoming bugs or requests by urgency so the worst gets attention first
example: We triage bugs on Mondays; by Wednesday they've healed or multiplied.

hindi: अनकहा ज्ञान — दस्तावेज़ों में नहीं, लोगों के दिमाग़ में बसी जानकारी
definition: unwritten know-how that lives in employees' heads
example: The deploy process is tribal knowledge and one shell script.

hindi: छँटाई करना — फ़ालतू ख़र्च या काम हटाना
definition: to cut whatever is deemed excess, from budgets to teams
example: Finance wants to trim the fat; everyone hides their snacks.

hindi: हिसाब मिलान — अनुमानित बनाम असल उपयोग का अंतर चुकता करना
definition: a periodic adjustment reconciling estimated versus actual usage or payment
example: The license true-up billed us for every laptop we forgot.

term: turn it off and on again
hindi: बंद करके फिर चालू करो — तकनीकी सहायता का अमर पहला उपाय
definition: the immortal first remedy of all computing support
example: Our orchestration layer is just turning it off and on again, at scale.

hindi: इस्तीफे की मानक सूचना — अमेरिकी दो-हफ़्ते की परंपरा
definition: the customary US resignation heads-up before departure
example: He gave two weeks' notice; his access lasted two hours.

hindi: टाइपिंग के तीन बिंदु — जवाब लिखे जाने का संकेत
definition: the three dots showing someone is composing, or deleting, a reply
example: The typing indicator flickered for five minutes; the reply was 'ok'.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता स्वीकृति परीक्षण — ग्राहक द्वारा अंतिम जाँच
definition: user acceptance testing; the stage where real users confirm it actually works
example: It sailed through QA and sank in UAT.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता इंटरफ़ेस — स्क्रीन पर दिखने-छूने वाली परत
definition: user interface; everything on screen the user sees and touches
example: The UI is clean because we moved the mess into settings.

hindi: बाधा हटाना — रुके काम को आगे बढ़ने देना
definition: to remove whatever is preventing someone's work from proceeding
example: Can you unblock me before standup so I have something to say?

hindi: अल्प-अनुकूलन — इतना सरल मॉडल कि पैटर्न ही न पकड़ पाए
definition: a model too simple to capture the pattern, wrong on old and new data alike
example: It calls every exercise 'movement detected' — underfitting with confidence.

hindi: कम वादा करना — उम्मीदें जानबूझकर नीची रखना
definition: to set expectations deliberately low so results look better
example: He underpromises so hard his estimates need therapy.

hindi: बाज़ार-भाव से महँगे हो चुके स्टॉक विकल्प — फिलहाल बेकार
definition: options whose strike price exceeds the current share value, making them worthless
example: The options went underwater, and so did morale.

hindi: अलिखित फ़ीचर — बग का शिष्ट, आधिकारिक-सा नाम
definition: a bug wearing the polite official name of a feature
example: The crash on double-click is an undocumented feature, per marketing.

hindi: एक अरब डॉलर से अधिक मूल्य वाला निजी स्टार्टअप
definition: a private startup valued at one billion dollars or more
example: The founder says unicorn status changed nothing, from his new corner office.

hindi: इकाई अर्थशास्त्र — प्रति ग्राहक कमाई और लागत का हिसाब
definition: profit and cost calculated per customer or unit sold
example: The unit economics work at scale; the scale is theoretical.

hindi: असीमित छुट्टी की नीति — जो अक्सर कम छुट्टी में बदलती है
definition: no fixed vacation allowance, which quietly means no payout and peer-pressured minimums
example: Unlimited PTO, and somehow everyone takes less than the old fifteen days.

hindi: खोलकर समझाना — बात की परतें अलग-अलग करना
definition: to break a statement down and examine it in detail
example: There's a lot to unpack in that one-line resignation.

hindi: सदस्यता छोड़ना — मेल सूची से नाम हटाना
definition: to remove yourself from a mailing list, hopefully forever
example: I unsubscribed from the newsletter and it came back anyway.

hindi: ऊपर और दाहिनी ओर — लगातार बढ़त दिखाता आदर्श ग्राफ
definition: the chart shape every investor update strives to show
example: Up and to the right, provided the y-axis starts at ninety.

hindi: बढ़े मूल्य का दौर — पिछले दौर से ऊँची वैल्यूएशन पर निवेश
definition: a funding round at a higher valuation than the previous one
example: An up round in this market deserves its own press release, apparently.

hindi: पूरी जानकारी में — काम की ताज़ा स्थिति से वाक़िफ़
definition: fully informed and ready to contribute
example: Bring the new manager up to speed before Thursday.

hindi: पदोन्नत हो या निकलो — तय समय में ऊपर न बढ़ने पर विदाई
definition: requiring promotion within a set time, or departure
example: The junior levels are up-or-out; the clock starts on day one.

hindi: सुधार-बढ़त — प्रयोग में नियंत्रण समूह के मुकाबले मिला फायदा
definition: the measured improvement a change produces over the control
example: A two percent uplift, rounded up in every retelling.

hindi: महँगा संस्करण बेचना — मौजूदा ग्राहक को बड़ा प्लान
definition: to sell an existing customer a bigger or pricier version of what they have
example: The support call somehow ended with an upsell to the enterprise tier.

hindi: मूल स्रोत — वह मूल प्रोजेक्ट जिससे आपकी प्रति निकली है
definition: the original project your copy derives from, where fixes should be sent
example: Send the fix upstream, or maintain your fork forever.

hindi: अत्यावश्यक — तुरंत ध्यान माँगता
definition: needing immediate attention, a label that dulls with every use
example: Everything he sends is marked urgent, so nothing is.

hindi: उपयोगिता परीक्षण — असली लोगों से उत्पाद चलवाकर अड़चनें देखना
definition: watching real people attempt tasks to find where they struggle
example: Five minutes into the usability test, nobody had found the search bar.

hindi: उपयोग प्रसंग — उत्पाद से हल होने वाली ठोस परिस्थिति
definition: a specific situation in which a product gets used
example: Great feature — but what's the use case beyond the demo?

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता प्रतिक्रिया — असली इस्तेमालकर्ताओं की राय और शिकायतें
definition: what actual users say about the product
example: User feedback is unanimous: nobody can find the button we're proudest of.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता प्रवाह — एक काम के लिए स्क्रीन-दर-स्क्रीन रास्ता
definition: the screen-by-screen path a user takes through one task
example: The checkout user flow has a scenic detour through account creation.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता साक्षात्कार — ज़रूरतें समझने की आमने-सामने बातचीत
definition: a one-on-one conversation to understand a user's needs and habits
example: In the user interview she praised the feature she'd never once opened.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता यात्रा — लक्ष्य तक पहुँचने के सभी चरणों का नक्शा
definition: the full sequence of steps a user takes to reach a goal
example: The user journey has eleven steps and users quit at step three.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता शोध — असली उपयोगकर्ताओं की ज़रूरतें समझने का अध्ययन
definition: studying real users to learn their needs and behavior
example: We did user research after launch, which explains a lot.

hindi: यूज़र स्टोरी — उपयोगकर्ता की ज़रूरत के रूप में लिखा कार्य
definition: a requirement written from the user's perspective, typically 'as a user, I want...'
example: As a user, I want this user story to fit in one sprint.

hindi: उपयोग में लाना — 'use' का लंबा, दफ़्तरी रूप
definition: to use, but with three extra letters of professionalism
example: Please utilize the new template going forward.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता अनुभव — उत्पाद इस्तेमाल का शुरू से अंत तक एहसास
definition: user experience; how using the product actually feels end to end
example: New coat of UI, same old UX underneath.

hindi: पहला संस्करण — शुरुआती, सीमित पर जारी करने लायक रूप
definition: the first shipped version, deliberately imperfect
example: v1 ships Friday; v2 is where the dreams live.

hindi: कंपनी का आँका गया मूल्य — निवेश के समय तय क़ीमत
definition: the negotiated worth of a company, often more art than math
example: Our valuation doubled; our revenue, less so.

hindi: अधिकतम मूल्य सीमा — जिस पर नोट या SAFE शेयरों में बदलता है
definition: the maximum valuation at which a convertible investment turns into equity
example: The angel wanted a lower valuation cap; we wanted his money anyway.

hindi: मूल्य प्रस्ताव — ग्राहक को क्या फ़ायदा मिलेगा
definition: the core promise of what a customer gets and why it beats alternatives
example: If the value proposition needs three slides, it isn't one.

hindi: अतिरिक्त लाभ — किसी काम से जुड़ी बढ़ी हुई उपयोगिता
definition: the extra benefit something contributes; often invoked when it is unclear
example: What's the value-add of a third weekly status meeting?

hindi: दिखावटी आँकड़ा — प्रभावशाली दिखता है पर असली प्रगति नहीं बताता
definition: a number that looks impressive but reflects no real progress
example: Cumulative signups only go up; that is why the chart exists.

hindi: प्रकार — प्रयोग में कुछ उपयोगकर्ताओं को दिखाया बदला हुआ संस्करण
definition: a modified version shown to some users in an experiment
example: Variant B won by a hair, so naturally we shipped variant C.

hindi: उद्यम पूँजीपति — जोखिम भरे स्टार्टअप्स में फ़ंड लगाने वाला पेशेवर निवेशक
definition: venture capitalist; a professional investor of pooled funds into high-risk, high-growth startups
example: The VC said 'interesting' four times, which means no.

hindi: सदिश डेटाबेस — अर्थ की समानता से खोज करने वाला भंडार
definition: a database that stores embeddings and finds items by similarity of meaning
example: Every FAQ lives in the vector database; the bot finds answers by vibes, mathematically.

hindi: वेग — प्रति स्प्रिंट पूरे हुए पॉइंट का औसत
definition: the average number of story points a team completes per sprint
example: Our velocity doubled after we doubled our estimates.

hindi: विक्रेता — कंपनी को सामान या सेवा बेचने वाली बाहरी फर्म
definition: an external company that sells you goods or services
example: The vendor promised 24/7 support; their inbox disagrees.

hindi: विक्रेता बंधन — सेवा बदलना इतना महँगा कि निकल न पाना
definition: being stuck with a supplier because switching would cost too much
example: It's not vendor lock-in, we just can't ever leave.

hindi: उद्यम ऋण — हिस्सेदारी दिए बिना रनवे बढ़ाने वाला क़र्ज़
definition: loans for venture-backed startups, extending runway without giving up equity
example: We took venture debt to avoid dilution; now the bank emails weekly.

hindi: वेंचर-पोषित — VC पूँजी से चलने वाली, ऊँची उम्मीदों समेत
definition: funded by venture capital, with the growth expectations that come attached
example: Venture-backed means the growth targets arrive before the revenue does.

hindi: ऊर्ध्व खंड — हर परत से होकर बनी छोटी संपूर्ण कार्यक्षमता
definition: a thin piece of functionality cut through every layer, shippable end to end
example: Demo a vertical slice first; nobody claps for a database schema.

hindi: समय के साथ शेयरों का आपका होते जाना
definition: earning your equity gradually over time, usually four years
example: He counts vesting dates the way children count down to birthdays.

hindi: जाँच-परख करना — भरोसे से पहले पृष्ठभूमि की पड़ताल
definition: to check someone or something carefully before trusting it
example: We vet vendors thoroughly now, one breach too late.

hindi: निषेध करना — अधिकार से प्रस्ताव ख़ारिज करना
definition: to block a decision using your authority
example: The CTO vetoed the rewrite; morale and relief in equal parts.

hindi: वाइब कोडिंग — एआई से कोड लिखवाकर बिना पूरा पढ़े अपनाना
definition: building software by prompting AI and accepting code you haven't fully read
example: The prototype was vibe coding at its finest; production has questions.

hindi: वीडियो-कॉल थकान — लंबी ऑनलाइन बैठकों की क्लांति
definition: tiredness caused by long hours on video calls
example: Camera off for this one, folks; video-call fatigue is real.

hindi: वायरल चक्र — उपयोग करते-करते नए उपयोगकर्ता अपने आप जुड़ना
definition: a built-in cycle where using the product naturally invites new users in
example: The viral loop works: every invoice we send advertises us to the client.

hindi: वायरल क्षमता — मौजूदा उपयोगकर्ताओं के ज़रिए नए उपयोगकर्ता आना
definition: growth driven by existing users bringing in new ones
example: We budgeted for virality; virality did not confirm.

hindi: आभासी पृष्ठभूमि — असल कमरे को ढकने वाला डिजिटल दृश्य
definition: a digital backdrop hiding your real surroundings on video
example: His virtual background flickered, revealing the laundry mountain.

hindi: दृश्यता — काम का ऊपर तक दिखना; जानकारी की पहुँच
definition: awareness of work by leadership; also access to information
example: The project needs more visibility, meaning a louder status email.

hindi: दृश्य पदानुक्रम — आकार-रंग से नज़र को महत्त्व का क्रम दिखाना
definition: arranging size, color, and position so the eye reads importance correctly
example: When everything is bold, the visual hierarchy is a flat line.

hindi: जबरन स्वयंसेवक बनाया गया — मना करने का विकल्प नहीं
definition: assigned to 'volunteer' for something with no real option to decline
example: He was voluntold to organize the hackathon he'd voted against.

hindi: प्रतीक्षा-कक्ष — मेज़बान की अनुमति तक ठहराव
definition: the holding area before a host admits you to a call
example: Spent five minutes in the waiting room of my own meeting.

hindi: प्रतीक्षा सूची — प्रवेश के इच्छुक उपयोगकर्ताओं की कतार
definition: a signup queue that rations access and manufactures demand
example: The waitlist has ten thousand people and, rumor has it, eleven users.

hindi: जागृति शब्द — जिस शब्द से वॉइस असिस्टेंट सक्रिय होता है
definition: the trigger phrase a voice assistant listens for before it starts responding
example: We tested wake words for months; everything sounds like 'okay' in a loud gym.

hindi: बोर्ड की सैर — स्टैंडअप में हर कार्ड की क्रमवार समीक्षा
definition: running standup by reviewing each card on the board instead of each person
example: We walk the board right to left, oldest regrets first.

hindi: चलते-चलते बैठक — टहलते हुए बातचीत
definition: a meeting held while walking, usually one-on-one
example: He books walking meetings so nobody can share a screen.

hindi: वॉर रूम — संकट के दौरान सबका एक जगह डेरा
definition: a room, physical or virtual, where a team camps until a crisis ends
example: We're in the war room until the migration lands; snacks provided.

hindi: परिचित के ज़रिए परिचय — भरोसे के साथ संपर्क
definition: an introduction to a prospect made by someone they already know and trust
example: One warm intro from an investor beat two hundred cold emails.

hindi: गपशप — सहकर्मियों की अनौपचारिक बतकही
definition: unplanned casual conversation between colleagues, in person or in a channel
example: Remote teams schedule watercooler chat, which slightly defeats the point.

hindi: जलप्रपात मॉडल — चरण-दर-चरण, बिना लौटे विकास पद्धति
definition: the sequential plan-then-build-then-test method agile was invented to escape
example: It's waterfall with standups, which we call transformation.

hindi: तरबूज़ परियोजना — बाहर से हरी, भीतर से लाल
definition: a project reported green outside while everything inside is red
example: That program is a watermelon; slice anywhere and it's red.

hindi: साप्ताहिक सक्रिय उपयोगकर्ता — हफ्ते में उत्पाद चलाने वाले लोग
definition: weekly active users; unique people active within a week
example: We report WAU because DAU was too honest.

hindi: वेब सुगम्यता दिशानिर्देश — पहुँच के अंतरराष्ट्रीय मानक नियम
definition: web content accessibility guidelines, the standard rules for accessible interfaces
example: Legal asked if we meet WCAG; the contrast checker laughed first.

hindi: आपका क्या विचार है — राय की माँग
definition: what do you think — an invitation to weigh in
example: Draft attached — WDYT before I send it wider?

hindi: कई भूमिकाएँ निभाना — एक व्यक्ति, कई ज़िम्मेदारियाँ
definition: to handle several roles at once, common at small companies
example: Our designer wears many hats, including support and payroll.

hindi: पहनने-योग्य डेटा — घड़ी-बैंड से मिले सेहत और गति के संकेत
definition: health and movement signals from watches, bands, and rings feeding AI features
example: The model saw your wearable data and gently suggests sleeping before midnight once.

hindi: ऑनलाइन संगोष्ठी — लीड जुटाने वाला वेब-सेमिनार
definition: an online seminar used to educate prospects and harvest their email addresses
example: Three hundred registered for the webinar, forty attended, twelve were employees.

hindi: प्रवेश औज़ार — बड़े अवसर में घुसने वाला छोटा शुरुआती उत्पाद
definition: the narrow initial product that gets you into a bigger opportunity
example: The expense tracker is just the wedge; the bank is the plan.

hindi: सप्ताह-दर-सप्ताह — पिछले हफ्ते से तुलना करके
definition: compared with the same measure one week earlier
example: Week-over-week we grew two percent, which annualizes into a fantasy.

hindi: साप्ताहिक बैठक — हफ़्ते की नियमित मीटिंग
definition: a team's regular once-a-week meeting
example: Add it to the weekly's agenda so we actually decide.

hindi: राय देना — चर्चा में अपना मत रखना
definition: to offer an opinion on a discussion
example: Legal wants to weigh in before the blog post goes live.

hindi: घर से काम करना
definition: work from home; doing the job outside the office
example: WFH Fridays survived three RTO memos and counting.

hindi: मुझे मंज़ूर है — बिना बहस सहमति
definition: works for me — agreement without further commentary
example: Tuesday at 11? WFM.

hindi: विशाल ग्राहक — पूरा साल बना देने वाला सौदा
definition: an unusually large customer or deal that could make the whole year
example: Land the whale and the quarter is saved; miss and we discuss 'learnings.'

hindi: महारत का क्षेत्र — जिस काम में कोई सबसे सहज हो
definition: the area where someone is most skilled and comfortable
example: Pricing models are squarely in her wheelhouse.

hindi: श्वेत पत्र — शोध-शैली में लिखा मार्केटिंग दस्तावेज़
definition: a long, authoritative-looking document that makes a pitch feel like research
example: The white paper cites three analysts and one blog post from 2019.

hindi: ख़ाली मैदान — बाज़ार का अनछुआ अवसर
definition: an untapped market opportunity
example: The deck claims white space; the market claims otherwise.

hindi: बोर्ड पर मिलकर सोचना — आरेख बनाकर हल खोजना
definition: to sketch and think through a problem on a board together
example: Let's whiteboard the architecture before anyone writes code.

hindi: बोर्ड पर कोड लिखवाने वाला इंटरव्यू — बिना कंप्यूटर के
definition: an interview where candidates solve coding problems on a whiteboard, sans compiler
example: Ten years of shipping software, judged by a whiteboard interview about linked lists.

hindi: कर दूँगा — सहमति, समय बताए बिना
definition: cheerful acceptance of a task, timeline unspecified
example: Will do, right after the two things due before it.

hindi: खोए ग्राहक की वापसी — पुराने ग्राहक को फिर जोड़ना
definition: a campaign to bring back customers who cancelled
example: The win-back email offers the discount they asked for before leaving.

hindi: दोनों का फ़ायदा — ऐसा नतीजा जिसमें दोनों पक्ष जीतें
definition: an outcome that benefits both sides
example: Remote Fridays were a rare, genuine win-win.

hindi: समेटना — काम धीरे-धीरे बंद करना
definition: to gradually shut something down
example: We're winding down the beta, gently, like a bomb squad.

hindi: विजेता-सर्वस्व — जहाँ बाज़ार का लगभग सब कुछ अगुवा ले जाता है
definition: describes markets where the leading player captures almost everything
example: In a winner-take-all market, second place is a case study.

hindi: प्रगतिरत कार्य — शुरू हुआ पर अधूरा काम
definition: work in progress; started but unfinished tasks, best kept few
example: Our WIP limit is six, and we're at fourteen.

hindi: रेखाचित्र खाका — स्क्रीन की संरचना दिखाने वाला सादा ढांचा
definition: a bare-bones sketch of a screen's layout, before visual design
example: Don't judge the colors; it's a wireframe, everything is gray on purpose.

hindi: पर्दे-पीछे मानव परीक्षण — स्वचालित दिखने वाला, इंसान से चलने वाला प्रोटोटाइप
definition: a prototype that looks automated but is secretly operated by humans
example: Our AI beta was a Wizard of Oz test named Kevin.

hindi: मुँह-ज़ुबानी प्रचार — ग्राहकों की आपसी सिफ़ारिश
definition: customers recommending the product to each other, unprompted and unbilled
example: Our best channel is word of mouth, which the dashboard can't take credit for.

hindi: कहीं से भी काम — स्थान की पूरी छूट
definition: a policy allowing work from any location, not just home or office
example: Work from anywhere lasted until payroll met tax law.

hindi: काम और निजी जीवन के बीच संतुलन
definition: the boundary between job and life, praised in postings, tested by pings
example: Work-life balance is in the job ad and off by the second sprint.

hindi: बग़ल का रास्ता — समस्या सुलझाए बिना उससे कतरा कर निकलना
definition: a way to avoid a problem without actually fixing it
example: The workaround is now five years old and load-bearing.

hindi: काम-सह-छुट्टी — सैरगाह से दफ़्तरी काम
definition: working remotely from a vacation spot
example: The workation was mostly work, with a view.

hindi: वर्कबैक अनुसूची — लॉन्च तिथि से पीछे की ओर बनी समय-योजना
definition: a timeline built backward from the launch date to today
example: The workback schedule says we needed to start last month.

hindi: कार्य-सत्र — चर्चा नहीं, साथ बैठकर काम
definition: a meeting for doing the work together rather than discussing it
example: Book a working session; we'll never finish this over comments.

hindi: मेरी मशीन पर तो चलता है — क्लासिक बहाना जब बग सिर्फ़ दूसरों को मिले
definition: the classic developer defense when a bug refuses to appear locally
example: Works on my machine, he said, as production burned.

hindi: मिलकर तराशना — समूह-सत्र में विचार सुधारना
definition: to refine an idea together in a group session
example: Let's workshop the name until it means nothing to everyone.

hindi: कार्यधारा — बड़ी परियोजना का समानांतर हिस्सा
definition: one parallel track of work inside a larger program
example: I'm on the migration workstream, whatever that turns out to be.

hindi: समेटना — बैठक का समापन और सार
definition: to bring a meeting to a close and summarize outcomes
example: Let's wrap up: three decisions, two action items, one grudge.

hindi: बट्टे खाते की रक़म — डूबी रक़म को घाटा मान लेना
definition: an amount accepted as a loss for accounting purposes
example: The failed pilot became a write-off and a cautionary tale.

hindi: अभी ज़रूरत नहीं — जो चाहिए ही नहीं उसे मत बनाओ (you aren't gonna need it)
definition: you aren't gonna need it; don't build for imagined future requirements
example: I was adding plugin support to a shell script when YAGNI intervened.

hindi: काम से पहले कामों की झड़ी — असल कार्य तक पहुँचने में उलझी छोटी पूर्व-तैयारियाँ
definition: the chain of small side tasks you must finish before the task you actually meant to do
example: I came to fix a typo and spent the morning yak shaving build scripts.

hindi: वर्ष-दर-वर्ष — पिछले साल की समान अवधि से तुलना करके
definition: compared with the same period a year earlier
example: Year-over-year hides a lot, which is why we love it.

hindi: कल का मौसम — पिछले स्प्रिंट जितना ही अगले में होगा, यह मानना
definition: predicting next sprint's output from last sprint's, whatever optimism says
example: Yesterday's weather says twenty points, not the forty in this plan.

hindi: आवाज़ कट रही है — ख़राब नेटवर्क की सूचना
definition: said when someone's audio keeps cutting out
example: You're breaking up; type it in the chat instead.

hindi: आपका माइक बंद है — हर कॉल की रस्मी टोक
definition: the ritual reminder that a speaker's microphone is off
example: She gave the whole update before the chorus of you're on mute.

hindi: शून्य से एक — नक़ल नहीं, बिल्कुल नई चीज़ रचना
definition: creating something genuinely new rather than improving what already exists
example: The keynote said zero to one; the roadmap said one point one.

hindi: शून्य-उदाहरण — बिना कोई नमूना दिखाए सीधे काम करवाना
definition: handling a task with no examples provided, just instructions
example: Zero-shot it first; if the answers get weird, start showing examples.

hindi: ज़ॉम्बी स्टार्टअप — न बढ़ने वाली, न मरने वाली कंपनी
definition: a company alive enough to keep operating but too stalled to grow or exit
example: It's a zombie startup: payroll clears, and absolutely nothing else happens.
